paragraphs.en: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2% and 42.9% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于机器人操作的研究集中于在示范数据上训练的专用策略。 我们表明，通用人工智能模型控制机械臂的可靠性可以超过专用策略，例如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）。 我们系统地分析了智能体操作策略（AMP），其中通用人工智能模型直接指挥机械臂，并随任务的展开调整其动作。 我们提出 AMP1，这是一个参考框架，可在单臂、双臂和移动操作中不加修改地运行。 AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 和 CaP-Gym 基准上取得了最先进的结果，且无需任何示范或针对任务的训练。 在 RoboLab-120 上，AMP1 零样本达到 85.6% 的成功率，而领先的 VLA 和 WAM 策略分别为 49.2% 和 42.9%。 该智能体在跨越十二个任务和三台机器人实例的 108 次真实世界试验中零样本成功 104 次，相比强大的 VLA 和 WAM 基线将失败率分别降低了 20 倍和 15 倍。 该基础框架不提供抓取、推压或放置技能；智能体自行发展出策略，例如搜索隐藏物体、将物体用作工具以及校准其摄像头。 加上持久记忆库后，智能体还能从经验中学习：带有跨回合保留的记忆表示的增强框架，相比零样本部署，将 RoboDojo 双臂操作任务上的失败率降低了 4.6 倍。 我们的分析表明，智能体操作策略远比专用操作策略更通用、更鲁棒，为机器人操作提供了有前景的基础。

paragraphs.en: In nature, manipulation draws on general intelligence. Animals can recruit their memory, reasoning, and problem-solving faculties when interacting with objects, with cognitive processes continuing to shape action as it unfolds [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . In robotics, much recent work has focused on models specialized for robot control, including vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs), trained or fine-tuned on robot demonstrations [ 4 , 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在自然界中，操纵依赖于通用智能。 动物在与物体交互时能够调动记忆、推理和问题解决能力，且认知过程在动作展开的过程中持续塑造行动 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 在机器人学中，近期的许多工作聚焦于专门用于机器人控制的模型，包括视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM），它们在机器人演示数据上进行训练或微调 [ 4 , 5 ] 。

sents.en: In nature, manipulation draws on general intelligence.
sents.zh: 在自然界中，操纵依赖于通用智能。

sents.en: Animals can recruit their memory, reasoning, and problem-solving faculties when interacting with objects, with cognitive processes continuing to shape action as it unfolds [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: 动物在与物体交互时能够调动记忆、推理和问题解决能力，且认知过程在动作展开的过程中持续塑造行动 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。

sents.en: In robotics, much recent work has focused on models specialized for robot control, including vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs), trained or fine-tuned on robot demonstrations [ 4 , 5 ] .
sents.zh: 在机器人学中，近期的许多工作聚焦于专门用于机器人控制的模型，包括视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM），它们在机器人演示数据上进行训练或微调 [ 4 , 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Generalist AI models have also been applied to manipulation, often through skill orchestration or offline program synthesis. In the first setting (skill orchestration), the model selects and sequences low-level skills such as grasping and placing [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . It can revise the plan as new observations arrive, but the available skills limit the generalist model’s control authority and the granularity at which it can command the manipulator. Since the generalist model’s interactions with the world are mediated by the provided skills, it is constrained by the skills’ limitations. In the second setting (offline program synthesis, sometimes known as ‘code-as-policies’), the model writes a control program before execution [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . The program can incorporate perception and feedback, but the generalist model is not in the loop and cannot reconsider the overall control strategy as the task unfolds.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型 AI 模型也被应用于操作任务，通常是通过技能编排或离线程序合成的方式。 在第一种设定（技能编排）中，模型选择并排序低层技能，例如抓取和放置 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 随着新观测的到来，它可以修改计划，但可用技能限制了通用型模型的控制权限以及它对机械臂下达指令的粒度。 由于通用型模型与世界的交互是由提供的技能来中介的，它受到这些技能局限性的制约。 在第二种设定（离线程序合成，有时被称为「代码即策略」）中，模型在执行之前编写一个控制程序 [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] 。 该程序可以包含感知和反馈，但通用型模型并不在控制回路中，无法随着任务的展开重新考虑整体控制策略。

sents.zh: 该程序可以包含感知和反馈，但通用型模型并不在控制回路中，无法随着任务的展开重新考虑整体控制策略。

paragraphs.en: A key obstacle to direct manipulation has been the limited spatial cognition of generalist frontier models [ 13 ] . However, spatial cognition has been advancing [ 14 , 15 ] , with recent models demonstrating convincing spatial planning, sensorimotor coordination, and embodied fluid intelligence [ 16 , 17 ] . These advances make a third approach increasingly viable: the generalist model remains in the control loop and commands the manipulator directly, revising its actions as the task unfolds [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] . We refer to this category as Agentic Manipulation Policies (AMPs).
paragraphs.zh: 直接操控的一个关键障碍是通用前沿模型的空间认知能力有限 [ 13 ] 。 然而，空间认知能力一直在进步 [ 14 , 15 ] ，近期的模型已经展现出令人信服的空间规划、感知运动协调以及具身流体智能 [ 16 , 17 ] 。 这些进展使得第三种方法日益可行：通用模型保持在控制回路中，直接指挥操作器，并随着任务的展开不断修正其动作 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] 。 我们将这一类别称为智能体操作策略（Agentic Manipulation Policies，AMPs）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies across models and harness configurations. We present AMP1, a reference harness that provides visual observations, code execution, and direct control of manipulator motion. Paired with frontier models, AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot results on the RoboLab-120 [ 22 ] and CaP-Gym [ 18 ] benchmarks. The agent succeeds in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, compared to 49 for FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] and 30 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 24 ] , thus reducing the failure rate by 15x and 20x, respectively, relative to these WAM and VLA baselines. See Fig. 1 and the supplementary video for curated highlights.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们系统地分析了跨模型与运行环境配置的智能体操作策略。 我们提出了 AMP1，一个提供视觉观测、代码执行以及对机械臂运动直接控制的参考运行环境。 与前沿模型配合使用，AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 [22] 和 CaP-Gym [18] 基准上取得了最先进的零样本结果。 该智能体在跨越十二个任务和三台机器人实例的 108 次真实世界试验中成功了 104 次，相比之下 FLUX 3 Action [23] 成功 49 次，π_{0.5} [24] 成功 30 次，因此相对于这些 WAM 和 VLA 基线，失败率分别降低了 15 倍和 20 倍。 精选亮点见图 1 和补充视频。

paragraphs.en: We document emergent behaviors that arise as the agent brings its broader cognitive faculties to bear on manipulation. When a book lies flat on a table and cannot be grasped as is, the agent pushes it to the table edge to expose a graspable surface. When a target object is hidden, the agent moves occluding objects out of the way to find it. When a large fruit is too wide to grasp, the agent pins it against a heavier object, slides the gripper underneath, and lifts it like a forklift. Failed actions can themselves supply information: the agent infers an unseen shelf from a blocked motion and changes its grasp and approach. On the real robot, the agent diagnoses camera calibration errors from discrepancies between commanded and observed motion, then compensates for them in subsequent actions. None of these behaviors are specified in the prompt or supplied as skills in the harness. The generalist model develops them within each episode by reasoning about geometry, contact, and the consequences of its own actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录了当智能体将其更广泛的认知能力运用于操作任务时所涌现出的行为。 当一本书平放在桌面上而无法按原样抓取时，智能体会将它推向桌边，以露出可抓取的表面。 当目标物体被遮挡时，智能体会移开遮挡物来找到它。 当一个水果太宽而无法直接抓取时，智能体会将它抵住一个更重的物体，把夹爪滑入其下方，然后像叉车一样将它抬起。 失败的动作本身也能提供信息：智能体会从受阻的动作中推断出一个看不见的搁板，并改变其抓取方式和接近路径。 在真实机器人上，智能体会根据指令动作与观测动作之间的差异来诊断相机标定误差，并在后续动作中加以补偿。 这些行为没有一项是在提示词中指定的，也没有作为技能在运行框架中提供。 通用模型在每一回合内通过推理几何关系、接触以及自身动作的后果来发展出这些行为。

paragraphs.en: We also investigate few-shot and continual learning from the agent’s own experience. We equip AMP1 with a persistent memory, allowing the agent to record useful observations, strategies, and code after reflecting on its successes and failures. Experience accumulates in this memory bank, while the model’s weights remain fixed. No expert demonstrations or gradient updates are required. We evaluate this approach on the 42 bimanual manipulation tasks of RoboDojo [ 25 ] . Practicing individual tasks raises the success rate on unseen layouts from 26.4% to 84.1%, above all entries on the benchmark’s leaderboard. We also test whether the agent can accumulate knowledge across tasks via continual learning. In this setting, the agent attempts each task once, in sequence, and updates its memory representation in the course of this continual deployment. A single pass through the tasks more than doubles the success rate, to 57.6%. Learning transfers to tasks not yet attempted without erasing gains on tasks already encountered. Experience improves efficiency as well: an agent with memory uses about 35% fewer model calls in comparison to zero-shot deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了智能体从自身经验中进行少样本学习和持续学习。 我们为 AMP1 配备了持久记忆，使智能体能够在反思其成功与失败之后，记录有用的观察、策略和代码。 经验不断累积在这个记忆库中，而模型权重保持固定。 无需专家演示，也无需梯度更新。 我们在 RoboDojo [25] 的 42 个双臂操作任务上评估了该方法。 对单个任务的练习将智能体在未见布局上的成功率从 26.4% 提升至 84.1%，高于该基准排行榜上的所有成绩。 我们还测试了智能体能否通过持续学习在多个任务之间积累知识。 在这一设置中，智能体按顺序对每个任务尝试一次，并在这段持续部署过程中更新其记忆表示。 对任务进行单次遍历即可将成功率提高一倍以上，达到 57.6%。 学习能够迁移到尚未尝试的任务，同时不会抹去在已遇到任务上获得的收益。 经验还能提升效率：与零样本部署相比，拥有记忆的智能体所使用的模型调用次数减少约 35%。

sents.zh: 我们还研究了智能体从自身经验中进行少样本学习和持续学习。

sents.zh: 经验不断累积在这个记忆库中，而模型权重保持固定。

sents.en: No expert demonstrations or gradient updates are required.
sents.zh: 无需专家演示，也无需梯度更新。

sents.en: We evaluate this approach on the 42 bimanual manipulation tasks of RoboDojo [ 25 ] .
sents.zh: 我们在 RoboDojo [25] 的 42 个双臂操作任务上评估了该方法。

sents.en: Practicing individual tasks raises the success rate on unseen layouts from 26.4% to 84.1%, above all entries on the benchmark’s leaderboard.
sents.zh: 对单个任务的练习将智能体在未见布局上的成功率从 26.4% 提升至 84.1%，高于该基准排行榜上的所有成绩。

sents.en: We also test whether the agent can accumulate knowledge across tasks via continual learning.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了智能体能否通过持续学习在多个任务之间积累知识。

sents.en: In this setting, the agent attempts each task once, in sequence, and updates its memory representation in the course of this continual deployment.
sents.zh: 在这一设置中，智能体按顺序对每个任务尝试一次，并在这段持续部署过程中更新其记忆表示。

sents.en: A single pass through the tasks more than doubles the success rate, to 57.6%.
sents.zh: 对任务进行单次遍历即可将成功率提高一倍以上，达到 57.6%。

sents.en: Learning transfers to tasks not yet attempted without erasing gains on tasks already encountered.
sents.zh: 学习能够迁移到尚未尝试的任务，同时不会抹去在已遇到任务上获得的收益。

sents.en: Experience improves efficiency as well: an agent with memory uses about 35% fewer model calls in comparison to zero-shot deployment.
sents.zh: 经验还能提升效率：与零样本部署相比，拥有记忆的智能体所使用的模型调用次数减少约 35%。

paragraphs.en: We conduct controlled experiments to isolate the effects of the model, its reasoning effort, and the harness’s perception and motion interfaces. The choice of model has the largest effect. For example, AMP1’s success rate on RoboLab-120 is 82.8% with Opus 5.5, 51.6% with Haiku 5.5, and 35.2% with Opus 4.5. More reasoning helps all evaluated models. The value of additional harness support depends on the model. Weaker models are helped by assistive grasping and placing routines, while stronger models perform best without these routines. Stronger models also cope better with missing sensory information. With the AMP1 harness, Opus 5.5 achieves a success rate of 82.8% with full sensory input, 81.1% without direct depth input, and 75.8% without depth or camera calibration. While the overall success rate does not suffer much, sensory impairment takes a toll on efficiency. The agent routes around limited sensory input by reconstructing 3D points via triangulation across views and, when needed, estimates camera calibration from images taken at known gripper poses. The mean number of model calls per episode rises from 34.8 with full sensory input to 46.3 without direct depth input and 53.5 without depth or camera calibration. A weaker model cannot compensate for impoverished perception: the success rate of AMP1 with Haiku 5.5 on RoboLab-120 collapses from 51.6% with full sensory input to 10.7% without depth or camera calibration. Our experiments also indicate that replacing visual input with textual descriptions has a sharply detrimental effect, for example cutting the success rate of AMP1 with Opus 5.5 from 82.8% to 36.8%; this contrasts with prior work, which recommended replacing visual input with textual descriptions [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行受控实验，以分离模型本身、其推理投入程度以及框架的感知与运动接口所带来的影响。 模型的选择影响最大。 例如，AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 上的成功率为：使用 Opus 5.5 时为 82.8%，使用 Haiku 5.5 时为 51.6%，使用 Opus 4.5 时为 35.2%。 更多的推理投入对所有被评估的模型都有帮助。 额外框架支持的价值取决于模型。 较弱的模型会受益于辅助抓取和放置例程，而较强的模型在没有这些例程时表现最佳。 较强的模型也能更好地应对缺失的传感信息。 使用 AMP1 框架时，Opus 5.5 在完整传感输入下的成功率为 82.8%，无直接深度输入时为 81.1%，无深度输入和相机标定时为 75.8%。 虽然总体成功率没有受到太大影响，但传感能力受损仍会降低效率。 智能体通过跨视图三角化重建 3D 点来绕过有限的传感输入，并在需要时利用在已知夹爪位姿下拍摄的图像估计相机标定。 每个回合的平均模型调用次数从完整传感输入下的 34.8 次上升到无直接深度输入时的 46.3 次，以及无深度输入和相机标定时的 53.5 次。 较弱的模型无法弥补贫乏的感知：AMP1 使用 Haiku 5.5 在 RoboLab-120 上的成功率从完整传感输入下的 51.6% 骤降至无深度输入和相机标定时的 10.7%。 我们的实验还表明，用文本描述替代视觉输入会产生极为不利的影响，例如使 AMP1 使用 Opus 5.5 的成功率从 82.8% 降至 36.8%；这与先前推荐用文本描述替代视觉输入的工作 [18] 形成对比。

paragraphs.en: Our results point to agentic manipulation policies as a promising foundation for generalist manipulation. AMPs are not yet practical, as the robot spends much of each episode waiting for the model to reason. But neither are the alternatives: the strongest VLA and WAM entries on the RoboLab-120 leaderboard at the time of writing succeed in 49.2% and 42.9% of the episodes, respectively, in contrast to AMP1’s 85.6%. A policy that fails every other task is not practical, however quickly it does so. We see a more promising path in making capable policies fast. Recent studies estimate that the cost of a given capability level has fallen by roughly an order of magnitude per year [ 26 , 27 ] . A harness could further reduce waiting by reusing generated code, running feedback loops locally [ 9 , 28 , 29 ] , and planning the next motion while the current one executes [ 30 ] . AMP experience could also be used to synthesize closed-loop onboard controllers [ 29 ] or train compact models through distillation [ 11 , 31 ] . Our analysis suggests that agentic manipulation policies are substantially more general and robust than alternative paradigms, opening the way to broad deployment of generalist manipulation capabilities across hardware embodiments and application domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，智能体化操控策略有望成为通用型操控的基础。 AMP 尚不实用，因为机器人在每个回合中有大量时间都在等待模型进行推理。 但其他方案同样不实用：在撰写本文时，RoboLab-120 排行榜上最强的 VLA 和 WAM 方法的成功率分别为 49.2% 和 42.9%，而 AMP1 的成功率为 85.6%。 一个每隔一个任务就失败一次的策略，无论多快，都算不上实用。 我们认为，让强大的策略变得更快是一条更有前景的路径。 最近的研究估计，达到给定能力水平所需的成本每年大约下降一个数量级 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 一个执行框架可以通过复用已生成的代码、在本地运行反馈回路 [ 9 , 28 , 29 ] ，以及在上一个动作执行的同时规划下一个动作 [ 30 ] ，进一步减少等待时间。 AMP 的经验还可以用于合成闭环机载控制器 [ 29 ] ，或通过蒸馏训练紧凑的模型 [ 11 , 31 ] 。 我们的分析表明，智能体化操控策略相比其他范式具有显著更强的通用性和鲁棒性，为通用型操控能力在各类硬件载体和应用领域的广泛部署铺平了道路。

paragraphs.en: We chose four simulation benchmarks that facilitate comprehensive quantitative evaluation of AMP1 against the most effective learned policies and other agents ( Fig. 2 A). RoboLab-120 comprises 120 manipulation tasks specified in natural language [ 22 ] . The tasks span visual, relational, and procedural competencies; each is posed with default, vague, and specific instructions. The other three benchmarks are suites of CaP-Gym [ 18 ] : LIBERO-PRO perturbs object positions and instructions to test whether a policy generalizes beyond familiar scenes [ 32 ] ; robosuite has five unimanual and two bimanual tasks [ 33 ] ; and two tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K that require mobile manipulation in a simulated home [ 34 ] . We run 10 episodes per task on RoboLab-120 (3,600 in total across the default, vague, and specific instruction conditions), 50 on LIBERO-PRO (3,000 in total), 100 on robosuite (700), and 25 on BEHAVIOR-1K (50). The AMP1 harness is the same on all four benchmarks; only the robot description and camera configuration change. AMP1 solves every episode zero-shot: in a single attempt, without demonstrations, training, or practice rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了四个仿真基准，以便对 AMP1 与最有效的学习策略及其他智能体（agents）进行全面的定量评估（图 2 A）。 RoboLab-120 包含 120 个以自然语言指定的操作任务 [ 22 ] 。 这些任务涵盖视觉、关系和程序性能力；每个任务都配有默认、模糊和具体三种指令。 其余三个基准是 CaP-Gym [ 18 ] 的任务套件：LIBERO-PRO 通过扰动物体位置和指令来测试策略能否泛化到熟悉场景之外 [ 32 ] ；robosuite 包含五个单手机械臂任务和两个双手机械臂任务 [ 33 ] ；以及 BEHAVIOR-1K 中的两个需要在模拟家庭环境中进行移动操作的任务 [ 34 ] 。 我们在 RoboLab-120 上每个任务运行 10 个回合（在默认、模糊和具体三种指令条件下共 3,600 个回合），在 LIBERO-PRO 上运行 50 个回合（共 3,000 个回合），在 robosuite 上运行 100 个回合（700 个回合），在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上运行 25 个回合（50 个回合）。 AMP1 的框架在所有四个基准上都是相同的；只有机器人描述和相机配置发生变化。 AMP1 以零样本方式解决每一个回合：仅尝试一次，无需演示、训练或练习性试运行。

paragraphs.zh: 时域 SS 单步 MS 多步（≥ 2 \geq 2 个子任务）

paragraphs.en: Reasoning SR spatial reasoning (a relation or a left/right choice) SG semantic grounding (color or category) EX exclusion OR ordering (compare sizes, decide an order) AF affordance (an enabling action is needed before a grasp is possible) ME memory (information that is no longer visible)
paragraphs.zh: 推理 SR 空间推理（一种关系或左/右选择） SG 语义定位（颜色或类别） EX 排除 OR 排序（比较大小，确定顺序） AF 具身可供性（在抓取可行之前需要先执行一个启用动作） ME 记忆（不再可见的信息）

paragraphs.en: On RoboLab-120, AMP1 paired with Gemini 4 Argon succeeds in 85.6% of episodes (95% confidence interval, 83.5 to 87.5%), and in 82.8% when paired with Opus 5.5 (95% CI, 80.6 to 84.9%) – the highest success rates reported on the benchmark ( Fig. 2 B). The strongest entry on the RoboLab-120 public leaderboard at the time of writing is also an agent: SenseNova-RoboRSI, which is based on GPT-6 Astra [ 35 ] ; it has a 57.1% success rate. The strongest learned policy on the leaderboard, Lakeside, has a 51.0% success rate, and the strongest VLA and WAM entries are at 49.2% and 42.9%, respectively. Astranomy, an agentic manipulation policy evaluated outside the leaderboard, reaches 74.8% with GPT-6 Astra [ 21 ] . Astranomy also reported a 25.3% success rate with Opus 5.5 on a 30-task subset of RoboLab; this contrasts with the 82.8% success rate achieved by AMP1 with Opus 5.5 on the full RoboLab-120.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RoboLab-120 上，AMP1 与 Gemini 4 Argon 配对的成功率为 85.6%（95% 置信区间为 83.5% 至 87.5%），与 Opus 5.5 配对时成功率为 82.8%（95% 置信区间为 80.6% 至 84.9%）——这是该基准上已报告的最高成功率（图 2 B）。 截至撰写本文时，RoboLab-120 公开排行榜上最强的参赛者也是一个智能体：基于 GPT-6 Astra [35] 的 SenseNova-RoboRSI，其成功率为 57.1%。 排行榜上最强的学习策略 Lakeside 的成功率为 51.0%，最强的 VLA 和 WAM 参赛者分别为 49.2% 和 42.9%。 Astranomy 是一种在排行榜之外评估的智能体操作策略，使用 GPT-6 Astra 达到了 74.8% [21]。 Astranomy 还报告了在 RoboLab 的一个包含 30 个任务的子集上使用 Opus 5.5 取得的 25.3% 成功率；这与 AMP1 使用 Opus 5.5 在完整 RoboLab-120 上取得的 82.8% 成功率形成对比。

sents.zh: Astranomy 还报告了在 RoboLab 的一个包含 30 个任务的子集上使用 Opus 5.5 取得的 25.3% 成功率；这与 AMP1 使用 Opus 5.5 在完整 RoboLab-120 上取得的 82.8% 成功率形成对比。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 is robust across instruction conditions. In RoboLab’s ‘vague’ and ‘specific’ instruction conditions, AMP1 succeeds in 84.0% and 87.1% of episodes with Gemini 4 Argon, and in 79.8% and 82.8% of episodes with Opus 5.5, respectively. The success rate thus varies by about three points across the three conditions (Supplementary Section S5 and Fig. S9 ). Specialist policies are far more brittle: with vague instructions, FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] falls from 42.9% to 28.4% and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 24 ] from 28.0% to 15.2%. (Since the RoboLab-120 leaderboard does not report FLUX 3 Action performance under the ‘vague’ and ‘specific’ conditions, we evaluated it ourselves on these conditions using its publicly released checkpoint.)
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 在各种指令条件下都具有稳健性。 在 RoboLab 的「模糊」和「具体」指令条件下，AMP1 使用 Gemini 4 Argon 时分别在 84.0% 和 87.1% 的回合中成功，使用 Opus 5.5 时分别在 79.8% 和 82.8% 的回合中成功。 因此，成功率在三种条件之间的差异约为三个百分点（补充材料 S5 节和图 S9）。 专用策略则脆弱得多：在模糊指令下，FLUX 3 Action [23] 的成功率从 42.9% 降至 28.4%，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [24] 从 28.0% 降至 15.2%。 （由于 RoboLab-120 排行榜未报告 FLUX 3 Action 在「模糊」和「具体」条件下的表现，我们使用其公开发布的检查点自行在这两种条件下进行了评估。）

paragraphs.en: AMP1’s success rate on RoboLab-120 approaches saturation, with the remaining failures bounded largely by benchmark artifacts rather than policy errors (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S6 , and Fig. S10 ). Across the 1,200 trials in the ‘default’ instruction condition, 121 of the 173 unsuccessful episodes with Gemini 4 Argon and 135 of the 206 unsuccessful episodes with Opus 5.5 can be traced to issues with the benchmark setup: either the object’s geometry or mass defeats a standard parallel-jaw grasp (77 and 101 episodes, respectively) or a flaky verifier rejects an end state that satisfies the instruction (44 and 34 episodes). Only two tasks fail all 10 trials for both models; the remaining affected tasks still succeed in about half of their trials when a placement happens to satisfy the verifier’s geometric check or when AMP1 improvises a non-standard grasp ( Sec. 2B ). Across the 95 tasks that do not suffer from these benchmark artifacts, AMP1 with Gemini 4 Argon succeeds in 96.2% of episodes (914 of 950).
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 上的成功率已接近饱和，其余失败很大程度上受限于基准测试本身的缺陷，而非策略错误（补充材料，第 S6 节，以及图 S10）。 在「默认」指令条件下的 1,200 次试验中，使用 Gemini 4 Argon 的 173 次失败回合中有 121 次、使用 Opus 5.5 的 206 次失败回合中有 135 次可归因于基准测试设置的问题：要么是物体的几何形状或质量使标准的平行夹爪抓取失效（分别为 77 次和 101 次回合），要么是不稳定的验证器拒绝了满足指令的最终状态（分别为 44 次和 34 次回合）。 只有两个任务在两个模型的所有 10 次试验中均失败；其余受影响的任务在摆放恰好满足验证器的几何检查、或 AMP1 即兴采用非标准抓取方式时，仍能在大约一半的试验中成功（第 2B 节）。 在不受这些基准测试缺陷影响的 95 个任务中，采用 Gemini 4 Argon 的 AMP1 在 96.2% 的回合中成功（950 次中的 914 次）。

sents.en: AMP1’s success rate on RoboLab-120 approaches saturation, with the remaining failures bounded largely by benchmark artifacts rather than policy errors (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S6 , and Fig. S10 ).

paragraphs.en: On CaP-Gym, the strongest agent baselines – HarnessPAI [ 12 ] , ASPIRE [ 36 ] , and Harness VLA [ 37 ] – all involve improving a program, a skill library, or a memory representation over rollouts of the evaluated tasks and are thus not zero-shot. In contrast, AMP1 solves every episode zero-shot, using the same harness in CaP-Gym as in RoboLab ( Fig. 2 C–E).
paragraphs.zh: 在 CaP-Gym 上，最强的智能体基线——HarnessPAI [ 12 ] 、ASPIRE [ 36 ] 和 Harness VLA [ 37 ] ——都涉及在被评估任务的多次轮次中改进程序、技能库或记忆表示，因此都不是零样本的。 相比之下，AMP1 以零样本方式解决每一个回合，在 CaP-Gym 中使用的框架与在 RoboLab 中相同（图 2 C–E）。

paragraphs.en: On the LIBERO-PRO subset of CaP-Gym, AMP1 with Gemini 4 Argon succeeds in 95.2% of episodes, against 18.2% for CaP-Agent0 [ 18 ] , the only other zero-shot agent, and 34.9% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , a fine-tuned VLA [ 24 ] . Only HarnessPAI [ 12 ] , which evolves its program on seeds that lie inside the evaluation, scores higher (96.5%). Its lead comes entirely from LIBERO-Goal (94.6% and 97.8% against 81.4% and 91.4% under swap and task perturbations, respectively), while AMP1 is ahead on LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial. In almost all of the unsuccessful LIBERO-Goal episodes, AMP1 ended the episode believing it had succeeded. The instructions do not say what LIBERO checks, such as which side of the stove counts as its front or how far a drawer must open, and a human review of the episodes marked as failures suggests that AMP1 interpreted the instructions in a way that is consistent with human interpretation but inconsistent with the verifier implemented by the benchmark. HarnessPAI utilizes a VLA that was fine-tuned on LIBERO demonstrations that succeed according to the implemented verifier, thus leaking the verifier’s implementation into the training data.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CaP-Gym 的 LIBERO-PRO 子集上，配备 Gemini 4 Argon 的 AMP1 在 95.2% 的回合中成功，而 CaP-Agent0 [18]（唯一另一个零样本智能体）为 18.2%，经过微调的 VLA π_{0.5} [24] 为 34.9%。 只有 HarnessPAI [12] 得分更高（96.5%），它在位于评估范围内的种子上演化其程序。 它的领先完全来自 LIBERO-Goal（在交换扰动和任务扰动下分别为 94.6% 和 97.8%，而对手为 81.4% 和 91.4%），而 AMP1 在 LIBERO-Object 和 LIBERO-Spatial 上领先。 在几乎所有的 LIBERO-Goal 失败回合中，AMP1 都是在认为自己已经成功的情况下结束了回合。 指令并未说明 LIBERO 检查什么，例如灶台的哪一侧算作正面，或者抽屉必须打开多远，而对被标记为失败的回合的人工审查表明，AMP1 对指令的解释与人类解释一致，但与基准实现的验证器不一致。 HarnessPAI 使用了一个在 LIBERO 演示数据上微调的 VLA，而这些演示数据是根据已实现的验证器判定为成功的，从而将验证器的实现泄露到了训练数据中。

paragraphs.en: On the robosuite subset of CaP-Gym, AMP1 paired with Gemini 4 Argon succeeds in all 700 episodes, including the two tasks that require coordinating two arms, against 96.3% for HarnessPAI [ 12 ] and 82.6% for programs written and debugged by human experts [ 18 ] . On the two BEHAVIOR-1K tasks in CaP-Gym, AMP1 succeeds in 48 of 50 episodes (96%), against 64% for CaP-Agent0 and 54% for human-written programs [ 18 ] ; only ASPIRE [ 36 ] , which evolves its programs over rollouts of the same task (and is thus not zero-shot), succeeds in every episode.

paragraphs.en: AMP1’s strong performance on benchmarks is matched in zero-shot trials on real-world hardware. We provide quantitative and qualitative results from diverse real-world manipulation tasks. All real-world experiments were conducted using a 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm equipped with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper and a three-camera vision system similar to DROID [ 38 ] (left and right shoulder views, plus a wrist-mounted camera). The AMP1 harness was paired with Claude Opus 5.5 at high reasoning effort. The results are reported in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 在基准测试中的强大表现，在真实硬件上的零样本试验中也得到了印证。 我们提供了来自多样化真实世界操作任务的定量与定性结果。 所有真实世界实验均使用一台 7 自由度的 Franka Research 3 机械臂进行，该机械臂配备 Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪以及一个类似于 DROID [ 38 ] 的三相机视觉系统（左肩视角、右肩视角，外加一个腕部安装的相机）。 AMP1 硬件系统与高推理强度的 Claude Opus 5.5 配对使用。 结果报告于表 1 中。

paragraphs.en: We designed 12 challenging short- and long-horizon manipulation tasks and evaluated AMP1 against leading VLA and WAM policies, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and FLUX 3 Action [ 24 , 23 ] . The tasks cover a broad range of capabilities, including prehensile and non-prehensile manipulation, spatial and temporal reasoning, semantic grounding, and object exclusion. We include both single- and multi-step tasks, the latter containing two or more subtasks. The results of the real-world trials are presented in Table 1 . Further details of our experimental setup and evaluation protocols are provided in Sec. 4F . All tasks are illustrated in the Supplementary Materials ( Fig. S2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了 12 个具有挑战性的短时程与长时程操作任务，并将 AMP1 与领先的 VLA 和 WAM 策略 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 及 FLUX 3 Action [ 24 , 23 ] 进行了评估比较。 这些任务涵盖广泛的能力，包括抓取性与非抓取性操作、空间与时间推理、语义接地以及物体排除。 我们同时纳入了单步和多步任务，后者包含两个或更多子任务。 真实世界试验的结果见表 1 。 我们实验设置与评估协议的更多细节见第 4F 节。 所有任务均展示于补充材料中（图 S2 ）。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 matches or outperforms the baselines on all 12 tasks. It particularly excels in scenarios that require object identification in crowded settings or complex manipulation strategies, such as non-prehensile interaction. Overall, AMP1 achieves a 96.3% success rate, compared to 45.4% for FLUX and 27.8% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . Baseline methods struggle to accurately identify target objects and frequently grasp incorrect objects, including those explicitly excluded by the task prompt. For example, when instructed to “Put all the tools except the hammer in the right bin”, both baselines still occasionally grasp the excluded object.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 在全部 12 项任务上与基线持平或表现更优。 它在需要于拥挤环境中识别物体或采用复杂操作策略（如非抓取式交互）的场景中尤为出色。 总体而言，AMP1 的成功率为 96.3%，相比之下 FLUX 为 45.4%，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 为 27.8%。 基线方法难以准确识别目标物体，经常抓取错误的物体，包括任务提示中明确排除的物体。 例如，当被指示“把除锤子以外的所有工具放进右边的箱子”时，两个基线方法仍偶尔会抓取被排除的物体。

sents.en: AMP1 matches or outperforms the baselines on all 12 tasks.
sents.zh: AMP1 在全部 12 项任务上与基线持平或表现更优。

sents.en: It particularly excels in scenarios that require object identification in crowded settings or complex manipulation strategies, such as non-prehensile interaction.
sents.zh: 它在需要于拥挤环境中识别物体或采用复杂操作策略（如非抓取式交互）的场景中尤为出色。

sents.en: Overall, AMP1 achieves a 96.3% success rate, compared to 45.4% for FLUX and 27.8% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} .
sents.zh: 总体而言，AMP1 的成功率为 96.3%，相比之下 FLUX 为 45.4%，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 为 27.8%。

sents.en: Baseline methods struggle to accurately identify target objects and frequently grasp incorrect objects, including those explicitly excluded by the task prompt.
sents.zh: 基线方法难以准确识别目标物体，经常抓取错误的物体，包括任务提示中明确排除的物体。

sents.en: For example, when instructed to “Put all the tools except the hammer in the right bin”, both baselines still occasionally grasp the excluded object.
sents.zh: 例如，当被指示“把除锤子以外的所有工具放进右边的箱子”时，两个基线方法仍偶尔会抓取被排除的物体。

paragraphs.en: Most real-world struggles of AMP1 are caused by collision, mainly with the surface of the table, the walls of the bin, and self-collision. These collisions occur because the underlying motion planning is sensitive to camera calibration and relies on approximations including simplified robot geometry and unmodeled hardware such as camera mounts and cables. Collisions can trigger the Franka controller’s collision reflex, which interrupts motion when estimated external forces or torques exceed configured thresholds. The resulting error must be cleared before commanded motion can resume. We provide SDK functions through which the agent can query the arm’s state and request error recovery. Following successful recovery, the agent can replan and continue the task. With this functionality, AMP1 fails in only 4 out of 108 trials. (In two, some cubes fell outside the target plate during pouring. In the other two, a bowl rolled off the table.) Without these functions, our evaluation protocol terminates a trial when a robot controller error interrupts motion; in this condition, AMP1 succeeds in 94 of 108 trials (87.0%; Tab. S1 ).
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 在真实世界中的大多数失败都是由碰撞引起的，主要发生在与桌面、收纳箱箱壁的碰撞以及自身碰撞上。 这些碰撞之所以发生，是因为底层运动规划对相机标定十分敏感，并依赖于多种近似处理，包括简化的机器人几何模型以及未被建模的硬件（如相机支架和线缆）。 碰撞可能触发 Franka 控制器的碰撞反射机制，当估计的外部力或力矩超过配置的阈值时，该机制会中断运动。 在恢复指令运动之前，必须先清除由此产生的错误。 我们提供了 SDK 函数，智能体可以通过这些函数查询机械臂的状态并请求错误恢复。 在成功恢复之后，智能体可以重新规划并继续执行任务。 借助这一功能，AMP1 在 108 次试验中仅在 4 次中失败。 （其中两次是在倾倒过程中一些立方体掉出了目标托盘。 另外两次是一个碗滚出了桌面。）如果没有这些功能，我们的评估协议会在机器人控制器错误中断运动时终止该次试验；在此条件下，AMP1 在 108 次试验中成功 94 次（87.0%；表 S1）。

paragraphs.en: A primary advantage of AMP1 is its capacity for dynamic error recovery and replanning as the task unfolds. For instance, for a task that requires moving a flipped bowl placed on top of a flat bin, where no initial feasible grasp exists, AMP1 recognizes that a direct grasp is infeasible and pushes the bowl to hang from the side of the bin where it can be grasped, thus combining non-prehensile and prehensile techniques ( Fig. S3 A). In contrast, baseline methods often continue pursuing hard or infeasible strategies (e.g., an intractable grasp) until the episode times out. Furthermore, for tasks that require complex semantic understanding, such as covering and uncovering multiple cubes with cups, the baseline methods perform inconsistent actions indicative of challenges with task comprehension. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} is particularly prone to exhibiting indecisive behavior, repeatedly grasping and dropping a correctly identified target object without completing the placement.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 的一个主要优势在于它能够在任务展开过程中进行动态的错误恢复与重新规划。 例如，对于一项需要移动放在扁平收纳箱顶部的翻转碗的任务，由于初始不存在可行的抓取，AMP1 会识别出直接抓取不可行，并将碗推到悬挂在收纳箱侧边从而可被抓住的位置，由此结合了非抓握与抓握技术（图 S3 A）。 相比之下，基线方法往往会继续执行困难或不可行的策略（例如难以实现的抓取），直到回合超时。 此外，对于需要复杂语义理解的任务，例如用杯子盖住和揭开多个立方体，基线方法会执行不一致的动作，表明其在任务理解方面存在困难。π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 尤其容易表现出犹豫不决的行为，反复抓起又放下一个被正确识别的目标物体，而未能完成放置。

paragraphs.en: A number of case studies, documented in Fig. 1 and the supplementary video, demonstrate that AMP1 can generalize zero-shot to even more complex tasks that require sequential dependency planning via interactive perception: manipulating the environment to uncover and subsequently manipulate hidden objects ( Fig. 1 A), devising effective tool-use strategies ( Fig. 1 B), reasoning through and physically executing a winning strategy in a game of chess followed by putting away the pieces (Fig. 1 C), pushing or sliding to reveal occluded grasps ( Fig. 1 D), and manipulating articulated objects ( Fig. 1 E).
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 和补充视频中记录的一系列案例研究表明，AMP1 能够零样本泛化到更加复杂的任务，这些任务需要通过交互式感知进行顺序依赖规划：操纵环境以发现并随后操纵隐藏的物体（图 1 A）、设计有效的工具使用策略（图 1 B）、在象棋对局中进行推理并实际执行获胜策略，随后将棋子收好（图 1 C）、通过推动或滑动以显露出被遮挡的抓取点（图 1 D），以及操纵铰接物体（图 1 E）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond aggregate task performance, we examine the manipulation strategies developed by AMP1 during execution. None of the behaviors described below was specified in the prompt or provided as a predefined skill in the harness. The agent develops these strategies while solving tasks, combining geometric reasoning, visual feedback, and physical interaction to construct higher-level manipulation skills. We highlight several examples, some of which are shown in Fig. 3 and the supplementary video.
paragraphs.zh: 除了总体任务表现之外，我们还考察了AMP1在执行过程中发展出的操作策略。 下文描述的这些行为均未在提示中指定，也未作为预定义技能在框架中提供。 该智能体在解决任务的过程中发展出这些策略，结合几何推理、视觉反馈和物理交互来构建更高层次的操作技能。 我们重点展示几个例子，其中一些如图3和补充视频所示。

sents.en: Beyond aggregate task performance, we examine the manipulation strategies developed by AMP1 during execution.
sents.zh: 除了总体任务表现之外，我们还考察了AMP1在执行过程中发展出的操作策略。

sents.zh: 下文描述的这些行为均未在提示中指定，也未作为预定义技能在框架中提供。

sents.zh: 该智能体在解决任务的过程中发展出这些策略，结合几何推理、视觉反馈和物理交互来构建更高层次的操作技能。

sents.en: We highlight several examples, some of which are shown in Fig. 3 and the supplementary video.
sents.zh: 我们重点展示几个例子，其中一些如图3和补充视频所示。

paragraphs.en: When the instructed object is not visible from any camera, AMP1 does not stop at what it sees. It reasons about which objects are large enough to hide the target, moves them aside one at a time, and looks again after each move until the target appears ( Fig. 3 A). The robotics literature calls this mechanical search [ 39 ] , a form of interactive perception [ 40 ] : the agent acts to gain information, not only to make progress on the task.
paragraphs.zh: 当被指令的目标物体在任何摄像头视野中都不可见时，AMP1 不会停留在眼前所见。 它会推理哪些物体大到足以遮挡目标，将其逐一移开，并在每次移动后再次观察，直到目标出现（图 3 A）。 机器人学文献将此称为机械搜索 [ 39 ] ，它是交互式感知 [ 40 ] 的一种形式：智能体通过行动来获取信息，而不仅是推进任务。

sents.en: When the instructed object is not visible from any camera, AMP1 does not stop at what it sees.
sents.zh: 当被指令的目标物体在任何摄像头视野中都不可见时，AMP1 不会停留在眼前所见。

sents.en: It reasons about which objects are large enough to hide the target, moves them aside one at a time, and looks again after each move until the target appears ( Fig. 3 A).
sents.zh: 它会推理哪些物体大到足以遮挡目标，将其逐一移开，并在每次移动后再次观察，直到目标出现（图 3 A）。

sents.zh: 机器人学文献将此称为机械搜索 [ 39 ] ，它是交互式感知 [ 40 ] 的一种形式：智能体通过行动来获取信息，而不仅是推进任务。

paragraphs.en: When an object cannot be grasped, AMP1 sometimes brings the goal to the object instead. In one task, “Put the bowl on the plate”, the bowl lay upside down on a bin, too wide for the gripper and with no edge the fingers could reach under ( Fig. 3 B). AMP1 instead grasped the plate by its rim and slid it up against the side of the bin, then pushed the bowl across the bin with the open gripper until it fell off the edge onto the plate. The bowl was never held: it reached its goal by non-prehensile manipulation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 当物体无法被直接抓取时，AMP1 有时会将目标物体带到该物体处。 在一个「把碗放到盘子上」的任务中，碗倒扣在一个箱子上，宽度超出了夹爪的范围，且手指没有边缘可以伸到其下方（图 3 B）。 AMP1 转而抓住盘子的边缘，将其向上滑动抵住箱子的一侧，然后用张开的夹爪把碗在箱子上推过去，直到碗从边缘掉落到盘子上。 碗从未被握持过：它仅通过非抓取式操控就达到了目标。

sents.zh: 当物体无法被直接抓取时，AMP1 有时会将目标物体带到该物体处。

sents.en: In one task, “Put the bowl on the plate”, the bowl lay upside down on a bin, too wide for the gripper and with no edge the fingers could reach under ( Fig. 3 B).

paragraphs.en: In some cases in which an object lies beyond the arm’s reach, AMP1 can use another item in the scene as a tool. It first establishes from inverse kinematics that the object is out of reach, and by how much. It then searches the scene for a tool long enough to cover that distance and reasons about how to use it to apply force, for example pulling rather than pushing so that the object moves toward the arm ( Fig. 3 C). Once the object is within reach, it sets the tool aside and grasps the object directly. None of this is described in the prompt, suggesting that AMP1 can at times improvise tool use from its understanding of geometry and contact. This strategy parallels tool selection in New Caledonian crows, which choose sticks long enough to retrieve otherwise inaccessible food [ 41 ] , and has precedents in robotics [ 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在某些物体超出机械臂触及范围的情况下，AMP1 可以使用场景中的另一件物品作为工具。 它首先通过逆运动学确定该物体超出触及范围，以及超出的距离。 然后它在场景中搜索一件足够长、能够覆盖该距离的工具，并推理如何用它施加力，例如采用拉而非推的方式，使物体朝机械臂方向移动（图 3 C）。 一旦物体进入触及范围，它便将工具放到一边，直接抓取该物体。 这些内容均未在提示中描述，这表明 AMP1 有时能够凭借其对几何和接触的理解即兴进行工具使用。 这一策略与新喀里多尼亚乌鸦的工具选择行为相似，后者会选择足够长的树枝来获取原本无法触及的食物 [41]，并且在机器人学中也有先例 [42]。

paragraphs.en: When an object, such as a large pomegranate, is wider than the gripper’s 85-mm stroke in every direction, AMP1 sometimes pins it against a heavier object so that it cannot roll or slide away ( Fig. 3 D). It then slides the open gripper beneath it and lifts it like a forklift to carry it to the goal. Like pushing an object to the table edge, this strategy exploits contact with the environment to achieve a grasp the gripper cannot achieve alone, a capability known as extrinsic dexterity [ 43 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当一个物体（例如一个大石榴）在任何方向上都比夹爪85毫米的行程更宽时，AMP1有时会把它抵在一个更重的物体上，使其无法滚动或滑走（图3D）。 然后，它将张开的夹爪滑到物体下方，像叉车一样将其抬起并运送到目标位置。 类似于把物体推到桌子边缘，这一策略利用与环境的接触来实现夹爪自身无法完成的抓取，这种能力被称为外在灵巧性[43]。

paragraphs.en: When an object is too wide to grasp where it lies, AMP1 pushes it toward the edge of its supporting surface until part of it overhangs, giving the gripper a narrower part to hold ( Fig. S3 A). When objects stand too close together to grasp one at a time, it pushes them apart ( Fig. S3 B). In both cases, AMP1 treats the scene as something it can rearrange rather than a fixed input: when no grasp is feasible, it first acts to create one, a strategy known as pre-grasp manipulation [ 44 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当物体太宽而无法在原位置抓取时，AMP1 会将其推向支撑面的边缘，直到物体一部分悬空，从而为夹爪提供一个更窄的可抓取部位（图 S3 A）。 当物体之间靠得太近而无法逐一抓取时，智能体会将它们推开（图 S3 B）。 在这两种情况下，AMP1 都将场景视为可以重新排布的对象，而非固定不变的输入：当没有可行的抓取时，它会先采取动作创造可行的抓取条件，这种策略被称为抓取前操作 [44]。

sents.zh: 当物体之间靠得太近而无法逐一抓取时，智能体会将它们推开（图 S3 B）。

sents.en: In both cases, AMP1 treats the scene as something it can rearrange rather than a fixed input: when no grasp is feasible, it first acts to create one, a strategy known as pre-grasp manipulation [ 44 ] .
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，AMP1 都将场景视为可以重新排布的对象，而非固定不变的输入：当没有可行的抓取时，它会先采取动作创造可行的抓取条件，这种策略被称为抓取前操作 [44]。

paragraphs.en: On the physical robot, camera calibration is imperfect, and the resulting errors in estimated poses can be too large for precise manipulation. When a motion misses its target, AMP1 compares where the gripper appears in the images with where it was commanded to go, attributes the offset to the calibration and corrects it ( Fig. S3 C). It then uses the corrected calibration for the rest of the episode. The same reasoning lets it calibrate the wrist camera from scratch when no calibration is given (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在实体机器人上，相机标定并不完美，由此产生的位姿估计误差可能过大，无法满足精确操作的需要。 当某次运动未命中目标时，AMP1 会将夹爪在图像中呈现的位置与其被指令前往的位置进行比较，将偏移归因于标定误差并加以修正（图 S3 C）。 随后，它会将修正后的标定用于本回合的其余过程。 同样的推理机制使其能在未提供标定的情况下从头标定腕部相机（补充材料，第 S4.1 节）。

sents.en: On the physical robot, camera calibration is imperfect, and the resulting errors in estimated poses can be too large for precise manipulation.
sents.zh: 在实体机器人上，相机标定并不完美，由此产生的位姿估计误差可能过大，无法满足精确操作的需要。

sents.en: When a motion misses its target, AMP1 compares where the gripper appears in the images with where it was commanded to go, attributes the offset to the calibration and corrects it ( Fig. S3 C).
sents.zh: 当某次运动未命中目标时，AMP1 会将夹爪在图像中呈现的位置与其被指令前往的位置进行比较，将偏移归因于标定误差并加以修正（图 S3 C）。

sents.en: It then uses the corrected calibration for the rest of the episode.
sents.zh: 随后，它会将修正后的标定用于本回合的其余过程。

sents.en: The same reasoning lets it calibrate the wrist camera from scratch when no calibration is given (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S4.1 ).
sents.zh: 同样的推理机制使其能在未提供标定的情况下从头标定腕部相机（补充材料，第 S4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: When placing a long object, AMP1 first rests one end on the surface, then lowers the other along an arc ( Fig. S3 D). This strategy uses surface contact to support the object during lowering, suggesting reasoning about contact and the physical consequences of the placement motion.
paragraphs.zh: 在放置长物体时，AMP1 先将一端放置在表面上，然后沿弧线放下另一端（图 S3 D）。 这一策略利用表面接触来支撑物体进行放下，表明智能体对接触以及放置动作的物理后果进行了推理。

sents.en: When placing a long object, AMP1 first rests one end on the surface, then lowers the other along an arc ( Fig. S3 D).
sents.zh: 在放置长物体时，AMP1 先将一端放置在表面上，然后沿弧线放下另一端（图 S3 D）。

sents.en: This strategy uses surface contact to support the object during lowering, suggesting reasoning about contact and the physical consequences of the placement motion.
sents.zh: 这一策略利用表面接触来支撑物体进行放下，表明智能体对接触以及放置动作的物理后果进行了推理。

paragraphs.en: For objects lying on their side, AMP1 sometimes closes the gripper, inserts the closed fingers into the object’s opening, and uses them as a hook while moving the gripper along an arc until the object stands upright ( Fig. S4 A). For objects placed upside down, it first grasps an outer feature to tip the object onto its side, then hooks and pivots it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于侧放的物体，AMP1 有时会闭合夹爪，将闭合的手指插入物体的开口中，在沿弧线移动夹爪的同时将其用作钩子，直到物体直立起来（图 S4 A）。 对于倒置放置的物体，它首先抓取外部特征将物体翻倒至侧放，然后钩住并旋转它。

sents.en: For objects lying on their side, AMP1 sometimes closes the gripper, inserts the closed fingers into the object’s opening, and uses them as a hook while moving the gripper along an arc until the object stands upright ( Fig. S4 A).
sents.zh: 对于侧放的物体，AMP1 有时会闭合夹爪，将闭合的手指插入物体的开口中，在沿弧线移动夹爪的同时将其用作钩子，直到物体直立起来（图 S4 A）。

sents.en: For objects placed upside down, it first grasps an outer feature to tip the object onto its side, then hooks and pivots it.
sents.zh: 对于倒置放置的物体，它首先抓取外部特征将物体翻倒至侧放，然后钩住并旋转它。

paragraphs.en: In one task, AMP1 must place an object on a shelf whose top is not visible from any camera, so that part of the shelf is missing from its point cloud. Its first placement motion fails when the arm is blocked by this unseen geometry. From the gap between the commanded and reached end-effector poses, AMP1 infers that an upper shelf lies just outside its field of view, assumes it sits at the edge of the visible region to leave a safety margin, and adjusts its grasp and approach angle accordingly ( Fig. S4 B). AMP1 thus treats a failed action as a measurement, using physical interaction to recover information its cameras cannot provide. Together with its behavior in the wrist-camera setting ( Sec. 2D.3 ), where it moves the arm back to see more of the scene, this suggests that AMP1 uses action as a source of information, not only as a means of changing the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项任务中，AMP1 必须将一个物体放到一个顶部在任何相机视角下都不可见的架子上，因此该架子的一部分在其点云中缺失。 它的第一次放置动作失败了，因为机械臂被这一不可见的几何结构挡住。 从指令位姿与实际到达的末端执行器位姿之间的差距中，AMP1 推断出一个上层架子恰好位于其视野之外，于是假设它位于可见区域的边缘以留出安全余量，并相应地调整抓取和接近角度（图 S4 B）。 因此，AMP1 将一次失败的动作当作一次测量，利用物理交互来恢复其相机无法提供的信息。 结合它在腕部相机设置中的行为（第 2D.3 节）——即移动机械臂以便看到更多场景——这表明 AMP1 把动作作为一种信息来源，而不仅仅是改变场景的手段。

sents.zh: 在一项任务中，AMP1 必须将一个物体放到一个顶部在任何相机视角下都不可见的架子上，因此该架子的一部分在其点云中缺失。

sents.en: Together with its behavior in the wrist-camera setting ( Sec. 2D.3 ), where it moves the arm back to see more of the scene, this suggests that AMP1 uses action as a source of information, not only as a means of changing the scene.

paragraphs.en: Through interaction with the environment, AMP1 discovers that friction-based grasps are brittle for heavy objects and prone to slippage. When the object’s geometry allows it, AMP1 switches to a mechanical interlocking grasp. For example, to lift a heavy drill, instead of grasping it from the top, it closes the fingers around the top of the handle, just below the drill’s head ( Fig. S4 C). Upon lifting, the head rests on the fingers, which yields an inherently stable grip that does not depend on friction.
paragraphs.zh: 通过与环境的交互，AMP1 发现基于摩擦的抓取对于重物较为脆弱，且容易打滑。 当物体几何形状允许时，AMP1 会切换到机械互锁式抓取。 例如，在提起一把沉重的电钻时，它不是从顶部抓取，而是将手指合拢在手柄顶部、钻头正下方的位置（图 S4 C）。 提起后，钻头靠在手指上，从而形成一种本质上稳定、不依赖摩擦的抓握。

sents.en: Through interaction with the environment, AMP1 discovers that friction-based grasps are brittle for heavy objects and prone to slippage.
sents.zh: 通过与环境的交互，AMP1 发现基于摩擦的抓取对于重物较为脆弱，且容易打滑。

sents.en: When the object’s geometry allows it, AMP1 switches to a mechanical interlocking grasp.
sents.zh: 当物体几何形状允许时，AMP1 会切换到机械互锁式抓取。

sents.zh: 提起后，钻头靠在手指上，从而形成一种本质上稳定、不依赖摩擦的抓握。

paragraphs.en: Beyond these examples, we measured how often AMP1 composes the same building blocks across many tasks ( Fig. 3 E). We matched the code AMP1 executed and the intentions stated in its reasoning, in 1,200 RoboLab episodes, against a set of skill patterns, and report a pattern as a skill only if it recurs (a) in at least five episodes and (b) in at least two tasks; the first condition excludes rare improvisations and spurious matches, and the second excludes procedures that serve a single task. Because the harness provides no grasping, placing, or pushing primitives ( Sec. 4A.3 ), AMP1 builds these skills itself, anew in each episode ( Fig. 3 E). (These statistics are reported for AMP1 paired with Opus 5.5.) The most frequent skills are routine geometric habits: AMP1 measures a container before placing into it in 66% of episodes, aligns its grasp with the object’s axes in 61%, and reasons about an object’s long and short axes in 47%. When the harness rejects a proposed motion, AMP1 reads the reason and repairs the plan (40% of episodes). When a motion fails during execution, it diagnoses the cause before replanning (39%).
paragraphs.zh: 除这些示例之外，我们还测量了 AMP1 在许多任务中组合相同构建块的频率（图 3E）。 我们将 AMP1 在 1,200 个 RoboLab 回合中执行的代码与其推理中陈述的意图，与一组技能模式进行匹配，只有当某个模式（a）至少在五个回合中且（b）至少在两个任务中重复出现时，才将其报告为技能；第一个条件排除了罕见的即兴发挥和虚假匹配，第二个条件排除了仅服务于单一任务的程序。 由于测试环境不提供抓取、放置或推动的原语（第 4A.3 节），AMP1 自己构建这些技能，并在每个回合中重新构建（图 3E）。 （这些统计数据显示的是 AMP1 与 Opus 5.5 搭配使用的结果。）最频繁的技能是常规的几何习惯：AMP1 在 66% 的回合中在放入容器之前先测量容器，在 61% 的回合中使抓取与物体的轴线对齐，在 47% 的回合中对物体的长轴和短轴进行推理。 当测试环境拒绝某个提议的运动时，AMP1 会读取原因并修复计划（40% 的回合）。 当某个运动在执行过程中失败时，它会先诊断原因再重新规划（39%）。

sents.en: Beyond these examples, we measured how often AMP1 composes the same building blocks across many tasks ( Fig. 3 E).
sents.zh: 除这些示例之外，我们还测量了 AMP1 在许多任务中组合相同构建块的频率（图 3E）。

sents.en: We matched the code AMP1 executed and the intentions stated in its reasoning, in 1,200 RoboLab episodes, against a set of skill patterns, and report a pattern as a skill only if it recurs (a) in at least five episodes and (b) in at least two tasks; the first condition excludes rare improvisations and spurious matches, and the second excludes procedures that serve a single task.

sents.zh: 由于测试环境不提供抓取、放置或推动的原语（第 4A.3 节），AMP1 自己构建这些技能，并在每个回合中重新构建（图 3E）。

sents.en: (These statistics are reported for AMP1 paired with Opus 5.5.) The most frequent skills are routine geometric habits: AMP1 measures a container before placing into it in 66% of episodes, aligns its grasp with the object’s axes in 61%, and reasons about an object’s long and short axes in 47%.
sents.zh: （这些统计数据显示的是 AMP1 与 Opus 5.5 搭配使用的结果。）最频繁的技能是常规的几何习惯：AMP1 在 66% 的回合中在放入容器之前先测量容器，在 61% 的回合中使抓取与物体的轴线对齐，在 47% 的回合中对物体的长轴和短轴进行推理。

sents.zh: 当测试环境拒绝某个提议的运动时，AMP1 会读取原因并修复计划（40% 的回合）。

sents.zh: 当某个运动在执行过程中失败时，它会先诊断原因再重新规划（39%）。

paragraphs.en: Together, these observations suggest that AMP1 can synthesize manipulation skills from the perception and control interfaces it is given, adapting its strategies to object geometry, execution failures, and contact constraints. Since these behaviors were neither specified in the prompt nor supplied as predefined skills, they provide qualitative evidence that code generation enables the agent to translate its reasoning into task-specific manipulation procedures. Many such skills recur across RoboLab-120 episodes ( Tab. S2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些观察结果表明 AMP1 能够从其被赋予的感知与控制接口中合成操作技能，并根据物体几何形状、执行失败情况和接触约束调整其策略。 由于这些行为既未在提示中指定，也未作为预定义技能提供，它们提供了定性证据，表明代码生成使智能体能够将其推理转化为任务特定的操作过程。 许多此类技能在 RoboLab-120 的各个回合中反复出现（表 S2）。

sents.en: Together, these observations suggest that AMP1 can synthesize manipulation skills from the perception and control interfaces it is given, adapting its strategies to object geometry, execution failures, and contact constraints.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些观察结果表明 AMP1 能够从其被赋予的感知与控制接口中合成操作技能，并根据物体几何形状、执行失败情况和接触约束调整其策略。

sents.en: Since these behaviors were neither specified in the prompt nor supplied as predefined skills, they provide qualitative evidence that code generation enables the agent to translate its reasoning into task-specific manipulation procedures.
sents.zh: 由于这些行为既未在提示中指定，也未作为预定义技能提供，它们提供了定性证据，表明代码生成使智能体能够将其推理转化为任务特定的操作过程。

sents.en: Many such skills recur across RoboLab-120 episodes ( Tab. S2 ).
sents.zh: 许多此类技能在 RoboLab-120 的各个回合中反复出现（表 S2）。

paragraphs.en: Thus far, the agent has been evaluated zero-shot, starting every episode from scratch with no memory of its past experience. In the field, however, a robot may be able to build on its experience. We therefore investigate whether the agent can improve with experience, both within a task via few-shot learning and across tasks via continual learning. In the few-shot setting, the agent practices on the same task with resets. In the continual setting, it learns across different tasks as it tackles them in sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，该智能体一直是零样本评估的，每一轮都从零开始，对其过去的经验没有任何记忆。 然而在实际应用中，机器人可以基于其以往的经验进行积累。 因此我们研究该智能体能否随着经验而提升，包括通过少样本学习在同一任务内提升，以及通过持续学习跨任务提升。 在少样本设置中，智能体通过重置在同一任务上进行练习。 在持续设置中，它按顺序处理不同任务并从中学习。

sents.en: Thus far, the agent has been evaluated zero-shot, starting every episode from scratch with no memory of its past experience.
sents.zh: 到目前为止，该智能体一直是零样本评估的，每一轮都从零开始，对其过去的经验没有任何记忆。

sents.en: In the field, however, a robot may be able to build on its experience.
sents.zh: 然而在实际应用中，机器人可以基于其以往的经验进行积累。

sents.en: We therefore investigate whether the agent can improve with experience, both within a task via few-shot learning and across tasks via continual learning.
sents.zh: 因此我们研究该智能体能否随着经验而提升，包括通过少样本学习在同一任务内提升，以及通过持续学习跨任务提升。

sents.en: In the few-shot setting, the agent practices on the same task with resets.
sents.zh: 在少样本设置中，智能体通过重置在同一任务上进行练习。

sents.en: In the continual setting, it learns across different tasks as it tackles them in sequence.
sents.zh: 在持续设置中，它按顺序处理不同任务并从中学习。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate learning from experience on RoboDojo [ 25 ] , a challenging benchmark that comprises 42 simulated bimanual manipulation tasks across five capability dimensions ( Sec. 4E ). RoboDojo provides many layouts per task, so a given task can be practiced on certain scenes and tested on others. Unlike in RoboLab-120, the agent receives only RGB images, without depth or camera calibration. While AMP1 approaches saturation on RoboLab-120 zero-shot ( Sec. 2A.1 ), RoboDojo leaves ample headroom for learning from experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboDojo [25] 上评估从经验中学习的能力，这是一个具有挑战性的基准，包含五个能力维度上的 42 个模拟双手操作任务（见 4E 节）。 RoboDojo 为每个任务提供了多种布局，因此同一任务可以在某些场景中进行练习，而在其他场景中进行测试。 与 RoboLab-120 不同，智能体只接收 RGB 图像，没有深度信息或相机标定。 虽然 AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 上的零样本表现已接近饱和（见 2A.1 节），但 RoboDojo 为从经验中学习留出了充足的提升空间。

sents.en: We evaluate learning from experience on RoboDojo [ 25 ] , a challenging benchmark that comprises 42 simulated bimanual manipulation tasks across five capability dimensions ( Sec. 4E ).
sents.zh: 我们在 RoboDojo [25] 上评估从经验中学习的能力，这是一个具有挑战性的基准，包含五个能力维度上的 42 个模拟双手操作任务（见 4E 节）。

sents.en: RoboDojo provides many layouts per task, so a given task can be practiced on certain scenes and tested on others.
sents.zh: RoboDojo 为每个任务提供了多种布局，因此同一任务可以在某些场景中进行练习，而在其他场景中进行测试。

sents.en: Unlike in RoboLab-120, the agent receives only RGB images, without depth or camera calibration.
sents.zh: 与 RoboLab-120 不同，智能体只接收 RGB 图像，没有深度信息或相机标定。

sents.en: While AMP1 approaches saturation on RoboLab-120 zero-shot ( Sec. 2A.1 ), RoboDojo leaves ample headroom for learning from experience.
sents.zh: 虽然 AMP1 在 RoboLab-120 上的零样本表现已接近饱和（见 2A.1 节），但 RoboDojo 为从经验中学习留出了充足的提升空间。

paragraphs.en: In both the few-shot and the continual settings, the agent keeps whatever it finds useful in a persistent memory ℳ \mathcal{M} , a folder that it reads at the start of every episode. We impose no format on ℳ \mathcal{M} , so it may hold notes, code, or data in any form. Typically, the agent decides to keep a Markdown file of notes (strategies that succeeded or failed, pitfalls and observations, useful constants and parameters) and a Python library of code it found useful. Later episodes can read the notes and import and call the Python code. We refer to the harness augmented by the persistent memory ℳ \mathcal{M} as AMP1+.
paragraphs.zh: 在少样本与持续学习两种设定下，智能体都会将其发现的有用内容保存在持久记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中，这是一个它在每轮回合开始时都会读取的文件夹。 我们不对 ℳ \mathcal{M} 施加任何格式限制，因此它可以以任何形式保存笔记、代码或数据。 通常情况下，智能体会决定保存一个 Markdown 笔记文件（成功或失败的策略、陷阱与观察结果、有用的常数与参数），以及一个包含其发现的有用代码的 Python 库。 后续回合可以读取这些笔记，并导入和调用这些 Python 代码。 我们将这种由持久记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M} 增强的 harness 称为 AMP1+。

sents.en: In both the few-shot and the continual settings, the agent keeps whatever it finds useful in a persistent memory ℳ \mathcal{M} , a folder that it reads at the start of every episode.
sents.zh: 在少样本与持续学习两种设定下，智能体都会将其发现的有用内容保存在持久记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中，这是一个它在每轮回合开始时都会读取的文件夹。

sents.en: We impose no format on ℳ \mathcal{M} , so it may hold notes, code, or data in any form.
sents.zh: 我们不对 ℳ \mathcal{M} 施加任何格式限制，因此它可以以任何形式保存笔记、代码或数据。

sents.en: Typically, the agent decides to keep a Markdown file of notes (strategies that succeeded or failed, pitfalls and observations, useful constants and parameters) and a Python library of code it found useful.
sents.zh: 通常情况下，智能体会决定保存一个 Markdown 笔记文件（成功或失败的策略、陷阱与观察结果、有用的常数与参数），以及一个包含其发现的有用代码的 Python 库。

sents.en: Later episodes can read the notes and import and call the Python code.
sents.zh: 后续回合可以读取这些笔记，并导入和调用这些 Python 代码。

sents.en: We refer to the harness augmented by the persistent memory ℳ \mathcal{M} as AMP1+.
sents.zh: 我们将这种由持久记忆 ℳ \mathcal{M} 增强的 harness 称为 AMP1+。

paragraphs.en: In the few-shot setting, we let the agent learn a task by practicing it on several layouts until the agent judges that it can reliably succeed or reaches its practice budget. Each practice episode presents a new layout. The only feedback the agent receives is the benchmark’s official binary reward for each episode. This requires no expert demonstrations, no additional model training, and no reward shaping.
paragraphs.zh: 在少样本设定中，我们让智能体通过在若干布局上反复练习来学习任务，直到智能体判断自己能够稳定成功，或达到其练习预算。 每个练习回合都会呈现一个新布局。 智能体获得的唯一反馈是基准测试对每个回合给出的官方二元奖励。 这不需要专家示范、不需要额外的模型训练，也不需要奖励塑形。

sents.en: In the few-shot setting, we let the agent learn a task by practicing it on several layouts until the agent judges that it can reliably succeed or reaches its practice budget.
sents.zh: 在少样本设定中，我们让智能体通过在若干布局上反复练习来学习任务，直到智能体判断自己能够稳定成功，或达到其练习预算。

sents.en: Each practice episode presents a new layout.
sents.zh: 每个练习回合都会呈现一个新布局。

sents.en: The only feedback the agent receives is the benchmark’s official binary reward for each episode.
sents.zh: 智能体获得的唯一反馈是基准测试对每个回合给出的官方二元奖励。

sents.en: This requires no expert demonstrations, no additional model training, and no reward shaping.
sents.zh: 这不需要专家示范、不需要额外的模型训练，也不需要奖励塑形。

paragraphs.en: In the continual setting, we test whether the agent can accumulate useful knowledge over its lifetime, applying lessons from earlier tasks to later ones. In this setting, the agent tackles an episode of each of the 42 RoboDojo tasks in random order. A persistent memory store ℳ \mathcal{M} is carried across tasks and the agent is instructed to keep only general lessons that may help with any task in the given robot embodiment.
paragraphs.zh: 在持续学习设定下，我们测试智能体能否在其生命周期中积累有用的知识，并将早期任务中的经验应用于后续任务。 在此设定下，智能体以随机顺序依次完成 42 个 RoboDojo 任务中每个任务的一个回合。 一个持久记忆库 ℳ \mathcal{M} 跨任务保留，并且智能体被指示只保留可能对给定机器人形态下任何任务都有帮助的一般性经验。

sents.en: In the continual setting, we test whether the agent can accumulate useful knowledge over its lifetime, applying lessons from earlier tasks to later ones.
sents.zh: 在持续学习设定下，我们测试智能体能否在其生命周期中积累有用的知识，并将早期任务中的经验应用于后续任务。

sents.en: In this setting, the agent tackles an episode of each of the 42 RoboDojo tasks in random order.
sents.zh: 在此设定下，智能体以随机顺序依次完成 42 个 RoboDojo 任务中每个任务的一个回合。

sents.en: A persistent memory store ℳ \mathcal{M} is carried across tasks and the agent is instructed to keep only general lessons that may help with any task in the given robot embodiment.
sents.zh: 一个持久记忆库 ℳ \mathcal{M} 跨任务保留，并且智能体被指示只保留可能对给定机器人形态下任何任务都有帮助的一般性经验。

paragraphs.en: Our approach to learning from experience is gradient-free: the agent revises its memory and code, while the model weights remain fixed. This differs structurally from gradient-based approaches to few-shot learning [ 45 ] and continual learning [ 46 , 47 ] , which adapt neural network weights to new experience. Learning without weight updates has precedents in agents that retain verbal reflections [ 48 , 49 ] or accumulate executable skills [ 50 ] . In robotics, ASPIRE retains validated repair knowledge [ 36 ] , RoboSkill consolidates execution records into reusable guidance and code [ 51 ] , and RAX builds autonomous control programs and a persistent skill library through exploration [ 29 ] . ENPIRE automates policy improvement on physical robots, including both program refinement and gradient-based policy training [ 52 ] . We study gradient-free few-shot and continual learning with the generalist model continuing to reason and command the manipulator during execution, measuring both improvement on practiced tasks and transfer and retention across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从经验中学习的方法是无梯度的：智能体修订其记忆和代码，而模型权重保持不变。 这与基于梯度的少样本学习 [ 45 ] 和持续学习 [ 46 , 47 ] 方法在结构上不同，后者通过调整神经网络权重来适应新经验。 无需权重更新的学习在先前工作中已有先例，例如保留言语反思的智能体 [ 48 , 49 ] 或积累可执行技能的智能体 [ 50 ] 。 在机器人领域，ASPIRE 保留经过验证的修复知识 [ 36 ] ，RoboSkill 将执行记录整合为可复用的指导和代码 [ 51 ] ，RAX 通过探索构建自主控制程序和持久化技能库 [ 29 ] 。 ENPIRE 在实体机器人上自动化策略改进，包括程序精炼和基于梯度的策略训练 [ 52 ] 。 我们研究无梯度的少样本学习和持续学习，其中通用模型在执行过程中持续进行推理并指挥机械臂，同时衡量在练习任务上的改进以及跨任务的迁移与保留。

paragraphs.en: AMP1+ practices each task over several rounds. To save wall-clock time, each round runs a batch of B B episodes in parallel. We build the memory ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} iteratively over rounds k = 0 , 1 , … {k=0,1,\ldots} , starting from an empty memory store ℳ 0 \mathcal{M}_{0} (zero-shot). At round k k , B B instances of AMP1+, each with memory bank ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} , run on different practice layouts, and the benchmark scores each episode with a binary reward r k , b ∈ { 0 , 1 } r_{k,b}\in\{0,1\} , b = 1 , … , B b=1,\dots,B . We denote by τ k , b \tau_{k,b} the episode’s transcript, the turn-by-turn record of its messages, code, outputs, and camera images. When the round ends, one of the B B AMP1+ instances from the batch continues after its episode to reflect on the round, with its own episode still in context. It sees all rewards and transcripts so far ( r j , b r_{j,b} and τ j , b \tau_{j,b} for 0 ≤ j ≤ k 0\leq j\leq k and 1 ≤ b ≤ B 1\leq b\leq B ), and hence the success rate of each round, as well as the memories ℳ 0 , … , ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{0},\dots,\mathcal{M}_{k} . It then populates ℳ k + 1 \mathcal{M}_{k+1} and decides whether to stop practicing. Practice ends when the reflecting agent decides to stop or after N / B N/B rounds, for a budget of N N practice episodes. In our experiments, we use B = 4 B=4 and N = 48 N=48 , so practice takes place over up to 12 rounds. The memory bank produced by the ultimate practice round is then frozen as ℳ ⋆ \mathcal{M}^{\star} and used for evaluation. AMP1+ itself, in practice and at evaluation, sees only its memory, ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} or ℳ ⋆ \mathcal{M}^{\star} . The rewards and transcripts are available only to the reflecting agent.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1+ 在多轮中对每个任务进行练习。 为节省实际运行时间，每一轮以并行方式同时运行一批 B 个回合。 我们从空的记忆库 ℳ₀（零样本）出发，在轮次 k = 0, 1, … 上迭代式地构建记忆 ℳₖ。 在第 k 轮，B 个 AMP1+ 实例各自携带记忆库 ℳₖ，在不同的练习布局上运行，基准测试用二元奖励 rₖ,ᵇ ∈ {0, 1}（b = 1, …, B）对每个回合进行评分。 我们用 τₖ,ᵇ 表示该回合的对话记录，即其中消息、代码、输出和相机图像的逐轮记录。 当一轮结束时，该批次中 B 个 AMP1+ 实例之一在其回合结束后继续对该轮进行反思，其自身的回合内容仍保留在上下文中。 它可以看到目前为止所有的奖励和对话记录（即 0 ≤ j ≤ k 且 1 ≤ b ≤ B 时的 rⱼ,ᵇ 和 τⱼ,ᵇ），因而能看到每一轮的成功率，以及各版记忆 ℳ₀, …, ℳₖ。 随后它填充 ℳ₊₁ 并决定是否停止练习。 当反思智能体决定停止，或在 N/B 轮（即 N 个练习回合的预算）之后，练习即告结束。 在我们的实验中，我们使用 B = 4 和 N = 48，因此练习最多进行 12 轮。 最后一轮练习产生的记忆库随后被冻结为 ℳ⋆，并用于评估。 AMP1+ 本身在练习和评估时只看到其记忆，即 ℳₖ 或 ℳ⋆。 奖励和对话记录只有反思智能体可以访问。

paragraphs.en: Practice raises AMP1+’s success rate on RoboDojo from 26.4% zero-shot to 84.1%, above every entry on the RoboDojo leaderboard. The strongest leaderboard entry at the time of writing, Q0-Preview, reaches 68.9%. Fig. 4 F and G show how success rates and efficiency change over the rounds of practice. We measure efficiency by the number of model calls per episode. Each call is one request from the harness to the generalist model to provide its next response. The harness then executes any tool calls specified in that response, such as running code that reads camera images, queries the robot’s pose, computes trajectories, or moves the robot. Efficiency improves almost entirely in the first rounds. By k = 2 k=2 , the memories of 39 of the 42 tasks hold a code library, and later episodes call it instead of rediscovering the procedure, which halves the number of model calls. Later rounds fix remaining failures and continue to raise the success rate without further reducing the number of model calls per episode. Practice ends early for 26 of the 42 tasks, and the other 16 use the full budget of practice rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 练习将 AMP1+ 在 RoboDojo 上的成功率从 26.4% 的零样本水平提升到 84.1%，高于 RoboDojo 排行榜上的所有条目。 在撰写本文时，排行榜上最强的条目 Q0-Preview 达到 68.9%。 图 4 F 和 G 展示了成功率和效率在练习各轮次中的变化情况。 我们通过每个回合（episode）的模型调用次数来衡量效率。 每次调用都是 harness 向通用模型发出的一次请求，要求其提供下一个响应。 harness 随后执行该响应中指定的任何工具调用，例如运行读取相机图像、查询机器人位姿、计算轨迹或移动机器人的代码。 效率的提升几乎完全发生在最初的几轮。 到 k = 2 k=2 时，42 个任务中有 39 个的记忆中保存了代码库，后续回合直接调用它而不再重新探索操作流程，这使模型调用次数减半。 后面的轮次修复剩余的失败情况，并继续提高成功率，而不再进一步减少每个回合的模型调用次数。 42 个任务中有 26 个提前结束练习，另外 16 个用满了全部练习轮次预算。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 B–E walk through one example, a task drawn from Mahjong. The agent is asked to take a tile from the stack and stand it upright at the right-hand end of its row; it is not told that the tile must also be the right way up, which the task’s scoring requires. At k = 2 k=2 , one practice episode fails and another succeeds. In its reflection, the agent enlarges the last camera frame of each and sees that the tile’s red symbol is at the bottom in the successful episode, like its neighbors’, but on top in the unsuccessful episode. Tracing both episodes’ actions, it finds that they picked up the face-down tile from opposite ends, and records which end is the tile’s top. After one more round, in which the agent learns to open the gripper before reaching for the tile on the stack, every practice episode succeeds, and success on held-out layouts rises from 10% prior to practice to 100%.
paragraphs.zh: 图4 B–E展示了一个示例，该任务来自麻将。 要求智能体从牌堆中取一块牌并将其竖立在所在排的右端；但没有告诉它牌还必须正面向上，而任务评分对此有要求。 在 k = 2 k=2 时，一次练习回合失败，另一次成功。 在其反思中，智能体放大两者各自的最后一帧相机画面，发现在成功的回合中，牌的红色符号位于底部，与相邻牌一致，而在失败的回合中却位于顶部。 追踪两个回合的动作后，它发现二者是从相反的两端拾起那张面朝下的牌的，并记录了哪一端是牌的顶部。 再经过一轮练习后——智能体学会了在伸手取牌堆上的牌之前先张开夹爪——每次练习回合都取得成功，在留出布局上的成功率从练习前的10%提升到100%。

sents.zh: 在其反思中，智能体放大两者各自的最后一帧相机画面，发现在成功的回合中，牌的红色符号位于底部，与相邻牌一致，而在失败的回合中却位于顶部。

sents.en: Tracing both episodes’ actions, it finds that they picked up the face-down tile from opposite ends, and records which end is the tile’s top.
sents.zh: 追踪两个回合的动作后，它发现二者是从相反的两端拾起那张面朝下的牌的，并记录了哪一端是牌的顶部。

sents.en: After one more round, in which the agent learns to open the gripper before reaching for the tile on the stack, every practice episode succeeds, and success on held-out layouts rises from 10% prior to practice to 100%.
sents.zh: 再经过一轮练习后——智能体学会了在伸手取牌堆上的牌之前先张开夹爪——每次练习回合都取得成功，在留出布局上的成功率从练习前的10%提升到100%。

paragraphs.en: Starting from an empty initialization ℳ 0 \mathcal{M}_{0} , AMP1+ attempts the t t -th task ( t = 1 , … ​ 42 t=1,\ldots 42 ) with memory bank ℳ t − 1 \mathcal{M}_{t-1} , is told whether it succeeded, and produces an updated memory bank ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} . After one pass through a random permutation of the 42 tasks, the agent’s success rate on all tasks rises from 26.4% zero-shot to 57.6% with ℳ 42 \mathcal{M}_{42} . To track the gain over the sequence, both on tasks that have already been seen and on tasks that have not yet been seen, we split the task sequence into four segments: S 1 S_{1} (tasks 1–10), S 2 S_{2} (11–20), S 3 S_{3} (21–30), and S 4 S_{4} (31–42). At the end of segment i i , we evaluate AMP1+ with the memory bank ℳ 10 ​ i \mathcal{M}_{10i} on all 42 tasks. Most of the gain in the success rate arrives with the first segment. Experience helps with efficiency as well ( Fig. 4 I, J).

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 K breaks this gain down segment by segment. Segments that have not yet been seen benefit along with segments that the agent already worked through. This implies that much of what the agent learns from earlier tasks transfers to new tasks. For example, success rate on S 4 S_{4} rises from 24% without memory to 47% after performing S 1 S_{1} alone. Segments seen earlier (blue) stay well above their no-memory success rates, so learning on later segments does not erase earlier gains.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 K 按片段逐一分解了这一增益。 尚未见过的片段与智能体已经处理过的片段一起获益。 这意味着智能体从较早任务中学到的许多内容可以迁移到新任务。 例如，仅执行 S 1 S_{1} 之后，S 4 S_{4} 上的成功率从无记忆时的 24% 上升到 47%。 较早见过的片段（蓝色）始终远高于其无记忆时的成功率，因此对后续片段的学习不会抹去先前的收益。

paragraphs.en: What AMP1+ writes into its memory explains these results. From the earliest episodes, it records embodiment-specific knowledge, such as the robot’s coordinate frames, its physical limits, and how to work around the lack of depth sensing and camera calibration. It also writes code for basic manipulation primitives, such as grasping and placing. Because these findings apply to every task, they benefit later episodes as well.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1+ 写入其记忆中的内容解释了这些结果。 从最初的情节开始，它就记录与具身相关的知识，例如机器人的坐标系、其物理限制，以及如何应对缺乏深度感知和相机标定的问题。 它还编写用于基本操作原语的代码，例如抓取和放置。 由于这些发现适用于每个任务，它们同样使后续的情节受益。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 comprises two interlocking parts: the frontier model and the harness. The latter serves as the former’s interface to the world, supplying the sensory inputs and executing the commanded actions. We separate the contributions of these two parts via controlled experiments on RoboLab-120, varying the sensory input and motion interface on the harness side, and the choice of model and its reasoning effort on the model side ( Fig. 5 ). We report a number of findings. First, the model matters far more than any change to the harness ( Sec. 2D.1 ). Second, stronger models do better when they command the manipulator directly rather than via a motion interface that adds assistive routines for grasping and placing objects ( Sec. 2D.2 ). Third, stronger models cope better with missing sensory input and can compensate for impaired sensor constellations via active perception and additional computation ( Sec. 2D.3 ). Fourth, direct image input is substantially more effective than textual descriptions ( Sec. 2D.3 ), contrasting with findings reported in prior work [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 由两个相互交织的部分组成：前沿模型和线束（harness）。 后者作为前者与世界的接口，提供感知输入并执行所指令的动作。 我们通过在 RoboLab-120 上进行受控实验来分离这两部分的贡献：在线束一侧改变感知输入和运动接口，在模型一侧改变模型选择及其推理努力程度（图 5）。 我们报告了若干发现。 首先，模型的影响远大于对线束的任何改动（第 2D.1 节）。 其次，更强的模型在直接指挥机械臂时表现更好，而不是通过为抓取和放置物体添加辅助例程的运动接口（第 2D.2 节）。 第三，更强的模型能更好地应对缺失的感知输入，并能通过主动感知和额外计算来补偿受损的传感器组合（第 2D.3 节）。 第四，直接图像输入比文本描述有效得多（第 2D.3 节），这与先前工作 [18] 中报告的发现形成对比。

paragraphs.en: We hold the harness fixed and vary the model and its reasoning effort ( Fig. 5 A). We test 13 models: seven closed models, namely Gemini 4 Argon and six Claude models (Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Opus 4.5, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 5.5), and six open-weight models, namely three Qwen models (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next), GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and Kimi K3. Each runs at a low and a high reasoning setting, except Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, which we run with reasoning off and at maximum, and Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which we run at low and maximum.
paragraphs.zh: 我们固定评测框架不变，改变模型及其推理力度（图 5 A）。 我们测试了 13 个模型：七个闭源模型，即 Gemini 4 Argon 和六个 Claude 模型（Opus 5.5、Opus 5、Opus 4.5、Sonnet 5.5、Sonnet 5 和 Haiku 5.5），以及六个开源权重模型，即三个 Qwen 模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）、GLM-5.3 Flash、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Kimi K3。 每个模型都在低推理设置和高推理设置下运行，但 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 除外，我们以关闭推理和最大推理力度运行它；Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 也是例外，我们以低和最大设置运行它们。

paragraphs.en: Success rates range from 12.8% with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to 85.6% with Gemini 4 Argon. Stronger models consistently outperform weaker or older ones: within the Claude family, the success rate is 82.8% with Opus 5.5, 51.6% with the smaller Haiku 5.5, and 35.2% with the older Opus 4.5. Among open-weight models, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves the highest success rate, 64.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率从 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 12.8% 到 Gemini 4 Argon 的 85.6% 不等。 更强的模型始终优于较弱或较旧的模型：在 Claude 系列中，Opus 5.5 的成功率为 82.8%，较小的 Haiku 5.5 为 51.6%，较旧的 Opus 4.5 为 35.2%。 在开放权重模型中，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 取得了最高的成功率，为 64.9%。

sents.zh: 成功率从 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 12.8% 到 Gemini 4 Argon 的 85.6% 不等。

sents.zh: 更强的模型始终优于较弱或较旧的模型：在 Claude 系列中，Opus 5.5 的成功率为 82.8%，较小的 Haiku 5.5 为 51.6%，较旧的 Opus 4.5 为 35.2%。

sents.zh: 在开放权重模型中，Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 取得了最高的成功率，为 64.9%。

paragraphs.en: Claude models gain the most from reasoning, up to 17.2 points for Sonnet 5.5 and 14.6 points for Opus 5.5. Gemini 4 Argon gains only 2.3 points, partly because it has little headroom: it already succeeds in most episodes at low reasoning, and more than half of its remaining failures are in tasks where reasoning is not the limiting factor (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S6 ).
paragraphs.zh: Claude 模型从推理中获益最多，Sonnet 5.5 提升高达 17.2 分，Opus 5.5 提升 14.6 分。 Gemini 4 Argon 仅提升 2.3 分，部分原因在于其提升空间很小：它在低推理水平下已经能在大多数回合中成功，而其剩余失败中超过一半发生在推理并非限制因素的任务上（补充材料，第 S6 节）。

paragraphs.en: We compare two motion interfaces for every model on RoboLab-120, each at its more-reasoning setting ( Fig. 5 B): the basic harness, our default, in which AMP1 commands timed end-effector waypoints directly, and an assistive harness, which adds routines that plan and execute picks and placements for the agent. Both use the same prompt and perception.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboLab-120 上为每个模型比较两种动作接口，均在其更强推理设置下（图 5 B）：一种是基础框架（我们的默认设置），其中 AMP1 直接为智能体下达定时末端执行器路径点指令；另一种是辅助框架，它在基础框架之上增加了为智能体规划并执行抓取和放置任务的例程。 两者使用相同的提示和感知。

sents.en: We compare two motion interfaces for every model on RoboLab-120, each at its more-reasoning setting ( Fig. 5 B): the basic harness, our default, in which AMP1 commands timed end-effector waypoints directly, and an assistive harness, which adds routines that plan and execute picks and placements for the agent.
sents.zh: 我们在 RoboLab-120 上为每个模型比较两种动作接口，均在其更强推理设置下（图 5 B）：一种是基础框架（我们的默认设置），其中 AMP1 直接为智能体下达定时末端执行器路径点指令；另一种是辅助框架，它在基础框架之上增加了为智能体规划并执行抓取和放置任务的例程。

sents.en: Both use the same prompt and perception.
sents.zh: 两者使用相同的提示和感知。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 commands motion as a trajectory of timed end-effector poses and gripper commands, and makes all decisions, from where to grasp an object to where to release it. The agent can preview a trajectory before executing it. The harness refuses motions that are unreachable or too fast, but leaves collision checking to the model ( Sec. 4A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 以一条带时间戳的末端执行器位姿和夹爪指令的轨迹来下达运动指令，并做出所有决策，从在哪里抓取物体到在哪里释放它。 智能体可以在执行轨迹之前预览该轨迹。 测试框架会拒绝不可达或速度过快的运动，但将碰撞检查留给模型（第 4A.3 节）。

sents.en: AMP1 commands motion as a trajectory of timed end-effector poses and gripper commands, and makes all decisions, from where to grasp an object to where to release it.
sents.zh: AMP1 以一条带时间戳的末端执行器位姿和夹爪指令的轨迹来下达运动指令，并做出所有决策，从在哪里抓取物体到在哪里释放它。

sents.en: The agent can preview a trajectory before executing it.
sents.zh: 智能体可以在执行轨迹之前预览该轨迹。

sents.en: The harness refuses motions that are unreachable or too fast, but leaves collision checking to the model ( Sec. 4A.3 ).
sents.zh: 测试框架会拒绝不可达或速度过快的运动，但将碰撞检查留给模型（第 4A.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The assistive harness lets the model delegate grasping and placing through additional routines. The model can request ranked grasp and placement poses. A motion planner executes collision-free picks and placements at the indicated poses. The assistive pick routines check whether the object is held and retry with another grasp if not ( Sec. 4A.3 ). The model still decides which objects to move, in what order, and when the task is complete. It can always take full control via the basic harness, which remains available at all times.

paragraphs.en: The four models with the highest success rates under the basic harness – Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5.5 – all do worse with the assistive harness, by up to 7.5 points ( Fig. 5 B). The six models with the lowest success rates all do better, by up to 17.6 points for the weakest model, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. The three models in between gain nothing.

paragraphs.en: Prior work found that high-level abstractions improved single-turn performance, while multi-turn reasoning could compensate for lower-level interfaces [ 18 ] . Our results indicate that assistive grasping and placing routines help weaker models but reduce the success rate of stronger models. The assistive routines are imperfect: a grasp can slip or a placement can miss. Weaker models still benefit from the assistance, because the routines succeed more often than their own direct grasping and placement attempts. For stronger models, the assistive routines are on balance a detrimental distraction, because they hide failures that the models could otherwise immediately observe and correct. For example, an assistive pick routine retries internally before the model can intervene, and reports only whether it succeeded, not what went wrong. With the basic harness, the model sees the result of every atomic action and can correct mistakes as they happen.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究发现，高层抽象可以提升单轮性能，而多轮推理可以弥补较低层接口的不足 [ 18 ] 。 我们的结果表明，辅助抓取与放置例程对较弱的模型有帮助，但会降低较强模型的成功率。 这些辅助例程并不完美：抓取可能打滑，放置可能落空。 较弱的模型仍然能从辅助中受益，因为这些例程的成功率高于它们自己直接进行抓取和放置尝试的成功率。 对较强的模型而言，辅助例程总体上是一种有害的干扰，因为它们掩盖了模型本可以立即观察到并加以纠正的失败。 例如，辅助拾取例程会在智能体介入之前在内部进行重试，并且只报告它是否成功，而不报告出了什么问题。 在基础运行框架下，智能体可以看到每个原子动作的结果，并能在错误发生时及时纠正。

paragraphs.en: RoboLab-120 provides fixed scene cameras and a wrist camera, each with RGB images, depth (D), and calibration (C). On top of these signals, the AMP1 harness offers perception tools (T) that build a scene model from the fused point cloud: they segment it into objects, track the objects over the episode, and render them from any viewpoint ( Sec. 4A.2 ). We ablate this input along two axes. The first is how much geometric information each camera provides: starting from the full input (RGB+C+D+T), we remove perception tools (RGB+C+D), then depth (RGB+C), and then calibration (RGB). The second is which cameras AMP1 sees through: all of them, the scene cameras only, or the wrist camera only. In a final condition (Text), AMP1 receives no images, only textual descriptions of their content, as recommended in prior work [ 18 ] . The rest of the harness and the prompt are unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: RoboLab-120 提供固定的场景相机和一个腕部相机，每个相机都有 RGB 图像、深度（D）和标定（C）。 在这些信号之上，AMP1 框架提供了感知工具（T），用于从融合的点云构建场景模型：它们将点云分割为物体、在整个回合中跟踪这些物体，并从任意视点渲染它们（见第 4A.2 节）。 我们沿两个轴对该输入进行消融实验。 第一个轴是每个相机提供多少几何信息：从完整输入（RGB+C+D+T）开始，我们先移除感知工具（RGB+C+D），再移除深度（RGB+C），最后移除标定（RGB）。 第二个轴是 AMP1 通过哪些相机进行观察：所有相机、仅场景相机，或仅腕部相机。 在最后的条件（Text）中，AMP1 不接收任何图像，只接收其内容的文本描述，如先前工作 [18] 所建议的。 框架的其余部分和提示词保持不变。

paragraphs.en: With a strong model (Opus 5.5) and all cameras, removing geometric information lowers the success rate only modestly but carries a cost in terms of efficiency ( Fig. 5 C). From RGB+C+D+T to RGB+C+D, RGB+C, and RGB, the success rate declines from 82.8% to 81.9%, 81.1%, and 75.8%, while the mean number of model calls per episode rises from 34.8 to 38.7, 46.3, and 53.5, respectively. AMP1 rebuilds the missing geometry itself. Without the perception tools, it detects objects in the images and lifts them to 3D with depth and calibration. Without depth, it picks matching pixels in zoomed crops of different views and triangulates them through the known calibration. Without calibration, it first estimates the camera parameters, most reliably with the wrist camera, which it can move (a form of active perception [ 53 ] ): it captures images at known gripper poses, matches SIFT features across them [ 54 ] , and fits the focal length, principal point, and camera-to-gripper pose by least squares (Supplementary Materials, Sec. S4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在强模型（Opus 5.5）且配备所有相机的情况下，去除几何信息只会使成功率小幅下降，但在效率方面会带来代价（图 5 C）。 从 RGB+C+D+T 到 RGB+C+D、RGB+C 和 RGB，成功率分别从 82.8% 降至 81.9%、81.1% 和 75.8%，而每个回合的平均模型调用次数分别从 34.8 次升至 38.7 次、46.3 次和 53.5 次。 AMP1 会自行重建缺失的几何信息。 在没有感知工具的情况下，它会检测图像中的物体，并利用深度和标定信息将它们提升到三维空间。 在没有深度信息的情况下，它会在不同视角的放大裁剪图像中选取匹配的像素，并利用已知标定信息对它们进行三角测量。 在没有标定信息的情况下，它会先估计相机参数，其中使用可移动的腕部相机最为可靠（这是一种主动感知形式 [53]）：它在已知的夹爪位姿下采集图像，匹配图像间的 SIFT 特征 [54]，并通过最小二乘法拟合焦距、主点以及相机到夹爪的位姿（补充材料，第 S4.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 C compares Opus 5.5 with three weaker models: Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and Opus 4.5. While Opus 5.5 is able to compensate for missing sensory input at the cost of efficiency, weaker models are more brittle. The weaker the model, the more sensitive it is to sensory impairment. The success rate of Opus 4.5 drops sharply as soon as the perception tools are taken away. Haiku 5.5 suffers when the perception tools and depth are both withheld. Sonnet 5.5 exhibits material degradation in task completion when the perception tools, depth, and calibration are all removed. The gap between the stronger and weaker models is particularly stark when only RGB input is provided; in this condition, Haiku 5.5 succeeds in only 10.7% of the episodes, against 75.8% for Opus 5.5. Weaker models are unable to compensate for sensory impairment even with more reasoning and computation: as sensory input is ablated, AMP1 with Opus 5.5 takes substantially more model calls to complete the tasks, while with weaker models the number of model calls does not grow by much as their success rate plummets.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 C 将 Opus 5.5 与三个更弱的模型进行了比较：Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Opus 4.5。 Opus 5.5 能够以牺牲效率为代价来弥补缺失的感官输入，而较弱的模型则更加脆弱。 模型越弱，它对感官损伤就越敏感。 一旦感知工具被移除，Opus 4.5 的成功率就会急剧下降。 当感知工具和深度信息同时被剥夺时，Haiku 5.5 会受到影响。 当感知工具、深度和校准全部被移除时，Sonnet 5.5 在任务完成上表现出明显的退化。 在仅提供 RGB 输入时，较强模型与较弱模型之间的差距尤为显著；在此条件下，Haiku 5.5 仅在 10.7% 的回合中成功，而 Opus 5.5 则达到 75.8%。 即使有更多的推理和计算，较弱的模型也无法弥补感官损伤：随着感官输入被消融，使用 Opus 5.5 的 AMP1 需要明显更多的模型调用次数才能完成任务，而使用较弱模型时，模型调用次数并没有增长多少，其成功率却骤然下跌。

sents.zh: 图 5 C 将 Opus 5.5 与三个更弱的模型进行了比较：Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Opus 4.5。

paragraphs.en: Prior work recommended substituting direct camera feeds by textual descriptions of their contents [ 18 ] . We test this with four Claude models: Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and Opus 4.5. In the Text condition, a second instance of the same model describes what the cameras see. AMP1 receives these descriptions in place of images. The results are summarized in Fig. 5 C. With Opus 5.5, the success rate drops from 75.8% with RGB images to 36.8% with the corresponding textual descriptions. The success rate of weaker models in the Text condition is vanishingly low. Textual descriptions elide geometric detail, such as whether the gripper is aligned with an object; this has a sharply detrimental effect on task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作建议用其内容的文字描述来替代直接的视频画面 [ 18 ]。 我们用四个 Claude 模型进行测试：Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Opus 4.5。 在 Text 条件下，同一模型的另一个实例对摄像头所见内容进行描述。 AMP1 接收这些描述以替代图像。 结果总结于图 5 C 中。 使用 Opus 5.5 时，成功率从使用 RGB 图像时的 75.8% 降至使用相应文字描述时的 36.8%。 较弱模型在 Text 条件下的成功率极低，几乎可以忽略。 文字描述省略了几何细节，例如夹爪是否与物体对齐；这对任务表现有极为不利的影响。

paragraphs.en: With a strong model (Opus 5.5), AMP1 is robust to removing all but one camera from the sensor constellation ( Fig. 5 D). Specifically, in the RGB+C+D+T condition, the agent has an 82.8% success rate with all cameras, 80.8% with the scene cameras only, and 80.0% with the wrist camera only. The spread is confined to three percentage points in all image-based conditions. With only the wrist camera, AMP1 compensates by means of active perception [ 53 ] : it first pulls the arm back to bring more of the scene into view.
