paragraphs.en: The policies we compare against fall into four classes: learned policies, skill orchestration, offline program synthesis, and agentic manipulation policies (AMPs). Learned policies, including VLAs and WAMs, map observations to actions end-to-end from robot data. Skill orchestration policies can utilize generalist AI models to sequence pre-existing low-level skills; their performance is thus limited by the reliability of those skills. In offline program synthesis, a generalist AI model writes or refines a control program before deployment; the program can incorporate perception and feedback, but the model does not revise the control strategy as the task unfolds. AMPs keep the generalist model in the control loop, where it can interpret new observations and directly command the manipulator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用来对比的策略分为四类：学习得到的策略、技能编排、离线程序合成，以及智能体操作策略（AMPs）。 学习得到的策略，包括视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）和世界-动作模型（WAMs），从机器人数据中以端到端的方式将观测映射为动作。 技能编排策略可以利用通用人工智能模型来对既有的低层技能进行排序；因此其性能受限于这些技能的可靠性。 在离线程序合成中，通用人工智能模型在部署前编写或改进控制程序；该程序可以结合感知与反馈，但在任务展开过程中模型不会修改控制策略。 智能体操作策略（AMPs）将通用模型保留在控制回路中，使其能够解读新的观测并直接指挥机械臂。

paragraphs.en: At the time of writing, the strongest learned policies on the RoboLab-120 leaderboard – Lakeside, BiMind v0.5, and FLUX 3 Action – succeed in 51.0%, 49.2%, and 42.9% of episodes, respectively, in contrast to 85.6% for AMP1 when paired with Gemini 4 Argon and 82.8% when paired with Opus 5.5. AMP1 perceives the environment with the aid of RGB, depth, and camera calibration, whereas typical VLAs and WAMs use RGB alone. The richer sensory input, however, does not explain the gap: when paired with Opus 5.5, AMP1 still succeeds in 81.1% of episodes without depth, and in 75.8% with RGB input alone ( Fig. 5 C). AMP1 draws on the broad intelligence of the generalist AI model to decide which objects to move, in what order, and how to react to unanticipated challenges ( Sec. 2B ), whereas a learned policy must acquire its skills from robot data. In addition to their overall poor task performance, specialist manipulation policies are particularly brittle to changes in the phrasing of the task: in the ‘vague’ task specification condition on RoboLab-120, the success rate of FLUX 3 Action drops further to 28.4%, while AMP1 remains at 84.0% and 79.8% with Gemini 4 Argon and Opus 5.5, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 截至撰写本文时，RoboLab-120 排行榜上最强的学习型策略——Lakeside、BiMind v0.5 和 FLUX 3 Action——分别在 51.0%、49.2% 和 42.9% 的回合中取得成功，而 AMP1 与 Gemini 4 Argon 搭配时的成功率为 85.6%，与 Opus 5.5 搭配时为 82.8%。 AMP1 借助 RGB、深度和相机标定来感知环境，而典型的 VLA 和 WAM 仅使用 RGB。 然而，更丰富的感官输入并不能解释这一差距：与 Opus 5.5 搭配时，AMP1 在没有深度信息的情况下仍在 81.1% 的回合中取得成功，仅使用 RGB 输入时为 75.8%（图 5 C）。 AMP1 利用通用 AI 模型的广泛智能来决定移动哪些物体、以何种顺序移动，以及如何应对未预料到的挑战（第 2B 节），而学习型策略必须从机器人数据中习得其技能。 除了整体任务表现不佳之外，专用操作策略对任务措辞的变化尤其脆弱：在 RoboLab-120 的「模糊」任务规范条件下，FLUX 3 Action 的成功率进一步下降至 28.4%，而 AMP1 与 Gemini 4 Argon 和 Opus 5.5 搭配时分别保持在 84.0% 和 79.8%。

paragraphs.en: Harness VLA [ 37 ] and HarnessPAI [ 12 ] delegate motion to a learned VLA policy, so their reliability is bounded by that learned policy. Like the routines of our assistive harness, but to an even greater degree, a VLA is something of a black box: when it fails, the agent has limited ability to understand the causes and potential mitigations ( Sec. 2D.2 ). HarnessPAI compensates for this limitation through practice, refining its program over several trial runs of the evaluation tasks. AMP1 reaches comparable results zero-shot: 95.2% against 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO, and 100.0% against 96.3% on robosuite ( Sec. 2A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: Harness VLA [ 37 ] 与 HarnessPAI [ 12 ] 将运动控制交给学习得到的 VLA 策略，因此其可靠性受限于该学习得到的策略。 与我们辅助框架（assistive harness）中的例程相比（但程度更深），VLA 在某种程度上是一个黑箱：当其失败时，智能体理解原因及潜在缓解措施的能力有限（第 2D.2 节）。 HarnessPAI 通过练习弥补了这一局限，在评估任务的多次试运行中不断改进其程序。 AMP1 零样本即可达到相当的结果：在 LIBERO-PRO 上为 95.2% 对 96.5%，在 robosuite 上为 100.0% 对 96.3%（第 2A.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: On LIBERO-PRO and robosuite, ASPIRE [ 36 ] refines a program for each task through repeated execution and debugging, then evaluates the resulting program on held-out configurations. The program can use perception and feedback, but the generalist model does not revise it during deployment. AMP1 is evaluated zero-shot on these benchmarks, with the generalist model in the control loop.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LIBERO-PRO 和 robosuite 上，ASPIRE [36] 通过反复执行与调试为每个任务改进一个程序，然后在留出的配置上评估所得程序。 该程序可以使用感知和反馈，但通用模型在部署期间不会对其进行修改。 AMP1 在这些基准上以零样本方式评估，通用模型处于控制回路中。

paragraphs.en: CaP-Agent0 [ 18 ] also keeps a coding model in the control loop. Its harness supplies a learned grasp planner and a library of synthesized geometric utilities, and uses a separate vision-language model to create a textual summary of changes in the scene. The authors found that this textual representation improved performance relative to direct image input. In our experiments, replacing images with textual descriptions is detrimental to task performance. Adding assistive grasping and placing routines also reduces the success rate of stronger models ( Sec. 2D ).
paragraphs.zh: CaP-Agent0 [ 18 ] 也在控制回路中保留了一个编码模型。 其框架提供了一个经过学习的抓取规划器和一个由合成的几何工具组成的库，并使用一个单独的视觉-语言模型来生成场景变化的文本摘要。 作者发现，这种文本表示相比直接图像输入提升了性能。 在我们的实验中，用文本描述替换图像会有损任务性能。 添加辅助抓取和放置例程也会降低更强模型的成功率（见第 2D 节）。

sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，用文本描述替换图像会有损任务性能。

paragraphs.en: Astranomy is a concurrent AMP that is based on GPT-6 Astra and was evaluated in simulation on the RoboLab-120 benchmark [ 21 ] . Astranomy reaches 74.8% on RoboLab-120, in comparison to 85.6% for AMP1 with Gemini 4 Argon. Beyond the underlying model, the harnesses differ in three ways. First, Astranomy queries the model for one small end-effector step at a time, whereas AMP1 commands a trajectory. Second, Astranomy disables code execution, whereas AMP1 acts by means of code. Third, the AMP1 harness equips the agent with an editable scene model. Equalizing the underlying model makes the effect of the harness even more salient: Astranomy reports a 25.3% success rate on a 30-task subset with Opus 5.5, in comparison to AMP1’s 84.7% with the same model on the same subset of tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Astranomy 是一个基于 GPT-6 Astra 的并发 AMP，并在 RoboLab-120 基准的仿真中进行了评估 [ 21 ] 。 Astranomy 在 RoboLab-120 上达到 74.8%，而配备 Gemini 4 Argon 的 AMP1 为 85.6%。 除了底层模型之外，两种 harness 在三个方面有所不同。 首先，Astranomy 每次向模型查询一个小的末端执行器步骤，而 AMP1 直接下达整条轨迹指令。 其次，Astranomy 禁用了代码执行，而 AMP1 通过代码进行操作。 第三，AMP1 harness 为智能体配备了一个可编辑的场景模型。 在统一底层模型之后，harness 的作用更加显著：Astranomy 使用 Opus 5.5 在一个 30 个任务的子集上报告了 25.3% 的成功率，而 AMP1 使用同一模型在同一任务子集上的成功率为 84.7%。

sents.zh: 首先，Astranomy 每次向模型查询一个小的末端执行器步骤，而 AMP1 直接下达整条轨迹指令。

sents.en: Second, Astranomy disables code execution, whereas AMP1 acts by means of code.
sents.zh: 其次，Astranomy 禁用了代码执行，而 AMP1 通过代码进行操作。

sents.en: Third, the AMP1 harness equips the agent with an editable scene model.
sents.zh: 第三，AMP1 harness 为智能体配备了一个可编辑的场景模型。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 has a number of limitations. First, the policy is slow as the robot spends much of each episode waiting for the model to reason. Second, the model cannot reconsider a trajectory while it executes: our evaluations largely concern quasi-static scenes, whereas a moving target or a slipping object may require a response before the model’s next turn.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 存在诸多局限。 首先，该策略速度缓慢，因为机器人在每个回合（episode）的很大一部分时间里都在等待模型进行推理。 其次，模型在执行轨迹的过程中无法对其重新考量：我们的评估主要针对准静态场景，而移动的目标或打滑的物体可能需要在模型的下一个回合到来之前就做出响应。

sents.en: AMP1 has a number of limitations.
sents.zh: AMP1 存在诸多局限。

sents.en: First, the policy is slow as the robot spends much of each episode waiting for the model to reason.
sents.zh: 首先，该策略速度缓慢，因为机器人在每个回合（episode）的很大一部分时间里都在等待模型进行推理。

sents.en: Second, the model cannot reconsider a trajectory while it executes: our evaluations largely concern quasi-static scenes, whereas a moving target or a slipping object may require a response before the model’s next turn.
sents.zh: 其次，模型在执行轨迹的过程中无法对其重新考量：我们的评估主要针对准静态场景，而移动的目标或打滑的物体可能需要在模型的下一个回合到来之前就做出响应。

paragraphs.en: Notwithstanding these limitations, our results indicate that AMPs constitute a promising foundation for robot manipulation. They cannot yet be deployed in mission-critical settings, but neither can the alternatives. Specialist manipulation policies, such as VLAs and WAMs, are comparably fast but unreliable. AMPs are comparably reliable but slow. We see a promising path to practical manipulation in using AMPs as a starting point for developing manipulation systems that are both reliable and fast. A general trend that supports this optimism is that the cost of a given capability level has fallen by roughly an order of magnitude per year [ 26 , 27 ] . Thus we can expect the cost of a model call (the ‘thinking’ part of an AMP’s execution) to asymptote to zero over time.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性，我们的结果表明，动作模型程序（AMP）为机器人操作构成了一个有前景的基础。 它们尚未能在任务关键场景中部署，但其他替代方案同样不能。 专门的操作系统策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM），速度相当快但不可靠。 AMP 相当可靠但速度慢。 我们看到了一条通往实用操作的有前景的路径，即以 AMP 为起点，开发既可靠又快速的操作系统。 支持这种乐观态度的一个总体趋势是，实现给定能力水平的成本每年大约下降一个数量级 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 因此，我们可以预期模型调用（AMP 执行中的「思考」部分）的成本会随着时间的推移渐近于零。

sents.en: Notwithstanding these limitations, our results indicate that AMPs constitute a promising foundation for robot manipulation.
sents.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性，我们的结果表明，动作模型程序（AMP）为机器人操作构成了一个有前景的基础。

sents.en: They cannot yet be deployed in mission-critical settings, but neither can the alternatives.
sents.zh: 它们尚未能在任务关键场景中部署，但其他替代方案同样不能。

sents.en: Specialist manipulation policies, such as VLAs and WAMs, are comparably fast but unreliable.
sents.zh: 专门的操作系统策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM），速度相当快但不可靠。

sents.en: AMPs are comparably reliable but slow.
sents.zh: AMP 相当可靠但速度慢。

sents.en: We see a promising path to practical manipulation in using AMPs as a starting point for developing manipulation systems that are both reliable and fast.
sents.zh: 我们看到了一条通往实用操作的有前景的路径，即以 AMP 为起点，开发既可靠又快速的操作系统。

sents.en: A general trend that supports this optimism is that the cost of a given capability level has fallen by roughly an order of magnitude per year [ 26 , 27 ] .
sents.zh: 支持这种乐观态度的一个总体趋势是，实现给定能力水平的成本每年大约下降一个数量级 [ 26 , 27 ] 。

sents.en: Thus we can expect the cost of a model call (the ‘thinking’ part of an AMP’s execution) to asymptote to zero over time.
sents.zh: 因此，我们可以预期模型调用（AMP 执行中的「思考」部分）的成本会随着时间的推移渐近于零。

paragraphs.en: Beyond these general trends, the harness itself offers several avenues for acceleration. Our few-shot and continual learning experiments show that the agent can retain useful code and reduce the number of model calls across episodes ( Sec. 2C ). Reusing these routines avoids repeatedly writing code for calibration, geometric computations, and basic motions. Fast local feedback controllers could be synthesized from AMP experience [ 29 ] . AMP execution traces could also provide supervision for learned policies [ 11 , 31 ] . And the model could plan the next motion while the current one executes, thus overlapping thinking with acting.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些总体趋势之外，测试框架本身还提供了若干加速途径。 我们的少样本和持续学习实验表明，智能体能够保留有用的代码，并减少各回合中的模型调用次数（见第 2C 节）。 复用这些例程可以避免反复编写用于标定、几何计算和基础运动的代码。 可以从 AMP 经验中合成快速局部反馈控制器 [ 29 ] 。 AMP 执行轨迹还可以为学习到的策略提供监督信号 [ 11 , 31 ] 。 此外，模型可以在当前动作执行的同时规划下一个动作，从而让思考与行动重叠进行。

paragraphs.en: At the core of AMP1 is a harness through which a generalist AI model perceives, acts, and reflects ( Fig. 6 ). The harness comprises (a) an SDK that is called by the model from a persistent Python interpreter ( Sec. 4B ); (b) a robot server that serves the SDK’s requests: it returns camera images, depth and the robot’s state, segments the point cloud into objects and tracks them over the episode, and checks and executes the robot’s motion; (c) a route policy that sets which of these requests the harness allows; and (d) reference documentation for the SDK, which is appended to the model’s system prompt. Parts (b) and (c) are omitted from Fig. 6 for clarity.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 的核心是一个框架（harness），通用 AI 模型通过它进行感知、行动和反思（图 6）。 该框架包括：(a) 一个 SDK，由模型从持久化的 Python 解释器中调用（第 4B 节）；(b) 一个机器人服务器，用于响应 SDK 的请求：它返回相机图像、深度图和机器人状态，将点云分割为物体并在整个回合中对其进行跟踪，并检查和执行机器人的运动；(c) 一个路由策略，设定框架允许哪些请求；以及 (d) SDK 的参考文档，该文档被附加到模型的系统提示中。 为清晰起见，图 6 中省略了 (b) 和 (c) 部分。

sents.en: At the core of AMP1 is a harness through which a generalist AI model perceives, acts, and reflects ( Fig. 6 ).
sents.zh: AMP1 的核心是一个框架（harness），通用 AI 模型通过它进行感知、行动和反思（图 6）。

sents.en: The harness comprises (a) an SDK that is called by the model from a persistent Python interpreter ( Sec. 4B ); (b) a robot server that serves the SDK’s requests: it returns camera images, depth and the robot’s state, segments the point cloud into objects and tracks them over the episode, and checks and executes the robot’s motion; (c) a route policy that sets which of these requests the harness allows; and (d) reference documentation for the SDK, which is appended to the model’s system prompt.
sents.zh: 该框架包括：(a) 一个 SDK，由模型从持久化的 Python 解释器中调用（第 4B 节）；(b) 一个机器人服务器，用于响应 SDK 的请求：它返回相机图像、深度图和机器人状态，将点云分割为物体并在整个回合中对其进行跟踪，并检查和执行机器人的运动；(c) 一个路由策略，设定框架允许哪些请求；以及 (d) SDK 的参考文档，该文档被附加到模型的系统提示中。

sents.en: Parts (b) and (c) are omitted from Fig. 6 for clarity.
sents.zh: 为清晰起见，图 6 中省略了 (b) 和 (c) 部分。

paragraphs.en: In zero-shot evaluation, everything the model knows about the task and the robot comes through the harness: the instruction, the camera images, depth and calibration, the robot’s proprioception, the segmented objects, and the remaining control steps and time. The instruction is read by the model through the SDK in its first turn, together with its first view of the scene.
paragraphs.zh: 在零样本评估中，模型对任务和机器人所知的一切都通过框架传入：指令、相机图像、深度与标定信息、机器人自身的本体感觉、分割出的物体，以及剩余的控制步数和时间。 指令由模型在第一轮通过 SDK 读取，同时读取的还有它对场景的第一眼观察。

sents.en: In zero-shot evaluation, everything the model knows about the task and the robot comes through the harness: the instruction, the camera images, depth and calibration, the robot’s proprioception, the segmented objects, and the remaining control steps and time.
sents.zh: 在零样本评估中，模型对任务和机器人所知的一切都通过框架传入：指令、相机图像、深度与标定信息、机器人自身的本体感觉、分割出的物体，以及剩余的控制步数和时间。

sents.en: The instruction is read by the model through the SDK in its first turn, together with its first view of the scene.
sents.zh: 指令由模型在第一轮通过 SDK 读取，同时读取的还有它对场景的第一眼观察。

paragraphs.en: The harness defines two frames for each end-effector. The end-effector (EE) frame is positioned at the base of the gripper. The tool center point (TCP) frame lies at a fixed offset from the EE frame: its origin, the TCP, is centered between the finger pads, and its axes point along the gripper’s approach and closing directions. The model commands motion and defines all grasp geometry at the TCP.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统框架为每个末端执行器定义了两个坐标系。 末端执行器（EE）坐标系位于夹爪的基座处。 工具中心点（TCP）坐标系相对 EE 坐标系处于固定偏移位置：其原点（即 TCP）位于指垫之间的中心，其坐标轴沿夹爪的接近方向和闭合方向。 模型在 TCP 处指令运动并定义所有抓取几何。

sents.en: The harness defines two frames for each end-effector.
sents.zh: 该系统框架为每个末端执行器定义了两个坐标系。

sents.en: The end-effector (EE) frame is positioned at the base of the gripper.
sents.zh: 末端执行器（EE）坐标系位于夹爪的基座处。

sents.en: The tool center point (TCP) frame lies at a fixed offset from the EE frame: its origin, the TCP, is centered between the finger pads, and its axes point along the gripper’s approach and closing directions.
sents.zh: 工具中心点（TCP）坐标系相对 EE 坐标系处于固定偏移位置：其原点（即 TCP）位于指垫之间的中心，其坐标轴沿夹爪的接近方向和闭合方向。

sents.en: The model commands motion and defines all grasp geometry at the TCP.
sents.zh: 模型在 TCP 处指令运动并定义所有抓取几何。

paragraphs.en: We describe the SDK’s functions in three groups: sensing, perception, and motion. Motion comes in two harness variants: the basic harness, our default, in which the model itself commands timed TCP waypoints with gripper commands, and the assistive harness, which adds grasping and placing routines to the basic functions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SDK 的功能分为三组进行介绍：感知（sensing）、知觉（perception）和运动（motion）。 运动功能提供两种工具变体：基础工具是我们的默认配置，由模型本身结合夹爪指令来发出定时的 TCP 路径点指令；辅助工具则在基础功能之上增加了抓取和放置例程。

sents.en: We describe the SDK’s functions in three groups: sensing, perception, and motion.
sents.zh: 我们将 SDK 的功能分为三组进行介绍：感知（sensing）、知觉（perception）和运动（motion）。

sents.en: Motion comes in two harness variants: the basic harness, our default, in which the model itself commands timed TCP waypoints with gripper commands, and the assistive harness, which adds grasping and placing routines to the basic functions.
sents.zh: 运动功能提供两种工具变体：基础工具是我们的默认配置，由模型本身结合夹爪指令来发出定时的 TCP 路径点指令；辅助工具则在基础功能之上增加了抓取和放置例程。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 observes the scene and the robot only through SDK calls in the code it implements, and thus the model decides what to observe and when. The only information added to every result the model receives from executing its code are the remaining control steps and wall-clock time. The model may observe the scene arbitrarily often and it may also execute a motion without prior observation and verify its outcome afterwards from the robot’s state and camera images.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 仅通过其所实现代码中的 SDK 调用来观察场景和机器人，因此由模型决定观察什么以及何时观察。 在模型执行代码所得到的每个结果中，唯一附加的信息是剩余的控制步数和真实时间（wall-clock time）。 模型可以任意频繁地观察场景，也可以在不事先观察的情况下执行一次动作，并在事后通过机器人的状态和相机图像来验证其结果。

sents.en: AMP1 observes the scene and the robot only through SDK calls in the code it implements, and thus the model decides what to observe and when.
sents.zh: AMP1 仅通过其所实现代码中的 SDK 调用来观察场景和机器人，因此由模型决定观察什么以及何时观察。

sents.en: The only information added to every result the model receives from executing its code are the remaining control steps and wall-clock time.
sents.zh: 在模型执行代码所得到的每个结果中，唯一附加的信息是剩余的控制步数和真实时间（wall-clock time）。

sents.en: The model may observe the scene arbitrarily often and it may also execute a motion without prior observation and verify its outcome afterwards from the robot’s state and camera images.
sents.zh: 模型可以任意频繁地观察场景，也可以在不事先观察的情况下执行一次动作，并在事后通过机器人的状态和相机图像来验证其结果。

paragraphs.en: The model reads the instruction, the maximum number of control steps in an episode, and the steps that remain. Since the episode terminates when its horizon is reached, the model can plan its motion against it. It can also read the robot specification such as its cameras, its workspace, the joint limits and the default configuration, and, for each end effector, its gripper geometry and TCP frame.
paragraphs.zh: 模型会读取指令、一个回合中控制步数的上限以及剩余的步数。 由于回合在到达其时间跨度时终止，模型可以据此规划自身的运动。 它还可以读取机器人规格说明，例如其相机、工作空间、关节限制和默认配置，以及每个末端执行器的夹爪几何结构和 TCP 坐标系。

sents.en: The model reads the instruction, the maximum number of control steps in an episode, and the steps that remain.
sents.zh: 模型会读取指令、一个回合中控制步数的上限以及剩余的步数。

sents.en: Since the episode terminates when its horizon is reached, the model can plan its motion against it.
sents.zh: 由于回合在到达其时间跨度时终止，模型可以据此规划自身的运动。

sents.en: It can also read the robot specification such as its cameras, its workspace, the joint limits and the default configuration, and, for each end effector, its gripper geometry and TCP frame.
sents.zh: 它还可以读取机器人规格说明，例如其相机、工作空间、关节限制和默认配置，以及每个末端执行器的夹爪几何结构和 TCP 坐标系。

paragraphs.en: The robot’s state comprises the measured joint positions q ~ ∈ ℝ n \tilde{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n} and the poses of the EE and TCP frames in the robot’s base frame; we denote the measured TCP pose by T ~ ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) \tilde{T}\in SE(3) . It also includes the gripper state g ~ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tilde{g}\in[0,1] (0 open, 1 closed) and the last gripper command g ∈ { 0 , 1 } g\in\{0,1\} .
paragraphs.zh: 机器人的状态包括测量得到的关节位置 q ~ ∈ ℝ n \tilde{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}，以及在机器人基座坐标系下表示的末端执行器（EE）与工具中心点（TCP）坐标系的位姿；我们将测量得到的 TCP 位姿记为 T ~ ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) \tilde{T}\in SE(3) 。 该状态还包括夹爪状态 g ~ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tilde{g}\in[0,1]（0 表示张开，1 表示闭合）以及最近一次夹爪指令 g ∈ { 0 , 1 } g\in\{0,1\} 。

sents.zh: 机器人的状态包括测量得到的关节位置 q ~ ∈ ℝ n \tilde{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}，以及在机器人基座坐标系下表示的末端执行器（EE）与工具中心点（TCP）坐标系的位姿；我们将测量得到的 TCP 位姿记为 T ~ ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) \tilde{T}\in SE(3) 。

sents.en: It also includes the gripper state g ~ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tilde{g}\in[0,1] (0 open, 1 closed) and the last gripper command g ∈ { 0 , 1 } g\in\{0,1\} .
sents.zh: 该状态还包括夹爪状态 g ~ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tilde{g}\in[0,1]（0 表示张开，1 表示闭合）以及最近一次夹爪指令 g ∈ { 0 , 1 } g\in\{0,1\} 。

paragraphs.en: For each camera, the model can read its RGB image, a depth image subsampled from the RGB image’s resolution by a fixed stride, the intrinsics K K , and the camera’s current pose T base , cam ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}\in SE(3) in the robot’s base frame. Helper functions convert between the image and 3D coordinates. One projects a 3D point into the image through T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} and K K , returning its pixel coordinates and its depth along the optical axis, and another inverts this projection for a given pixel and depth. The model can also request a colored point cloud combined from all cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个相机，模型可以读取其 RGB 图像、通过固定步长从 RGB 图像分辨率降采样得到的深度图像、内参 K K，以及相机在机器人基座坐标系下的当前位姿 T base , cam ∈ S E ( 3 ) T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}\in SE(3)。 辅助函数可以在图像坐标与三维坐标之间进行转换。 其中一个函数通过 T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} 和 K K 将三维点投影到图像中，返回其像素坐标及沿光轴的深度；另一个函数则针对给定的像素和深度进行该投影的逆运算。 智能体还可以请求获取由所有相机合并而成的彩色点云。

sents.zh: 对于每个相机，模型可以读取其 RGB 图像、通过固定步长从 RGB 图像分辨率降采样得到的深度图像、内参 K K，以及相机在机器人基座坐标系下的当前位姿 T base , cam ∈ S E ( 3 ) T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}\in SE(3)。

sents.en: Helper functions convert between the image and 3D coordinates.
sents.zh: 辅助函数可以在图像坐标与三维坐标之间进行转换。

sents.en: One projects a 3D point into the image through T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} and K K , returning its pixel coordinates and its depth along the optical axis, and another inverts this projection for a given pixel and depth.
sents.zh: 其中一个函数通过 T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} 和 K K 将三维点投影到图像中，返回其像素坐标及沿光轴的深度；另一个函数则针对给定的像素和深度进行该投影的逆运算。

sents.en: The model can also request a colored point cloud combined from all cameras.
sents.zh: 智能体还可以请求获取由所有相机合并而成的彩色点云。

paragraphs.en: With the rendering functions provided by the harness, the model can compose its own views of the scene from these inputs and the perceived objects. It can draw 3D elements, such as points, boxes, object identifiers, target poses or a planned motion, onto a real camera image by projecting them through T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} and K K , for example to check whether a planned grasp is aligned with the object. It can also render a point cloud, perceived objects, and the robot from any virtual viewpoint, and request a close-up of an object that combines renders from viewpoints around the object. All of these views are built from the robot’s own sensor data and the perceived scene model ( Sec. 4A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 借助运行框架提供的渲染功能，模型可以从这些输入以及感知到的物体自行构建对场景的视图。 它可以通过 T base , cam − 1 T_{\mathrm{base,cam}}^{-1} 和 K K 将三维元素（如点、包围盒、物体标识符、目标位姿或规划的运动）投影并绘制到真实相机图像上，例如用于检查规划的抓取是否与物体对齐。 它还可以从任意虚拟视角渲染点云、感知到的物体和机器人，并请求某个物体的特写视图，该视图结合了围绕该物体多个视角的渲染结果。 所有这些视图均由机器人自身的传感器数据和感知到的场景模型构建（见第 4A.2 节）。

sents.en: With the rendering functions provided by the harness, the model can compose its own views of the scene from these inputs and the perceived objects.
sents.zh: 借助运行框架提供的渲染功能，模型可以从这些输入以及感知到的物体自行构建对场景的视图。

sents.zh: 它还可以从任意虚拟视角渲染点云、感知到的物体和机器人，并请求某个物体的特写视图，该视图结合了围绕该物体多个视角的渲染结果。

sents.zh: 所有这些视图均由机器人自身的传感器数据和感知到的场景模型构建（见第 4A.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: An image enters the model’s context only when the model chooses to look at it; that is, when its code displays the image. Every displayed image is also saved. Once the context exceeds a fixed number or total size of images, the oldest are replaced by pointers to their saved files, and the model can reload any of them with a dedicated tool. The model can also keep information from earlier turns, such as images and depth maps, in its persistent interpreter, for example to compare a scene before and after a motion.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当模型选择查看某张图像时，即其代码显示该图像时，图像才会进入模型的上下文。 每张被显示的图像也会被保存。 一旦上下文中的图像数量或总大小超过固定限制，最旧的图像就会被替换为指向其已保存文件的指针，模型可以通过专用工具重新加载其中任何一张。 模型还可以将先前轮次的信息（例如图像和深度图）保存在其持久化解释器中，例如用于比较某个场景在运动前后的变化。

sents.en: An image enters the model’s context only when the model chooses to look at it; that is, when its code displays the image.
sents.zh: 只有当模型选择查看某张图像时，即其代码显示该图像时，图像才会进入模型的上下文。

sents.en: Every displayed image is also saved.
sents.zh: 每张被显示的图像也会被保存。

sents.en: Once the context exceeds a fixed number or total size of images, the oldest are replaced by pointers to their saved files, and the model can reload any of them with a dedicated tool.
sents.zh: 一旦上下文中的图像数量或总大小超过固定限制，最旧的图像就会被替换为指向其已保存文件的指针，模型可以通过专用工具重新加载其中任何一张。

sents.en: The model can also keep information from earlier turns, such as images and depth maps, in its persistent interpreter, for example to compare a scene before and after a motion.
sents.zh: 模型还可以将先前轮次的信息（例如图像和深度图）保存在其持久化解释器中，例如用于比较某个场景在运动前后的变化。

paragraphs.en: The harness maintains a scene model, a set of objects o j o_{j} , each occupying a region M j ⊂ ℝ 3 M_{j}\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} . It segments a fused point cloud into voxel clusters and extrudes the height map of each cluster into a closed mesh that bounds M j M_{j} . The union of these regions forms the obstacle region 𝒪 = ⋃ j M j \mathcal{O}=\bigcup_{j}M_{j} against which collisions are checked. The generalist AI model can exclude objects (such as the one it is about to grasp) from a collision check. A stereo matching model can be used to estimate depth from stereo images ( Sec. 4F ).
paragraphs.zh: 该框架维护一个场景模型，即一组物体 o j o_{j}，每个物体占据一个区域 M j ⊂ ℝ 3 M_{j}\subset\mathbb{R}^{3}。 它将融合后的点云分割为体素簇，并将每个簇的高度图拉伸为一个包围 M j M_{j} 的封闭网格。 这些区域的并集构成障碍物区域 𝒪 = ⋃ j M j \mathcal{O}=\bigcup_{j}M_{j}，用于进行碰撞检测。 通用人工智能模型可以将某些物体（例如它即将抓取的物体）从碰撞检测中排除。 立体匹配模型可用于从立体图像中估计深度（见第 4F 节）。

paragraphs.en: At each update of the scene model, the harness voxelizes the fused point cloud and clusters the voxels into candidate objects as connected components of adjacent voxels. The clustering stops where one object touches another and at sharp color discontinuities. Small fragments, such as an isolated face, are merged into a larger nearby segment of similar color, and close segments of the same color are joined. Segments that remain very small are dropped as noise. Each object is then represented as a closed mesh by extruding its top surface downwards to its lowest observed point. Occluded gaps in the top surface are filled unless the cameras have seen them. Geometry is therefore inferred from depth, while color serves as a secondary criterion that separates touching objects.
paragraphs.zh: 在场景模型的每次更新中，测试框架将融合后的点云体素化，并将体素聚类为候选物体，即相邻体素构成的连通分量。 聚类在一个物体接触另一个物体处以及颜色剧烈不连续处停止。 小碎片（例如一个孤立的表面）会被合并到附近颜色相近的更大片段中，颜色相同且彼此接近的片段会被连接起来。 仍然非常小的片段会被作为噪声丢弃。 随后，每个物体通过将其顶面向下延伸至其观测到的最低点，表示为一个封闭网格。 除非相机已经看到过顶面中被遮挡的空隙，否则这些空隙会被填补。 因此几何形状由深度推断得出，而颜色则作为区分相互接触物体的次要标准。

paragraphs.en: The scene model is updated in the background whenever a new camera frame is available and no motion is running, before every collision check, and whenever the generalist AI model requests it. Each object o j o_{j} has a unique identifier, a label naming its color and dimensions, its centroid, axis aligned and oriented bounding boxes, and the mesh bounding M j M_{j} . The generalist AI model can list objects, read their points, size and color, filter them by label, color or size, and sort them by distance to a 3D point.
paragraphs.zh: 每当有新的相机帧可用且没有运动正在运行时、在每次碰撞检查之前、以及 whenever 通用人工智能模型发出请求时，场景模型都会在后台进行更新。 每个对象 o j o_{j} 都有一个唯一标识符、一个描述其颜色和尺寸的标签、其质心、轴对齐和有向包围盒，以及网格边界 M j M_{j} 。 通用人工智能模型可以列出对象、读取它们的点位、尺寸和颜色、按标签、颜色或尺寸过滤它们，并按到某个 3D 点的距离对它们排序。

paragraphs.en: Each update matches its objects to those in the previous update by a minimal cost assignment, which pairs two objects only if their centroids lie within a distance d m d_{\mathrm{m}} and their colors and sizes agree within tolerances; a matched object keeps its identifier. When an object is merged with another, split, or keeps its place but no longer matches because its appearance changed, its old identifier resolves to the object that now covers most of its footprint, while an object that moved farther than d m d_{\mathrm{m}} receives a new identifier. An object that is not seen in an observation update, for example, because the arm occludes it, leaves the scene model, but its identifier is reserved for a fixed time. An object of similar color and size that reappears within d m d_{\mathrm{m}} of where it was last seen receives the old identifier. Each update also reports what it removed and changed, so that the generalist AI model can follow how the scene model evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 每次更新通过一次最小代价分配将其中的物体与上一次更新中的物体进行匹配，只有当两个物体质心之间的距离在 d m d_{\mathrm{m}} 以内，且其颜色和尺寸在容差范围内一致时才会配对；匹配成功的物体会保留其标识符。 当一个物体与另一物体合并、发生分裂，或位置不变但因外观变化而不再匹配时，其旧标识符会解析到如今覆盖其大部分足迹的物体，而移动距离超过 d m d_{\mathrm{m}} 的物体会获得一个新的标识符。 在观测更新中未被看到的物体（例如被机械臂遮挡）会离开场景模型，但其标识符会被保留一段固定时间。 如果一个颜色和尺寸相似的物体在距其上次被看到位置 d m d_{\mathrm{m}} 范围内重新出现，它将获得旧的标识符。 每次更新还会报告其移除和更改的内容，以便通用人工智能模型能够跟踪场景模型的演变过程。

paragraphs.en: The generalist AI model can also correct the scene model. It can grow an object from a single pixel through neighboring points. It can define an object from an axis-aligned or oriented box or from a set of points. And it can replace and remove wrong or spurious objects. Objects that are added by the generalist AI model persist across perception updates and take precedence over the perceived objects they overlap. The system prompt warns the generalist AI model that perception can merge touching objects, split one object in two, or fill in hidden parts incorrectly. It instructs the generalist AI model to check the perceived objects against the camera images and, when they are incorrect, to repair the scene model with these tools rather than compensate for the error in its plans. After every motion, the generalist AI model is instructed to update the scene model and look at the cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 通用人工智能模型也可以修正场景模型。 它可以通过相邻点从一个像素开始生长出物体。 它可以用轴对齐框、有向框或一组点来定义物体。 它还可以替换和移除错误或虚假的物体。 由通用人工智能模型添加的物体会跨感知更新持续存在，并优先于与之重叠的感知物体。 系统提示词提醒通用人工智能模型：感知可能会将相互接触的物体合并为一个、把一个物体一分为二，或者错误地补全被遮挡的部分。 系统提示词指示通用人工智能模型对照相机图像检查感知到的物体，当发现不正确时，使用这些工具修复场景模型，而不是在其规划中补偿该错误。 每次运动之后，通用人工智能模型都会被指示更新场景模型并查看相机画面。

paragraphs.en: The generalist AI model writes code that produces a trajectory of TCP poses with gripper commands, given as timed waypoints w i = ( T i , t i , g i ) {w_{i}=(T_{i},t_{i},g_{i})} , i = 1 , … , N i=1,\dots,N . Each waypoint consists of (a) a desired TCP pose T i = ( p i , R i ) ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) T_{i}=(p_{i},R_{i})\in SE(3) in the robot’s base frame, with position p i ∈ ℝ 3 p_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} and orientation R i ∈ S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) R_{i}\in SO(3) , (b) the desired arrival time t i t_{i} , and (c) a gripper command g i ∈ { 0 , 1 } g_{i}\in\{0,1\} (open or closed). The model typically constructs each waypoint’s TCP pose relative to a reference it has measured, such as the current TCP pose, an object’s centroid, or the pose of another waypoint, using helper functions that either build a pose from a position and an approach direction (for example, top-down at a given yaw) or shift a pose along its own axes. The harness provides no function that chooses grasps or placements; those decisions are left to the generalist model. For a bimanual robot, the model generates a sequence of waypoints for each arm.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型 AI 模型编写代码，生成由夹爪指令伴随的 TCP 位姿轨迹，以带时间戳的路径点 w i = ( T i , t i , g i ) {w_{i}=(T_{i},t_{i},g_{i})} 、i = 1, …, N i=1,\dots,N 的形式给出。 每个路径点由以下部分组成：(a) 机器人基坐标系下的期望 TCP 位姿 T i = ( p i , R i ) ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) T_{i}=(p_{i},R_{i})\in SE(3)，其中位置 p i ∈ ℝ 3 p_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3}、姿态 R i ∈ S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) R_{i}\in SO(3)；(b) 期望到达时间 t i t_{i}；(c) 夹爪指令 g i ∈ { 0 , 1 } g_{i}\in\{0,1\}（张开或闭合）。 模型通常基于其测量到的参考来构建每个路径点的 TCP 位姿，例如当前 TCP 位姿、物体的质心或另一路径点的位姿，并借助辅助函数实现：这些函数要么由位置和接近方向（例如给定偏航角的俯视朝向）构建位姿，要么沿位姿自身的坐标轴对位姿进行平移。 系统框架不提供任何选择抓取或放置的函数；这些决策留给通用型模型。 对于双臂机器人，模型为每条机械臂各生成一段路径点序列。

Starting from the current TCP pose T 0 = ( p 0 , R 0 ) = f ⁡ ( q 0 ) T_{0}=(p_{0},R_{0})=f(q_{0}) at t 0 = 0 t_{0}=0 , where f : 𝒞 → S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) f\colon\mathcal{C}\to SE(3) is the forward kinematics, the harness interpolates between consecutive waypoints, treating position and orientation separately rather than as a single screw motion (the decoupled path of Sec. 9.2.1 in [ 55 ] ). sents.zh: 基于这些路径点，测试框架计算关节空间轨迹 τ : [ 0 , t N ] → 𝒞 \tau\colon[0,t_{N}]\to\mathcal{C} ，其中 𝒞 ⊂ ℝ n \mathcal{C}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} 是机器人 n n 个关节的构型空间，构型为 q ∈ 𝒞 q\in\mathcal{C} 。

sents.zh: 从当前 TCP 位姿 T 0 = ( p 0 , R 0 ) = f ⁡ ( q 0 ) T_{0}=(p_{0},R_{0})=f(q_{0}) 在 t 0 = 0 t_{0}=0 处开始，其中 f : 𝒞 → S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) f\colon\mathcal{C}\to SE(3) 为正向运动学，测试框架在相邻路径点之间进行插值，将位置与姿态分开处理而非作为单一的螺旋运动（即 [ 55 ] 中 9.2.1 节的解耦路径）。

paragraphs.en: At every control step k k of duration Δ ​ t \Delta t , the harness computes q k = τ ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) {q_{k}=\tau(k\,\Delta t)} by damped least squares inverse kinematics of T ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) = ( p ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) , R ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) ) {T(k\,\Delta t)=(p(k\,\Delta t),R(k\,\Delta t))} , seeded with q k − 1 q_{k-1} . The numerical inverse kinematics solver always returns the best configuration q k q_{k} it can find for an interpolated pose T ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) T(k\,\Delta t) , but when the pose is unreachable or the solver does not converge, q k q_{k} reaches it only approximately. The harness therefore validates the trajectory and executes it only if the following conditions hold at every step k k . First, the position and orientation errors between f ⁡ ( q k ) f(q_{k}) and T ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) T(k\,\Delta t) must lie within specified tolerances. Second, each joint’s speed must stay below its speed limit. Approaching near the end of a joint’s range of motion or near a singularity only sends a warning to the model. Additionally, the model can also test whether τ \tau lies in 𝒞 free = 𝒞 ∖ 𝒞 obs \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{free}}=\mathcal{C}\setminus\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{obs}} , where 𝒞 obs = { q ∈ 𝒞 ∣ 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) ∩ 𝒪 ≠ ∅ } \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{obs}}=\{q\in\mathcal{C}\mid\mathcal{A}(q)\cap\mathcal{O}\neq\emptyset\} , by checking configurations it samples from τ \tau . Here, 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) ⊂ ℝ 3 \mathcal{A}(q)\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} is the region occupied by the robot at configuration q q , which the harness approximates by spheres covering the arm and the gripper, and 𝒪 \mathcal{O} is the obstacle region formed by the perceived objects ( Sec. 4A.2 ). A refused trajectory is returned with the reason and the affected steps, so that the model can repair it. Before planning a motion, the model can also test whether a single pose is reachable, with the same tolerances.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个持续时间为 Δ t \Delta t 的控制步 k k 中，框架通过阻尼最小二乘逆运动学计算 q k = τ ⁡ ( k Δ t ) {q_{k}=\tau(k\,\Delta t)} ，其目标为 T ⁡ ( k Δ t ) = ( p ⁡ ( k Δ t ) , R ⁡ ( k Δ t ) ) {T(k\,\Delta t)=(p(k\,\Delta t),R(k\,\Delta t))} ，并以 q k − 1 q_{k-1} 作为初值。 数值逆运动学求解器总是返回它能为插值位姿 T ⁡ ( k Δ t ) T(k\,\Delta t) 找到的最优构型 q k q_{k} ，但当位姿不可达或求解器不收敛时， q k q_{k} 只能近似达到该位姿。 因此，框架会对轨迹进行验证，只有当下列条件在每个步 k k 都成立时才执行该轨迹。 第一， f ⁡ ( q k ) f(q_{k}) 与 T ⁡ ( k Δ t ) T(k\,\Delta t) 之间的位置和姿态误差必须处于规定的容差范围内。 第二，每个关节的速度必须保持在速度限制之下。 当接近关节运动范围的边界或接近奇异点时，只会向模型发送警告。 此外，模型还可以通过检查从 τ \tau 中采样得到的构型，来测试 τ \tau 是否位于 𝒞 free = 𝒞 ∖ 𝒞 obs \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{free}}=\mathcal{C}\setminus\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{obs}} 中，其中 𝒞 obs = { q ∈ 𝒞 ∣ 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) ∩ 𝒪 ≠ ∅ } \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{obs}}=\{q\in\mathcal{C}\mid\mathcal{A}(q)\cap\mathcal{O}\neq\emptyset\} 。 这里， 𝒜 ⁡ ( q ) ⊂ ℝ 3 \mathcal{A}(q)\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} 是机器人在构型 q q 下占据的区域，框架用覆盖机械臂和夹爪的球体来近似该区域，而 𝒪 \mathcal{O} 是由感知到的物体构成的障碍区域（第 4A.2 节）。 被拒绝的轨迹会连同原因和受影响的步骤一起返回，以便模型进行修复。 在规划运动之前，模型还可以在相同容差下测试单个位姿是否可达。

sents.en: First, the position and orientation errors between f ⁡ ( q k ) f(q_{k}) and T ⁡ ( k ​ Δ ​ t ) T(k\,\Delta t) must lie within specified tolerances.

paragraphs.en: Once the entire trajectory has passed these checks, the harness executes it by sending the robot the computed absolute joint position targets, one q k q_{k} per control step, each with the current gripper command.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦整条轨迹通过了这些检查，测试框架便会执行该轨迹：向机器人发送计算好的绝对关节位置目标，每个控制步发送一个 q k q_{k}，并同时附上当前的夹爪指令。

paragraphs.en: The agent acts primarily through a Python interpreter, which executes the code implemented by the model in a kernel that persists during the entire episode. The kernel keeps imports, variables, and the functions the model defines between calls, so that the information it generates in one turn can be reused in later ones. Each call returns the code’s printed output, any error with its traceback, and the images the code displays, followed by the remaining control steps and wall-clock time. The model reads the result at the start of its next turn. The model has a number of auxiliary tools in addition to the interpreter, such as reloading an image saved earlier, and ending the episode.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体主要通过一个 Python 解释器来执行操作，该解释器在一个在整个回合期间持续存在的内核中运行模型实现的代码。 该内核在多次调用之间保留导入项、变量以及模型定义的函数，使得它在某一轮中生成的信息可以在后续轮次中被复用。 每次调用会返回代码打印的输出、任何错误及其堆栈跟踪，以及代码显示的图像，随后返回剩余的控制步数和实际运行时间。 模型在其下一轮开始时读取该结果。 除解释器外，模型还拥有若干辅助工具，例如重新加载先前保存的图像，以及结束该回合。

paragraphs.en: In the basic harness, the motion interface only previews, checks, and executes waypoints and gripper commands. Everything in between – from choosing a grasp to measuring a container, pushing an object, or recovering from a refused trajectory – the model implements itself, combining SDK calls with its own geometry code. In zero-shot evaluation, each episode starts from a new sandboxed kernel, so the model writes its skills from scratch every time. Section S3 in the Supplementary Materials shows how the model builds such skills during one episode, turn by turn. When learning from experience, the model can decide to save its skills into the memory store ℳ \mathcal{M} ( Sec. 2C ).
paragraphs.zh: 在基础框架中，运动接口仅用于预览、检查和执行路径点与夹爪指令。 中间的所有环节——从选择抓取方式到测量容器、推动物体或从被拒绝的轨迹中恢复——均由模型自行实现，将 SDK 调用与其自身的几何代码相结合。 在零样本评估中，每个回合都从一个新的沙盒化内核开始，因此模型每次都要从头编写其技能。 补充材料中的 S3 节展示了模型在一个回合内如何逐步构建此类技能。 在从经验中学习时，模型可以决定将其技能保存到记忆库 ℳ \mathcal{M} 中（见第 2C 节）。

paragraphs.en: RoboLab-120 comprises 120 language-specified pick-and-place tasks simulated in Isaac Sim [ 22 ] . Each task is posed with three variants of its instruction: default, vague, and specific.
paragraphs.zh: RoboLab-120 包含 120 个在 Isaac Sim [22] 中仿真的、以语言指定的抓取放置任务。 每个任务都有三种指令变体：默认、模糊和具体。

paragraphs.en: The robot is a simulated Franka Panda arm in the DROID configuration, with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, mounted at a table. Physics runs at 120 Hz and control at 15 Hz. Each action specifies seven absolute joint positions and a gripper command. Two fixed over-the-shoulder cameras and a wrist camera render 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 images, with horizontal fields of view of about 104 ∘ 104^{\circ} and 88 ∘ 88^{\circ} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人是一个 DROID 配置下仿真的 Franka Panda 机械臂，配有 Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪，安装在桌子上。 物理仿真以 120 Hz 运行，控制以 15 Hz 运行。 每个动作指定七个绝对关节位置和一个夹爪指令。 两个固定的肩上相机和一个腕部相机渲染 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 的图像，水平视场角分别约为 104 ∘ 104^{\circ} 和 88 ∘ 88^{\circ} 。

sents.zh: 两个固定的肩上相机和一个腕部相机渲染 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 的图像，水平视场角分别约为 104 ∘ 104^{\circ} 和 88 ∘ 88^{\circ} 。

paragraphs.en: Following the benchmark’s published protocol, we run 10 episodes per task (i.e., 1,200 in total) for each of the three instruction variants. All episodes of a task start from the same initial scene, so they differ only through the policy and simulator nondeterminism. An episode succeeds at the first step at which the task’s success condition holds, and fails if the task’s time limit, between 20 and 300 s of simulated time, expires first. The simulation is paused while the agent reasons, perceives, and plans, so only executed motion counts against this limit. The agent receives the robot model (kinematics, joint limits, and collision geometry). Depth is rendered without noise, and camera intrinsics and extrinsics are exact.
paragraphs.zh: 按照该基准测试公布的协议，我们对三种指令变体中的每一种，每个任务运行 10 个回合（即总计 1,200 个回合）。 一个任务的所有回合都从相同的初始场景开始，因此它们仅在策略和模拟器的非确定性上存在差异。 当任务的成功条件在某一时刻成立时，该回合即在该步成功；若任务的时限（模拟时间 20 到 300 秒之间）先到期，则该回合失败。 在智能体进行推理、感知和规划时，模拟会被暂停，因此只有执行的动作才计入该时限。 智能体会接收机器人模型（运动学、关节限制和碰撞几何）。 深度渲染不带噪声，且相机的内参和外参都是精确的。

paragraphs.en: CaP-Gym [ 18 ] wraps three simulation benchmarks behind a common interface: LIBERO-PRO [ 32 ] , robosuite [ 33 ] , and BEHAVIOR-1K [ 34 ] . Following the published protocol, we evaluate three of the four LIBERO-PRO suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-Spatial), all seven robosuite tasks, and two BEHAVIOR-1K tasks.
paragraphs.zh: CaP-Gym [18] 将三个仿真基准封装在统一接口之下：LIBERO-PRO [32]、robosuite [33] 和 BEHAVIOR-1K [34]。 按照已发布的协议，我们评估了 LIBERO-PRO 四个套件中的三个（LIBERO-Object、LIBERO-Goal 和 LIBERO-Spatial）、全部七个 robosuite 任务以及两个 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务。

sents.en: CaP-Gym [ 18 ] wraps three simulation benchmarks behind a common interface: LIBERO-PRO [ 32 ] , robosuite [ 33 ] , and BEHAVIOR-1K [ 34 ] .
sents.zh: CaP-Gym [18] 将三个仿真基准封装在统一接口之下：LIBERO-PRO [32]、robosuite [33] 和 BEHAVIOR-1K [34]。

sents.en: Following the published protocol, we evaluate three of the four LIBERO-PRO suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-Spatial), all seven robosuite tasks, and two BEHAVIOR-1K tasks.
sents.zh: 按照已发布的协议，我们评估了 LIBERO-PRO 四个套件中的三个（LIBERO-Object、LIBERO-Goal 和 LIBERO-Spatial）、全部七个 robosuite 任务以及两个 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务。

paragraphs.en: The embodiment differs across benchmarks. LIBERO-PRO and robosuite simulate a Franka Panda arm with its standard parallel-jaw gripper in MuJoCo [ 56 ] . Physics runs at 500 Hz and control at 20 Hz. Each action specifies seven absolute joint positions and a gripper command. In robosuite, the two bimanual tasks use two opposing Panda arms. (The ‘spill wipe’ task replaces the gripper with a wiping tool.) BEHAVIOR-1K simulates a Galaxea R1Pro mobile manipulator in OmniGibson on Isaac Sim, with a holonomic base, a four-joint torso, and two seven-joint arms with parallel-jaw grippers, controlled at 30 Hz. LIBERO-PRO uses a fixed camera and a wrist camera at 800 × 512 800\times 512 . robosuite uses a single camera at 512 × 512 512\times 512 . BEHAVIOR-1K uses a head camera and two wrist cameras at 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
paragraphs.zh: 该实现在不同基准测试中有所差异。 LIBERO-PRO 和 robosuite 在 MuJoCo [ 56 ] 中模拟 Franka Panda 机械臂及其标准平行夹爪。 物理仿真以 500 Hz 运行，控制以 20 Hz 运行。 每个动作指定七个绝对关节位置和一个夹爪命令。 在 robosuite 中，两个双手机器人任务使用两条相对布置的 Panda 机械臂。 （“spill wipe”任务用擦拭工具替换夹爪。）BEHAVIOR-1K 在 Isaac Sim 上的 OmniGibson 中模拟 Galaxea R1Pro 移动操作机器人，其底座为全向底盘，躯干有四个关节，两条机械臂各有七个关节并配备平行夹爪，以 30 Hz 进行控制。 LIBERO-PRO 使用一个固定相机和一个腕部相机，分辨率均为 800 × 512 800\times 512 。robosuite 使用单个相机，分辨率为 512 × 512 512\times 512 。 BEHAVIOR-1K 使用一个头部相机和两个腕部相机，分辨率均为 512 × 512 512\times 512 。

paragraphs.en: We follow CaP-Gym’s environment protocol, including its tasks, controllers, cameras, step horizon, and success checks. LIBERO-PRO perturbs each of its 30 tasks in two ways, swapping object positions or changing the instruction to name a different object, yielding 60 tasks with 50 trials each (i.e., 3,000 episodes). Robosuite runs 100 trials per task (i.e., 700 episodes), with object positions randomized at every reset. BEHAVIOR-1K runs 25 trials per task (i.e., 50 episodes), each starting from a fixed, pre-sampled scene instance. Each episode is limited by the environment’s step horizon: 8,000 steps for LIBERO-PRO and 1,000–5,000 for robosuite. BEHAVIOR-1K has no step horizon and is bounded only by wall-clock time. As in RoboLab, the simulation is paused while the agent reasons, so only executed motion counts against the horizon. Depth and camera calibration are part of CaP-Gym’s observations. Depth is rendered without noise, and camera intrinsics and extrinsics are exact.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 CaP-Gym 的环境协议，包括其任务、控制器、相机、步数上限和成功判定。 LIBERO-PRO 以两种方式对其 30 个任务中的每一个进行扰动：交换物体位置，或将指令改为指称另一个物体，从而得到 60 个任务，每个任务 50 次试验（即 3,000 个回合）。 Robosuite 每个任务运行 100 次试验（即 700 个回合），并在每次重置时随机化物体位置。 BEHAVIOR-1K 每个任务运行 25 次试验（即 50 个回合），每个回合都从一个固定的、预先采样的场景实例开始。 每个回合都受环境的步数上限限制：LIBERO-PRO 为 8,000 步，robosuite 为 1,000–5,000 步。 BEHAVIOR-1K 没有步数上限，仅受挂钟时间限制。 与 RoboLab 一样，仿真会在智能体推理时暂停，因此只有实际执行的动作计入步数上限。 深度和相机标定是 CaP-Gym 观测的一部分。 深度渲染不含噪声，相机内参和外参均为精确值。

paragraphs.en: RoboDojo [ 25 ] comprises 42 bimanual manipulation tasks simulated in Isaac Sim, grouped into five categories: generalization (12 tasks), memory (6), long-horizon (8), precision (8), and open-ended (8).
paragraphs.zh: RoboDojo [ 25 ] 包含在 Isaac Sim 中模拟的 42 个双臂操作任务，分为五个类别：泛化（12 个任务）、记忆（6 个）、长时程（8 个）、精细操作（8 个）和开放式（8 个）。

paragraphs.en: The robot consists of two ARX X5 arms with six joints and a parallel-jaw gripper on each, mounted at fixed bases on a table. Physics runs at 250 Hz and control at 25 Hz. Each action specifies six absolute joint positions and a gripper command per arm. A head camera and two wrist cameras render 640 × 480 640\times 480 images, with horizontal fields of view of about 96 ∘ 96^{\circ} and 78 ∘ 78^{\circ} , respectively.

paragraphs.en: We conduct our few-shot learning and continual learning experiments on RoboDojo ( Sec. 2C ). The benchmark defines three public evaluation seeds (0, 1, and 2), each specifying 50 predetermined layouts per task with variations in objects, their positions, backgrounds, and clutter. We use seed 0 for experience collection. In few-shot learning, practice is run five times per task, and the run with the highest success rate in seed 1 is selected for each task. In both few-shot and continual learning, we report success rates on seed 2. We calculate the success rate as the public leaderboard does. Each category’s success rate is the mean over its tasks, and the overall success rate is the mean over the five categories. Confidence intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over tasks, resampled within each category. As in RoboLab, simulation is paused while the agent reasons. We follow the input protocol of the GPT-6 Astra entry on the public leaderboard, submitted by the RoboDojo authors [ 57 ] . For camera data, the agent receives only RGB images, without depth or camera calibration. Each task instruction is accompanied by a task recipe that describes the scene and gives a scoring rubric. Four tasks also have task notes, which we summarize here. In ‘imitate sorting sequence’, the robot must hold still through the demonstration and then reproduce the observed order. In ‘make kong’, it must wait for the opponent’s discard and then declare the kong in two motions. In ‘match and pick from conveyor’, the belt does not stop, so the grasp must be aimed where the object will be. In ‘play tic-tac-toe’, the robot must hold still during the opponent’s turns, play to win or block, and place all five pieces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboDojo 上进行少样本学习与持续学习实验（第 2C 节）。 该基准定义了三个公开评估种子（0、1 和 2），每个种子为每项任务指定 50 个预定布局，并在物体、物体位置、背景和杂乱程度上有所变化。 我们使用种子 0 进行经验收集。 在少样本学习中，每项任务进行五次练习，并选取种子 1 中成功率最高的一次作为该任务的练习结果。 在少样本学习和持续学习中，我们均报告种子 2 上的成功率。 我们按照公开排行榜的方式计算成功率。 每个类别的成功率是其各任务成功率的均值，总成功率为五个类别成功率的均值。 置信区间为基于任务、在每个类别内重抽样的 95% 百分位自助区间。 与 RoboLab 一样，在智能体推理时仿真会暂停。 我们遵循公开排行榜上由 RoboDojo 作者提交的 GPT-6 Astra 参赛方案的输入协议 [ 57 ] 。 对于相机数据，智能体仅接收 RGB 图像，不含深度信息或相机标定。 每项任务指令都附带一个描述场景并给出评分细则的任务配方。 有四个任务还包含任务说明，我们在此进行总结。 在「imitate sorting sequence」中，机器人必须在示范过程中保持静止，然后复现所观察到的顺序。 在「make kong」中，机器人必须等待对手出牌，然后用两个动作宣告杠牌。 在「match and pick from conveyor」中，传送带不会停止，因此抓取必须瞄准物体将要到达的位置。 在「play tic-tac-toe」中，机器人必须在对手回合时保持静止，落子以求获胜或阻挡，并放置全部五枚棋子。

paragraphs.en: We made minimal adjustments to the harness SDK’s reference documentation, replacing simulation references with their real-world equivalents. To support recovery from errors (RfE), the harness includes two SDK functions: one queries the arm’s state, the other requests robot error recovery. When a Franka collision reflex interrupts motion, the harness reports the error to the model. The model can generate code that calls these functions. The harness executes the code and returns the results. Following successful recovery, the model can command a revised trajectory.

paragraphs.en: We use the DROID setup [ 38 ] , comprising a 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, a wrist-mounted ZED Mini attached using the official DROID fixture, and two ZED 2i cameras providing left and right shoulder views. The shoulder cameras are positioned to approximate the baseline policies’ training-time camera configuration, with each baseline using its expected views. All cameras operate at 30 fps with an output resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . When depth is needed, we use a pretrained S 2 M 2 stereo model to obtain metric depth from the ZED cameras [ 58 ] . Each methods uses its expected views: π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} takes the left shoulder and wrist cameras as visual observations [ 24 ] , whereas FLUX 3 [ 23 ] and AMP1 additionally use the right shoulder camera.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each method on 12 complex real-world tasks. To assess robustness to visual and hardware variation, we use three instances of the platform that differ in scene background and hardware characteristics, including camera calibration, cabling, and component wear. For each task and method, we conduct 9 trials, with 3 trials on each platform instance. The instructions are issued in free-form natural language and span single-skill pick-and-place as well as multi-stage instructions that require subgoal sequencing. For fair comparison, we build a scene restoration tool that ensures that, for every trial of each task, the initial object poses (projected into the workspace relative to the robot base) and the set of objects are consistent across all methods. The initial scene and the language instruction for each task are detailed in Supplementary Materials. All methods are evaluated under the same 5-minute execution time budget (excluding reasoning time). If the time limit is exceeded or an uninstructed object is erroneously grasped and placed, the trial is considered unsuccessful. For the baseline deployments and AMP1 without RfE, a robot controller error that interrupts motion also terminates the trial. For AMP1 with RfE, a recoverable controller error does not by itself terminate the trial; the agent can request error recovery through the harness and, if recovery succeeds, continue the same trial within the remaining execution-time budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在12个复杂的真实世界任务上评估每种方法。 为了评估对视觉和硬件差异的鲁棒性，我们使用三台在场景背景和硬件特性上有所不同的平台实例，包括相机标定、布线和部件磨损。 对于每个任务和方法，我们进行9次试验，其中每台平台实例上进行3次试验。 指令以自由格式的自然语言发出，涵盖单一技能的抓取与放置，以及需要子目标排序的多阶段指令。 为了公平比较，我们构建了一个场景恢复工具，确保每个任务的每次试验中，初始物体位姿（投影到相对于机器人基座的工作空间中）和物体集合在所有方法之间保持一致。 每个任务的初始场景和语言指令详见补充材料。 所有方法都在相同的5分钟执行时间预算（不包括推理时间）下进行评估。 如果超出时间限制，或者错误地抓取并放置了未被指令的物体，则该试验被视为不成功。 对于基线部署以及不带RfE的AMP1，中断运动的机器人控制器错误也会终止试验。 对于带RfE的AMP1，可恢复的控制器错误本身不会终止试验；智能体可以通过框架请求错误恢复，如果恢复成功，则在剩余的执行时间预算内继续同一试验。

paragraphs.en: Closed-weight models are queried through their providers’ APIs. Open-weight models are self-hosted with SGLang. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B run on H100 GPUs, the others on B200 GPUs. We do not set sampling parameters such as temperature and top- p p , so each model uses its provider’s defaults. In simulation, multiple episodes run in parallel on a node with eight H100 GPUs, which hosts the simulator together with the harness and the agent’s code execution. On the real robot, the harness runs on a local workstation with two RTX Pro 6000 GPUs. The baseline policies are also evaluated on the same platform.
paragraphs.zh: 闭权重模型通过其提供商的 API 进行查询。 开权重模型使用 SGLang 自行部署。 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 运行在 H100 GPU 上，其余模型运行在 B200 GPU 上。 我们不设置 temperature 和 top-p 等采样参数，因此每个模型使用其提供商的默认值。 在仿真中，多个回合（episode）在配备八块 H100 GPU 的节点上并行运行，该节点同时承载模拟器、测试框架（harness）以及智能体的代码执行。 在真实机器人上，测试框架（harness）运行在配备两块 RTX Pro 6000 GPU 的本地工作站上。 基线策略也在同一平台上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: In the real-world evaluation results ( Tab. 1 ), the time to success of AMP1 is split into execution (Exec.) and reasoning (Reason.). Execution time covers only the intervals in which the robot is carrying out the agent’s commanded actions; reasoning time accumulates the agent’s inference, the execution of its own code, the camera capture, and the 3D perception processing performed after each motion. In addition, we annotate each of the 12 tasks with three kinds of features, shown in the columns Manip. , Horizon , and Reasoning . These features let us relate a method’s success to the demands of a task; we explain each of them in more detail below:
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界评估结果（表 1）中，AMP1 的成功时间被拆分为执行时间和推理时间。 执行时间仅涵盖机器人执行智能体所指令动作的时间段；推理时间则累积智能体的推理、其自身代码的运行、相机采集，以及每次运动后进行的 3D 感知处理。 此外，我们为 12 个任务中的每一个标注了三种特征，分别显示在 Manip.、Horizon 和 Reasoning 这几列中。 这些特征使我们能够将方法的成功与任务的需求关联起来；下面我们更详细地解释每一项特征：

sents.en: In the real-world evaluation results ( Tab. 1 ), the time to success of AMP1 is split into execution (Exec.) and reasoning (Reason.).
sents.zh: 在真实世界评估结果（表 1）中，AMP1 的成功时间被拆分为执行时间和推理时间。

sents.en: Execution time covers only the intervals in which the robot is carrying out the agent’s commanded actions; reasoning time accumulates the agent’s inference, the execution of its own code, the camera capture, and the 3D perception processing performed after each motion.
sents.zh: 执行时间仅涵盖机器人执行智能体所指令动作的时间段；推理时间则累积智能体的推理、其自身代码的运行、相机采集，以及每次运动后进行的 3D 感知处理。

sents.en: In addition, we annotate each of the 12 tasks with three kinds of features, shown in the columns Manip. , Horizon , and Reasoning .
sents.zh: 此外，我们为 12 个任务中的每一个标注了三种特征，分别显示在 Manip.、Horizon 和 Reasoning 这几列中。

sents.en: These features let us relate a method’s success to the demands of a task; we explain each of them in more detail below:
sents.zh: 这些特征使我们能够将方法的成功与任务的需求关联起来；下面我们更详细地解释每一项特征：

paragraphs.en: Manipulation describes the kinds of actions a task requires. A task is prehensile if it can be solved by grasping and placing objects alone. A task is labeled non-prehensile if completing it requires non-prehensile actions, such as pushing, sliding, or nudging an object, so that purely prehensile manipulation cannot solve it. A task can have both labels when completing it requires both kinds of motion. For example, in the task “Put the bowl on the plate”, the bowl is flipped and no initial grasp is feasible, so the robot first pushes it to the edge of the bin and then grasps it.
paragraphs.zh: 操作描述了任务所需的各种动作类型。 如果一个任务仅通过抓取和放置物体就能完成，则该任务是抓握式的。 如果完成任务需要非抓握式动作，例如推、滑动或轻推物体，从而纯抓握式操作无法解决它，则该任务被标记为非抓握式的。 当完成任务同时需要这两种动作时，任务可以同时具有这两种标签。 例如，在任务“把碗放到盘子上”中，碗被翻倒且没有可行的初始抓取，因此智能体先将其推到料箱边缘，然后再抓取它。

sents.en: Manipulation describes the kinds of actions a task requires.
sents.zh: 操作描述了任务所需的各种动作类型。

sents.en: A task is prehensile if it can be solved by grasping and placing objects alone.
sents.zh: 如果一个任务仅通过抓取和放置物体就能完成，则该任务是抓握式的。

sents.en: A task is labeled non-prehensile if completing it requires non-prehensile actions, such as pushing, sliding, or nudging an object, so that purely prehensile manipulation cannot solve it.
sents.zh: 如果完成任务需要非抓握式动作，例如推、滑动或轻推物体，从而纯抓握式操作无法解决它，则该任务被标记为非抓握式的。

sents.en: A task can have both labels when completing it requires both kinds of motion.
sents.zh: 当完成任务同时需要这两种动作时，任务可以同时具有这两种标签。

sents.en: For example, in the task “Put the bowl on the plate”, the bowl is flipped and no initial grasp is feasible, so the robot first pushes it to the edge of the bin and then grasps it.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务“把碗放到盘子上”中，碗被翻倒且没有可行的初始抓取，因此智能体先将其推到料箱边缘，然后再抓取它。

paragraphs.en: Horizon separates single-step and multi-step tasks. A single-step task usually involves manipulating only one target object (e.g., picking and placing one object). A multi-step task requires completing multiple subtasks in sequence, usually by manipulating multiple objects one after another (e.g., putting all the red things in the bin).
paragraphs.zh: Horizon（任务跨度）用于区分单步任务和多步任务。 单步任务通常只涉及操作一个目标物体（例如，抓取并放置一个物体）。 多步任务需要按顺序完成多个子任务，通常需要依次操作多个物体（例如，把所有红色的东西放进箱子里）。

sents.en: Horizon separates single-step and multi-step tasks.
sents.zh: Horizon（任务跨度）用于区分单步任务和多步任务。

sents.en: A single-step task usually involves manipulating only one target object (e.g., picking and placing one object).
sents.zh: 单步任务通常只涉及操作一个目标物体（例如，抓取并放置一个物体）。

sents.en: A multi-step task requires completing multiple subtasks in sequence, usually by manipulating multiple objects one after another (e.g., putting all the red things in the bin).
sents.zh: 多步任务需要按顺序完成多个子任务，通常需要依次操作多个物体（例如，把所有红色的东西放进箱子里）。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning lists the kinds of reasoning a task requires to decide what to manipulate and how. Multiple kinds may be called for per task:
paragraphs.zh: 推理列出任务所需的推理类型，以决定操作什么以及如何操作。 每个任务可能需要多种类型：

sents.en: Reasoning lists the kinds of reasoning a task requires to decide what to manipulate and how.
sents.zh: 推理列出任务所需的推理类型，以决定操作什么以及如何操作。

sents.en: Multiple kinds may be called for per task:
sents.zh: 每个任务可能需要多种类型：

paragraphs.en: Spatial reasoning : understanding a spatial relation, e.g., “to the left of”.
paragraphs.zh: 空间推理：理解空间关系，例如“在……的左边”。

paragraphs.en: Semantic grounding : identifying objects from their color or category, e.g., “red things” or “canned foods”.
paragraphs.zh: 语义落地（semantic grounding）：根据颜色或类别识别物体，例如「红色的东西」或「罐装食品」。

paragraphs.en: Exclusion : acting on all objects of a class except a named one, e.g., “all the tools except the hammer”.
paragraphs.zh: 排除：作用于某类中除指定对象之外的所有对象，例如，“除锤子之外的所有工具”。

paragraphs.en: Ordering : deciding the order in which to act, e.g., comparing cup sizes to nest them.
paragraphs.zh: 排序：决定行动的顺序，例如比较杯子的大小以便嵌套它们。

paragraphs.en: Affordance : an enabling action is needed to make the next action feasible, e.g., pushing a flipped bowl to the bin edge before grasping it.
paragraphs.zh: 可供性（Affordance）：需要一个使能动作来让下一个动作可行，例如在抓取之前先将翻转的碗推向箱子边缘。

paragraphs.en: Memory : using information that is no longer visible, e.g., remembering which cup hides the yellow cube in order to uncover it.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆：使用不再可见的信息，例如记住黄色方块藏在哪个杯子下面，以便将其揭开。

paragraphs.en: Complementing the baseline comparison in Tab. 1 , we ablate access to the two error-recovery SDK functions in Tab. S1 . Without these functions, a robot controller error that interrupts motion terminates the trial under our evaluation protocol. With recovery from error (RfE), the agent can request recovery through the harness and continue the same trial if recovery succeeds. AMP1 succeeds in 104 of 108 trials (96.3%) with RfE and 94 of 108 trials (87.0%) without RfE. The reported average time to success is similar across conditions, although each average includes only the successful trials in that condition. The gain is largest on tasks involving close contact between the gripper or held object and the scene, where collisions are more likely (e.g., “Pack canned foods into the bin”, from 3 / 9 to 9 / 9).

paragraphs.en: Figure S5 follows one complete episode, on the RoboLab BananaInBowlTask , to demonstrate how AMP1 reasons and acts. The agent runs Claude Opus 5.5 at high reasoning effort with the basic harness. It commands the manipulator by means of timed waypoints with gripper commands. It solves the task in eight turns, in each of which it writes and runs Python code.

paragraphs.en: The episode exhibits a generic decision loop that repeats across tasks. AMP1 gathers the information needed for the decision, builds its own geometric model of the object to manipulate from the perceived points, previews its motion before executing it, and checks the outcome in images and sensor readings before the next decision.
paragraphs.zh: 该片段展现了一个可在各任务间重复使用的通用决策循环。 AMP1 收集决策所需的信息，根据感知到的点构建其自身的待操作物体几何模型，在执行前对动作进行预演，并在下一次决策前通过图像和传感器读数检查执行结果。

sents.en: The episode exhibits a generic decision loop that repeats across tasks.
sents.zh: 该片段展现了一个可在各任务间重复使用的通用决策循环。

sents.en: AMP1 gathers the information needed for the decision, builds its own geometric model of the object to manipulate from the perceived points, previews its motion before executing it, and checks the outcome in images and sensor readings before the next decision.

paragraphs.en: The first turn starts from a) the system prompt, which describes the robot, the SDK and the rules of the episode, b) the tool definitions, and c) a first user message that withholds the instruction and the remaining steps. AMP1 therefore has no image of the scene yet. Its first implemented code, which follows an example in the system prompt, reads the instruction (“Pick up the banana and place it in the bowl”) and the remaining steps, lists the objects detected by perception, and shows itself two camera views, one annotated with the object identifiers and bounding boxes.
paragraphs.zh: 第一轮对话包括：a) 系统提示词，其中描述了机器人、SDK 以及本回合的规则；b) 工具定义；以及 c) 第一条用户消息，该消息隐瞒了指令和剩余步骤。 因此，AMP1 此时尚未获得场景的图像。 它实现的第一段代码（遵循系统提示词中的一个示例）会读取指令（「把香蕉拿起来放进碗里」）和剩余步骤，列出感知系统检测到的物体，并向自己展示两个相机视角，其中一个标注了物体标识符和边界框。

paragraphs.en: In turn 2, AMP1 builds its own geometric model of the banana. It retrieves the banana’s points, fits an oriented bounding box to them, and reads the end-effector pose and the table height from the robot’s observation. In turn 3, AMP1 plans the grasp. Because the banana is curved, AMP1 reasons that the centroid of its points may not lie on it, so it plans to grasp the banana at the point of the cloud nearest to the centroid, with the fingers closing across the banana’s width, perpendicular to its long axis. It plans timed waypoints for the approach and previews the motion without executing it. The harness confirms that the motion is feasible, and AMP1 then runs a collision check on poses sampled along the previewed path, which reports contacts of the gripper with both the banana and the table. In turn 4, AMP1 accepts the contact with the banana as expected for a grasp, raises the grasp pose slightly so that the fingertips reach approximately the middle of the banana’s height rather than the table, and only then executes the approach. In turn 5, AMP1 checks the wrist camera and finds that the banana sits between the open fingers. It closes the gripper and lifts the banana. In turn 6, AMP1 interprets its gripper reading, which rose from 0.28 after closing to 0.55 after the lift, as the banana slipping or rotating in the grasp. Rather than reusing the bowl position from the first turn, it perceives the scene again to locate the bowl’s center. It then plans to carry the banana high enough to clear the bowl’s rim, and to lower it before opening the gripper. In turn 7, allowing for the banana having rotated in the grasp, it estimates that the banana now hangs about 7 cm below the gripper, so its bottom clears the rim during the carry. It then carries it over the bowl and lowers it. In turn 8, it opens the gripper and plans to raise the empty gripper to look at the result. Finally, RoboLab’s success check detects that the banana has dropped into the bowl and ends the episode.
paragraphs.zh: 在第2轮中，AMP1构建了香蕉自己的几何模型。 它检索香蕉的点云，对点云拟合一个有向包围盒，并从机器人的观测中读取末端执行器位姿和桌面高度。 在第3轮中，AMP1规划抓取。 由于香蕉是弯曲的，AMP1推断其点云的质心可能不在香蕉上，因此它计划在点云中最靠近质心的点处抓取香蕉，手指沿香蕉宽度方向闭合，垂直于其长轴。 它为接近阶段规划带时间戳的路径点，并在不执行的情况下预览该运动。 框架确认该运动可行，随后AMP1对沿预览路径采样的位姿运行碰撞检查，结果显示夹爪与香蕉和桌面均发生接触。 在第4轮中，AMP1将夹爪与香蕉的接触视为抓取的正常预期，将抓取位姿略微抬高，使指尖大致触及香蕉高度的中部而非桌面，然后才执行接近动作。 在第5轮中，AMP1检查腕部相机，发现香蕉位于张开的手指之间。 它闭合夹爪并抬起香蕉。 在第6轮中，AMP1解读其夹爪读数——闭合后从0.28升至抬起后的0.55——认为香蕉在抓取中发生了滑动或旋转。 它没有复用第一轮中碗的位置，而是重新感知场景以定位碗的中心。 随后它规划将香蕉携带到足以越过碗沿的高度，并在打开夹爪之前将其降低。 在第7轮中，考虑到香蕉在抓取中已发生旋转，它估计香蕉现在悬垂在夹爪下方约7厘米处，因此在搬运过程中其底部不会碰到碗沿。 然后它将香蕉搬运到碗的上方并降低。 在第8轮中，它打开夹爪，并规划将空夹爪抬起以查看结果。 最后，RoboLab的成功检查检测到香蕉已落入碗中，并结束该回合。

paragraphs.en: This section walks through a number of episodes in detail, to show how AMP1 reasons, acts, and verifies its progress over the course of a task.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将详细讲解若干个片段，以展示 AMP1 在任务执行过程中如何推理、行动并验证自身的进展。

paragraphs.en: This case study follows one episode of the RGB-only ablation ( Sec. 2D.3 , Fig. 5 C) on the RoboLab task FoodPacking2CansTask (“Pack canned foods into the bin”). In this setting, AMP1 has access to RGB frames from the two scene cameras and the wrist camera, the robot’s proprioception, and its kinematic model. The harness withholds depth, the camera intrinsics and extrinsics, and perception tools. AMP1 can see the cans in every image, but it has nothing that turns a pixel into a position in the robot’s frame, which it needs before it can plan a grasp.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究跟踪纯RGB消融实验（见第2D.3节、图5C）在RoboLab任务FoodPacking2CansTask（“将罐装食品装箱”）中的一次执行过程。 在该设置中，AMP1可以访问来自两个场景相机和腕部相机的RGB帧、机器人本体感知信息以及其运动学模型。 该评测框架隐藏了深度信息、相机内外参以及感知工具。 AMP1在每张图像中都能看到罐子，但它没有任何东西能把像素转换为机器人坐标系中的位置，而在规划抓取之前它需要这样的位置信息。

sents.en: This case study follows one episode of the RGB-only ablation ( Sec. 2D.3 , Fig. 5 C) on the RoboLab task FoodPacking2CansTask (“Pack canned foods into the bin”).
sents.zh: 本案例研究跟踪纯RGB消融实验（见第2D.3节、图5C）在RoboLab任务FoodPacking2CansTask（“将罐装食品装箱”）中的一次执行过程。

sents.en: In this setting, AMP1 has access to RGB frames from the two scene cameras and the wrist camera, the robot’s proprioception, and its kinematic model.

sents.en: The harness withholds depth, the camera intrinsics and extrinsics, and perception tools.
sents.zh: 该评测框架隐藏了深度信息、相机内外参以及感知工具。

sents.en: AMP1 can see the cans in every image, but it has nothing that turns a pixel into a position in the robot’s frame, which it needs before it can plan a grasp.
sents.zh: AMP1在每张图像中都能看到罐子，但它没有任何东西能把像素转换为机器人坐标系中的位置，而在规划抓取之前它需要这样的位置信息。

paragraphs.en: AMP1 closes this gap by calibrating the wrist camera itself. The wrist camera moves with the gripper, whose pose AMP1 knows at every instant, so images taken at known gripper poses form a multi-view camera rig once two unknowns – the camera’s intrinsics and its fixed pose relative to the gripper – are solved for. The episode succeeded in 44 model calls, of which the calibration and 3D estimation described below took the first 16, all before the first grasp.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 通过对手腕相机本身进行标定来弥补这一空白。 手腕相机随夹持器移动，而 AMP1 在每一时刻都知道夹持器的位姿，因此只要求解出两个未知量——相机的内参以及它相对于夹持器的固定位姿——在已知夹持器位姿下拍摄的图像就构成了一个多视角相机阵列。 该次执行通过 44 次模型调用成功完成，其中下文所述的标定与三维估计占用了前 16 次，全部发生在第一次抓取之前。

sents.en: AMP1 closes this gap by calibrating the wrist camera itself.
sents.zh: AMP1 通过对手腕相机本身进行标定来弥补这一空白。

sents.en: The wrist camera moves with the gripper, whose pose AMP1 knows at every instant, so images taken at known gripper poses form a multi-view camera rig once two unknowns – the camera’s intrinsics and its fixed pose relative to the gripper – are solved for.
sents.zh: 手腕相机随夹持器移动，而 AMP1 在每一时刻都知道夹持器的位姿，因此只要求解出两个未知量——相机的内参以及它相对于夹持器的固定位姿——在已知夹持器位姿下拍摄的图像就构成了一个多视角相机阵列。

sents.en: The episode succeeded in 44 model calls, of which the calibration and 3D estimation described below took the first 16, all before the first grasp.

paragraphs.en: AMP1 moved the gripper to a few known poses and kept the wrist image at each ( Fig. S6 A), then matched SIFT features across the views. It wrote a bundle adjustment routine that performs a least-squares fit of the camera’s intrinsics, its pose relative to the gripper, and the 3D positions of the matched features. The bundle adjustment minimizes the distance between where each point projects and where it was observed. The first fit converged but placed the camera 2.8 m up the tool axis, because shifts and a yaw alone leave the camera’s offset along that axis unobservable. AMP1 diagnosed this, added two views with the tool tilted ( Fig. S6 B), and re-ran the fit on all seven views. The table plane emerged from the reconstruction without being given, and AMP1 checked the result by projecting the points back onto a view.
paragraphs.zh: AMP1 将夹爪移动到几个已知位姿，并在每个位姿保存腕部图像（图 S6 A），然后在不同视角间匹配 SIFT 特征。 它编写了一个光束法平差程序，对相机的内参、相机相对夹爪的位姿以及匹配特征的 3D 位置进行最小二乘拟合。 光束法平差最小化每个点投影位置与观测位置之间的距离。 第一次拟合收敛了，但把相机放在了工具轴上方 2.8 米处，因为仅靠平移和偏航无法观测到相机沿该轴的偏移量。 AMP1 诊断出这一问题，增加了两个工具倾斜的视角（图 S6 B），并在全部七个视角上重新运行拟合。 无需给定，桌面平面便从重建结果中自然显现出来，AMP1 通过将点投影回一个视角来验证结果。

paragraphs.en: This case study follows one episode of the “Wrist camera only” ablation ( Sec. 2D.3 , Fig. 5 D) on the RoboLab task CubesAndBlocksInBinTask (“Put all the cubes and blocks in the bin”). In this setting, the wrist camera is AMP1’s only view of the scene: its code receives the wrist camera’s RGB and depth images, and there is no scene camera. The task has seven target objects that the arm must pick up and place in the bin: three Rubik’s cubes and a blue, a red, a green, and a yellow block. Because the camera rides on the gripper, it mostly sees only part of the table at a time. At the start, some targets are in view and others are not, so AMP1 first has to work out where to look.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究跟踪了「仅腕部相机」消融实验（第2D.3节，图5D）在RoboLab任务CubesAndBlocksInBinTask（“把所有魔方和方块放进箱子”）中的一次运行过程。 在此设置中，腕部相机是AMP1观察场景的唯一视角：其代码接收腕部相机的RGB和深度图像，没有场景相机。 该任务有七个目标物体，机械臂必须将它们拿起并放进箱子：三个魔方以及一个蓝色、一个红色、一个绿色和一个黄色方块。 由于相机安装在夹爪上，它每次大多只能看到桌面的一部分。 开始时，一些目标物体在视野内，另一些则不在，因此AMP1首先必须弄清楚该往哪里看。

paragraphs.en: At the start pose, AMP1 noted that there might be more objects beyond the edge of the frame and hidden under the gripper ( Fig. S8 A), so it did not plan from this view. Instead, it lifted the gripper to 0.62 m above the middle of the table to see the whole scene. From there it found the green block and the whole birdhouse. Two problems remained. The bin touched the edge of the image, so its estimated box might be cut short, and objects might lie out of view on the robot’s side of the table. AMP1 therefore moved the camera 0.20 m toward the robot ( Fig. S8 B). The bin’s box grew from 34 to 42 cm, and the yellow block appeared next to a lizard figurine.
paragraphs.zh: 在起始位姿处，AMP1 注意到画面边缘之外和夹爪下方可能还有更多物体（图 S8 A），因此它没有从这个视角进行规划。 S8 A），因此它没有从这个视角进行规划。 相反，它将夹爪抬升到桌面中上方 0.62 m 处，以观察整个场景。 从那里它发现了绿色积木和完整的鸟屋。但仍存在两个问题。 垃圾桶触碰到了图像边缘，因此其估计的边界框可能被截短，而且物体可能位于桌面上机器人一侧的视野之外。 因此，AMP1 将相机向机器人方向移动了 0.20 m（图 S8 B）。 垃圾桶的边界框从 34 cm 增大到 42 cm，黄色积木出现在一个蜥蜴摆件旁边。

paragraphs.en: The overviews found every target but measured them poorly. The depth captured mostly the tops of the objects from that height, so two of the Rubik’s cubes and the blue block came out about 2 cm tall instead of about 5 cm. The agent reasoned that perception from that height was too coarse and decided to hover low over each object and look again before grasping it. At the first close look, the Rubik’s cube nearest the robot measured 6.1 × \times 6.1 × \times 5.3 cm, with its faces at − 51.6 -51.6 ° rather than the 69.9° the overview had given. AMP1 then used the new angle to choose how to close its fingers so that the gripper would not touch the blue block beside the cube ( Fig. S8 C). For every later pick, AMP1 started with a close look like this one.
paragraphs.zh: 概览找到了所有目标，但测量得很差。 从那个高度拍摄的深度大多只捕捉到物体的顶部，因此两个魔方和蓝色方块的高度测出来约为 2 厘米，而不是约 5 厘米。 智能体推断该高度的感知过于粗糙，于是决定在每个物体上方低空悬停并再次观察，然后再进行抓取。 在第一次近距离观察时，离智能体机器人最近的魔方测量结果为 6.1 × \times 6.1 × \times 5.3 厘米，其朝向为 − 51.6 -51.6 °，而不是概览给出的 69.9°。 AMP1 随后利用新的角度来选择如何闭合手指，使夹爪不会碰到魔方旁边的蓝色方块（图 S8 C）。 对于之后的每一次拾取，AMP1 都以这样的近距离观察开始。

paragraphs.en: RoboLab-120 evaluates every task under three natural-language instruction conditions: default (standard task phrasing), vague (underspecified phrasing that omits explicit object names or attributes), and specific (detailed phrasing that names target objects and relations explicitly) [ 22 ] . Fig. S9 compares all 19 policies for which evaluation data exist across all three conditions: seven AMP1 configurations (Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 4.5) and 12 baseline policies (11 leaderboard entries plus our evaluation of FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] on the vague and specific conditions, 1,200 trials per condition). For each policy, we report the absolute success rate under default instructions, the absolute spread across the three conditions ( max − min \max-\min , in percentage points), and the relative spread ( spread / default success rate \text{spread}/\text{default success rate} ), and rank all policies from lowest to highest relative spread. Across all seven models, AMP1’s absolute spread stays between 0.9 and 4.5 percentage points, corresponding to a relative spread of 1.9% to 6.4% – occupying the top six positions and seven of the top eight. AMP1 with six models (Opus 5, Opus 4.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 5.5) achieves the six lowest relative spreads on the benchmark (1.9%, 2.6%, 3.6%, 3.6%, 5.5%, and 5.8%, respectively). Even with smaller or older models such as Haiku 5.5 (51.6% default success) and Opus 4.5 (35.2% default success), AMP1 maintains relative spreads of 5.8% and 2.6%, lower than every learned policy. Only one learned policy, BiMind v0.5 (6.1%), has a lower relative spread than any AMP1 configuration: AMP1 with Sonnet 5.5 (6.4%), a gap of 0.3 points. By contrast, end-to-end VLA and WAM/LWM baselines exhibit a median relative spread of 42.0%, ranging from 6.1% for BiMind v0.5 to 70.6% for paligemma-binning, with large drops under vague phrasing – including 12.8 percentage points for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 24 ] (46.1% relative spread), 14.5 percentage points for FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] (33.8%), and 16.2 percentage points for Cosmos3-Nano-Policy (51.9%).
paragraphs.zh: RoboLab-120 在三种自然语言指令条件下评估每个任务：默认（标准任务表述）、模糊（省略明确对象名称或属性的欠明确表述）和具体（明确指出目标对象及关系的详细表述）[ 22 ]。图 S9 比较了在所有三种条件下均存在评估数据的全部 19 个策略：七个 AMP1 配置（Gemini 4 Argon、Opus 5.5、Opus 5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5、Sonnet 5 和 Opus 4.5）以及 12 个基线策略（11 个排行榜条目，加上我们在模糊和具体条件下对 FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] 的评估，每种条件 1,200 次试验）。 对于每个策略，我们报告其在默认指令下的绝对成功率、在三种条件之间的绝对差幅（ max − min \max-\min ，以百分点计）以及相对差幅（ spread / default success rate \text{spread}/\text{default success rate} ，即差幅除以默认成功率），并将所有策略按相对差幅从低到高排序。 在全部七个模型中，AMP1 的绝对差幅保持在 0.9 至 4.5 个百分点之间，对应 1.9% 至 6.4% 的相对差幅——占据前六名以及前八名中的七席。 AMP1 搭配六个模型（Opus 5、Opus 4.5、Gemini 4 Argon、Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5 和 Haiku 5.5）取得了该基准上最低的六个相对差幅（分别为 1.9%、2.6%、3.6%、3.6%、5.5% 和 5.8%）。 即使使用较小或较旧的模型，如 Haiku 5.5（默认成功率 51.6%）和 Opus 4.5（默认成功率 35.2%），AMP1 仍保持 5.8% 和 2.6% 的相对差幅，低于所有学习型策略。 只有一个学习型策略 BiMind v0.5（6.1%）的相对差幅低于任何 AMP1 配置：AMP1 搭配 Sonnet 5.5（6.4%），差距为 0.3 个百分点。 相比之下，端到端 VLA 和 WAM/LWM 基线的中位相对差幅为 42.0%，范围从 BiMind v0.5 的 6.1% 到 paligemma-binning 的 70.6%，且在模糊表述下出现大幅下降——包括 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 24 ] 下降 12.8 个百分点（相对差幅 46.1%）、FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] 下降 14.5 个百分点（33.8%）以及 Cosmos3-Nano-Policy 下降 16.2 个百分点（51.9%）。

sents.en: By contrast, end-to-end VLA and WAM/LWM baselines exhibit a median relative spread of 42.0%, ranging from 6.1% for BiMind v0.5 to 70.6% for paligemma-binning, with large drops under vague phrasing – including 12.8 percentage points for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 24 ] (46.1% relative spread), 14.5 percentage points for FLUX 3 Action [ 23 ] (33.8%), and 16.2 percentage points for Cosmos3-Nano-Policy (51.9%).

paragraphs.en: We examined every failed episode of the two strongest models in the RoboLab-120 evaluation of Fig. 2 B, under the ‘default’ instruction condition (10 trials per task, 1,200 trials per model): 173 failed episodes for AMP1 with Gemini 4 Argon (1,027 successes, or 85.6%) and 206 for AMP1 with Opus 5.5 (994 successes, or 82.8%). For each failed episode, we compared the final scene with RoboLab’s programmed verifier and analyzed the agent’s execution trace and measurements, the task verification code, and the final camera frames.

paragraphs.en: Fig. S10 partitions all 1,200 trials of each model by outcome. It first separates failures by their source – the benchmark ( Eval failure ), the policy ( AMP1 failure ), or the model API ( Provider failure ) – and then breaks each source into specific causes. AMP1 succeeds in every trial of 76 of the 120 tasks with Gemini 4 Argon (66 tasks with Opus 5.5). For both models, roughly two-thirds of the failures stem from the benchmark rather than the policy: 121 of the 173 failures with Gemini 4 Argon (70%), across 25 tasks, and 135 of the 206 failures with Opus 5.5 (66%), across 30 tasks. These benchmark artifacts comprise objects whose width or mass distribution is incompatible with a standard parallel-jaw grasp (77 episodes for Gemini 4 Argon and 101 for Opus 5.5) and flaky verifiers that reject end states that satisfy the instruction (44 and 34 episodes, respectively). Genuine AMP1 failures on graspable objects account for 47 episodes with Gemini 4 Argon (3.9% of all trials) and 71 with Opus 5.5 (5.9%); the remaining 5 episodes with Gemini 4 Argon are terminated by the provider’s safety filter.
paragraphs.zh: 图。 S10 按结果划分每个模型的全部 1,200 次试验。 它首先按来源区分失败——基准（Eval failure）、策略（AMP1 failure）或模型 API（Provider failure）——然后将每种来源细分为具体原因。 AMP1 在 120 个任务中的 76 个任务的所有试验中都获得成功，使用的是 Gemini 4 Argon（Opus 5.5 为 66 个任务）。 对于两个模型，大约三分之二的失败源于基准而非策略：Gemini 4 Argon 的 173 次失败中有 121 次（70%），涉及 25 个任务；Opus 5.5 的 206 次失败中有 135 次（66%），涉及 30 个任务。 这些基准伪影包括宽度或质量分布与标准平行夹爪抓取不兼容的物体（Gemini 4 Argon 为 77 个片段，Opus 5.5 为 101 个），以及拒绝满足指令的结束状态的不稳定验证器（分别为 44 个和 34 个片段）。 对可抓取物体的真实 AMP1 失败在 Gemini 4 Argon 中占 47 个片段（占全部试验的 3.9%），在 Opus 5.5 中占 71 个（5.9%）；Gemini 4 Argon 其余的 5 个片段由提供商的安全过滤器终止。
