paragraphs.en: In 16 tasks for Gemini 4 Argon and 22 tasks for Opus 5.5 (24 distinct tasks in total; Fig. S10 ), the target object is incompatible with a standard parallel-jaw grasp. Some objects, such as the pomegranate (115 mm), the bagels (100 mm), and the coffee can (102 mm), are wider than the 85-mm maximum aperture of the Robotiq 2F-85 gripper. Others slip out of a friction grasp because of their mass distribution or thin profile, including the 1.5-kg cordless drill, heavy-headed hammers extracted from a bin, a 2-cm-thick flat block, and a moka pot. Only one task fails every trial for both models because of a defect: in FoodPackingByColor , the instruction asks for “the blue object” although the scene contains two, and RoboLab’s verifier accepts only the 102-mm coffee can. In all 10 trials, AMP1 packs the graspable blue SPAM can and fails to hold the oversize coffee can. In the remaining tasks, AMP1 succeeds when it improvises a non-standard grasp ( Sec. 2B ). For objects wider than the gripper, it holds a narrower feature or supports the object from below: it inserts one finger through the hole of a bagel ( BagelsOnPlate and GrabABagel ), and it pinches the pomegranate’s narrow crown or pins the fruit against a heavier object and scoops it up with the open gripper ( FruitsOnPlate and ClearOrganicObjects ; Fig. 3 D). For the heavy drill, it replaces the friction grasp with an interlocking one, closing the fingers around the top of the handle so that the head rests on them once the drill is lifted ( PickDrill and ToolsPickingDrill ; Fig. S4 C). Across the 16 affected tasks (160 trials), AMP1 with Gemini 4 Argon still succeeds in 66 episodes (41%); it fails in 77 because of the object defect and in 17 for other reasons (5 flaky-verifier rejections, 8 AMP1 errors, and 4 provider blocks). Across the 22 tasks affected for AMP1 with Opus 5.5 (220 trials), it succeeds in 107 episodes (49%).
paragraphs.zh: 在针对 Gemini 4 Argon 的 16 个任务和针对 Opus 5.5 的 22 个任务中（共 24 个不同任务；图 S10），目标物体无法用标准平行夹爪抓取。有些物体，如石榴（115 毫米）、百吉饼（100 毫米）和咖啡罐（102 毫米），比 Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪 85 毫米的最大开口还要宽。另一些物体则因其质量分布或薄外形而从摩擦抓取中滑落，包括 1.5 千克的无绳电钻、从收纳箱中取出的重锤头锤子、2 厘米厚的扁平块，以及摩卡壶。只有一个任务因缺陷导致两个模型的所有试验均失败：在 FoodPackingByColor 中，指令要求抓取「蓝色物体」，但场景中有两个蓝色物体，而 RoboLab 的验证器只接受 102 毫米的咖啡罐。在全部 10 次试验中，AMP1 都装入了可抓取的蓝色 SPAM 罐，却无法抓住超尺寸的咖啡罐。在其余任务中，AMP1 在即兴采用非标准抓取方式时获得成功（第 2B 节）。对于比夹爪更宽的物体，它会抓住较窄的部位或从下方托住物体：它将一根手指穿过百吉饼的孔（BagelsOnPlate 和 GrabABagel），并捏住石榴较窄的冠部，或将水果抵住较重的物体再用张开的夹爪将其舀起（FruitsOnPlate 和 ClearOrganicObjects；图 3 D）。对于沉重的电钻，它用互锁抓取取代摩擦抓取，将手指绕把手顶部合拢，使电钻提起后钻头落在手指上（PickDrill 和 ToolsPickingDrill；图 S4 C）。在受影响的 16 个任务中（160 次试验），使用 Gemini 4 Argon 的 AMP1 仍在 66 个回合中成功（41%）；77 次因物体缺陷失败，17 次因其他原因失败（5 次验证器不稳定导致的拒绝、8 次 AMP1 错误，以及 4 次提供商拦截）。在 AMP1 受 Opus 5.5 影响的 22 个任务中（220 次试验），它在 107 个回合中成功（49%）。

paragraphs.en: In 13 tasks for Gemini 4 Argon and 9 tasks for Opus 5.5 ( Fig. S10 ), RoboLab’s verifier rejects end states that satisfy the natural-language instruction. Only one task fails every trial for both models: in RecycleCartonsOnBox (“Put the cartons that can be recycled on the box”), the verifier tests whether the cartons lie inside the box, which is closed, whereas the task’s own progress tracker checks whether they rest on top of it. In all 10 trials for both models, AMP1 places both cartons on top of the box, the progress tracker scores them as placed, and the verifier rejects the outcome. In the remaining tasks, the verifier is overly strict rather than impossible to satisfy: it accepts only a narrow subset of valid placements, so AMP1 still succeeds in 59 of the 130 trials across the 13 tasks with Gemini 4 Argon and in 48 of the 90 trials across the 9 tasks with Opus 5.5. In CookingPickPastaTool (9 verifier rejections for Gemini 4 Argon and 7 for Opus 5.5), the pasta tool ends standing inside the target holder, but the verifier – which requires the tool’s center to lie inside the holder while the tool touches it – does not register it; the single Gemini 4 Argon success came when the episode ended with the gripper still holding the tool inside the holder. In PickUpBluePitcher (6 and 5 rejections), AMP1 lifts the pitcher 8.5 to 12.8 cm above the table, but the verifier’s 5-cm lift check does not trigger. In StackWhiteMugs (5 rejections for Gemini 4 Argon), the verifier rejects deeply nested mugs whose upper bounding-box corners dip below the lower mug’s base; in PickOrangeObject (5 for Opus 5.5), it rejects lifts that sit on the boundary of its height threshold. In MoveBananaToBagelPlate (5 rejections for Gemini 4 Argon), AMP1 places the banana on top of the bagels already on the plate, whereas the verifier requires direct contact with the plate surface. The remaining rejections (9 across 8 tasks for Gemini 4 Argon and 7 across 5 tasks for Opus 5.5) are isolated cases of one or two episodes in which a lifted object or an in-container placement sits just outside the verifier’s geometric threshold, as in PickDrill , GrabABagel , UtensilsInMug , and ToolsPickingAllHammers . In nearly all of these episodes, AMP1 ended the trial believing it had succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Gemini 4 Argon 的 13 个任务和 Opus 5.5 的 9 个任务中（图 S10），RoboLab 的验证器拒绝了那些满足自然语言指令的终止状态。 只有一个任务对两个模型的每次试验都失败：在 RecycleCartonsOnBox（“把可回收的纸箱放到盒子上”）中，验证器检测纸箱是否位于盒子内部，而盒子是关闭的，但任务自身的进度追踪器检测的却是纸箱是否位于盒子顶部。 在两个模型的全部 10 次试验中，AMP1 都将两个纸箱放在盒子顶部，进度追踪器将其判为已放置，而验证器却拒绝了该结果。 在其余任务中，验证器是过于严格而非无法满足：它只接受有效放置位置中很窄的一个子集，因此在 13 个任务共 130 次试验中，AMP1 使用 Gemini 4 Argon 仍有 59 次成功，在 9 个任务共 90 次试验中，使用 Opus 5.5 有 48 次成功。 在 CookingPickPastaTool 中（Gemini 4 Argon 被验证器拒绝 9 次，Opus 5.5 被拒绝 7 次），意面工具最终直立在目标支架内部，但验证器——它要求工具在接触支架的同时其中心位于支架内部——并未将其登记为有效；Gemini 4 Argon 唯一一次成功出现在回合结束时夹爪仍握着工具处于支架内的情况。 在 PickUpBluePitcher 中（分别被拒绝 6 次和 5 次），AMP1 将水壶抬起至桌面上方 8.5 至 12.8 厘米，但验证器的 5 厘米抬起检测并未触发。 在 StackWhiteMugs 中（Gemini 4 Argon 被拒绝 5 次），验证器拒绝了深度嵌套的马克杯，其上部包围盒的角落低于下方马克杯的底座；在 PickOrangeObject 中（Opus 5.5 被拒绝 5 次），验证器拒绝了恰好位于其高度阈值边界上的抬起动作。 在 MoveBananaToBagelPlate 中（Gemini 4 Argon 被拒绝 5 次），AMP1 将香蕉放在了盘子上已有的贝果顶部，而验证器要求与盘子表面直接接触。 其余被拒绝的情况（Gemini 4 Argon 在 8 个任务中共 9 次，Opus 5.5 在 5 个任务中共 7 次）是仅涉及一到两个回合的孤立案例，其中被抬起或容器内放置的物体刚好落在验证器几何阈值之外，如 PickDrill、GrabABagel、UtensilsInMug 和 ToolsPickingAllHammers。 在几乎所有这些回合中，AMP1 结束试验时都认为自己已经成功。

paragraphs.en: The remaining failures are execution or interpretation errors by AMP1 on objects that the gripper can hold with a standard grasp: 47 episodes across 24 tasks for Gemini 4 Argon and 71 episodes across 33 tasks for Opus 5.5 ( Fig. S10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 其余失败是AMP1对机械爪可以用标准抓取方式握持的物体产生的执行或解释错误：Gemini 4 Argon在24个任务中共47个回合，Opus 5.5在33个任务中共71个回合（图S10）。

paragraphs.en: Timeout (15 episodes for Gemini 4 Argon, 28 for Opus 5.5): AMP1 exhausts the step budget, or ends the episode itself because too few steps remain to finish the remaining objects. Most timeouts follow earlier setbacks that AMP1 recovers from – repeated regrasps after slips, freeing a wedged finger, or searching for a reachable arm configuration on a shelf – but that consume most of the step budget before the last object is placed.
paragraphs.zh: 超时（Gemini 4 Argon 为15个回合，Opus 5.5 为28个回合）：AMP1 耗尽了步数预算，或者由于剩余步数不足以完成剩余物体而自行结束回合。 大多数超时都发生在早期的挫折之后——这些挫折 AMP1 能够从中恢复，例如打滑后反复重新抓取、解放被卡住的手指，或在货架上寻找可触及的手臂构型——但这些挫折在最后一个物体被放置之前就消耗了大部分步数预算。

sents.en: Timeout (15 episodes for Gemini 4 Argon, 28 for Opus 5.5): AMP1 exhausts the step budget, or ends the episode itself because too few steps remain to finish the remaining objects.
sents.zh: 超时（Gemini 4 Argon 为15个回合，Opus 5.5 为28个回合）：AMP1 耗尽了步数预算，或者由于剩余步数不足以完成剩余物体而自行结束回合。

sents.en: Most timeouts follow earlier setbacks that AMP1 recovers from – repeated regrasps after slips, freeing a wedged finger, or searching for a reachable arm configuration on a shelf – but that consume most of the step budget before the last object is placed.
sents.zh: 大多数超时都发生在早期的挫折之后——这些挫折 AMP1 能够从中恢复，例如打滑后反复重新抓取、解放被卡住的手指，或在货架上寻找可触及的手臂构型——但这些挫折在最后一个物体被放置之前就消耗了大部分步数预算。

paragraphs.en: Target dropped (13 for Gemini 4 Argon, 19 for Opus 5.5): A graspable object slips, drops, or tips out of a valid goal state during transport or release, and AMP1 does not recover it before the episode ends.
paragraphs.zh: 目标掉落（Gemini 4 Argon 为 13 次，Opus 5.5 为 19 次）：一个可抓取物体在搬运或释放过程中滑落、掉落或倾翻出有效目标状态，且智能体（AMP1）在本回合结束前未能将其恢复。

paragraphs.en: Collision (9 and 11 episodes): The arm, the gripper, or the held object collides with the scene, such as an unperceived upper shelf tier or a bin wall, or knocks a previously placed object out of position.
paragraphs.zh: 碰撞（第 9 和 11 集）：机械臂、夹爪或所持物体与场景发生碰撞，例如撞上未被感知到的上层货架或箱壁，或将先前放置的物体撞离原位。

paragraphs.en: Instruction misread (4 for Gemini 4 Argon, 9 for Opus 5.5): AMP1 identifies the objects in the scene correctly but interprets the instruction too narrowly or too broadly. In SpoonsInPot (4 episodes for Gemini 4 Argon and 7 for Opus 5.5) and GreenSpoonsInPot (1 for Opus 5.5), it takes a deep green utensil with a bent neck for a soup ladle rather than a serving spoon and leaves it out (in one trial actively removing it from the pot), whereas RoboLab’s verifier requires it in the pot. In one trial of OneBottleInSquarePail , Opus 5.5 puts a white-capped utility jug into the pail instead of one of the small white plastic bottles.
paragraphs.zh: 指令误读（Gemini 4 Argon 为 4 例，Opus 5.5 为 9 例）：AMP1 能够正确识别场景中的物体，但对指令的理解过于狭窄或过于宽泛。 在 SpoonsInPot（Gemini 4 Argon 为 4 个片段，Opus 5.5 为 7 个）和 GreenSpoonsInPot（Opus 5.5 为 1 例）中，模型把一把带有弯颈的深绿色器皿误认为是汤勺而非分餐勺，并将其排除在外（其中一次试验中还主动将其从锅中移出），而 RoboLab 的验证器要求把它放进锅里。 在 OneBottleInSquarePail 的一次试验中，Opus 5.5 把一个白色盖子的多功能水壶放进了方形桶，而不是放入其中一个白色小塑料瓶。

sents.en: Instruction misread (4 for Gemini 4 Argon, 9 for Opus 5.5): AMP1 identifies the objects in the scene correctly but interprets the instruction too narrowly or too broadly.
sents.zh: 指令误读（Gemini 4 Argon 为 4 例，Opus 5.5 为 9 例）：AMP1 能够正确识别场景中的物体，但对指令的理解过于狭窄或过于宽泛。

paragraphs.en: Gripper not released (3 for Gemini 4 Argon, 4 for Opus 5.5): The object reaches the goal region, but the gripper fails to open or detach cleanly, for example when a bowl rim or a mug handle wedges on the finger linkage, and remains in contact at the end of the episode.
paragraphs.zh: 夹爪未松开（Gemini 4 Argon 为 3，Opus 5.5 为 4）：物体到达目标区域，但夹爪未能顺利打开或干净地脱离，例如碗沿或马克杯把手卡在手指连杆上时，导致在回合结束时仍保持接触。

paragraphs.en: Misperception (3 for Gemini 4 Argon, 0 for Opus 5.5): AMP1 misidentifies an object’s category or geometry from the camera images. In two trials of SpoonsInPot , Gemini 4 Argon takes an oval green serving spoon, partly hidden beneath the ladle, for a flat spatula and leaves it on the plate; in one trial of FoodPacking1Boxes , it mistakes a crease on top of a cracker box for the box’s edge and misplaces the grasp.
paragraphs.zh: 感知错误（Gemini 4 Argon 得 3 分，Opus 5.5 得 0 分）：AMP1 从相机图像中错误识别物体的类别或几何形状。 在 SpoonsInPot 的两次试验中，Gemini 4 Argon 把一把部分被汤勺遮住的椭圆形绿色分菜勺误认为是扁平锅铲，并将其留在盘子上；在 FoodPacking1Boxes 的一次试验中，它把饼干盒顶部的一道折痕误认为是盒子的边缘，导致抓取位置错误。

paragraphs.en: Finally, 5 episodes with Gemini 4 Argon ( Provider failure: Safety filter block ) end early because the Gemini API blocks a model request under its safety filter, even after automatic retries; no such blocks occur with Opus 5.5.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，使用 Gemini 4 Argon 的 5 个回合（提供方故障：安全过滤器拦截）提前结束，原因是 Gemini API 在其安全过滤器下拦截了模型请求，即使在自动重试之后也是如此；而使用 Opus 5.5 时没有出现此类拦截。

paragraphs.en: On the tasks free of both flaky verifiers and object defects, AMP1 succeeds in 96.2% of episodes with Gemini 4 Argon (914 of 950 trials across 95 tasks) and in 93.6% with Opus 5.5 (842 of 900 trials across 90 tasks). On the 84 tasks free of both issues for both models, the success rates are 96.2% and 93.7%, respectively. Without excluding any task, crediting the verifier rejections whose end state satisfies the instruction (44 for Gemini 4 Argon and 34 for Opus 5.5) raises AMP1’s success rate across all 1,200 trials from 85.6% to 89.3% with Gemini 4 Argon and from 82.8% to 85.7% with Opus 5.5.
paragraphs.zh: 在既不存在不稳定验证器也不存在目标缺陷的任务上，AMP1 使用 Gemini 4 Argon 在 96.2% 的回合中成功（95 个任务共 950 次试验中的 914 次），使用 Opus 5.5 在 93.6% 的回合中成功（90 个任务共 900 次试验中的 842 次）。 在对两个模型都不存在上述两类问题的 84 个任务上，成功率分别为 96.2% 和 93.7%。 若不排除任何任务，并将最终状态满足指令的验证器拒绝（Gemini 4 Argon 为 44 次，Opus 5.5 为 34 次）计为成功，则 AMP1 在全部 1,200 次试验中的成功率从 85.6% 提升至 89.3%（Gemini 4 Argon），从 82.8% 提升至 85.7%（Opus 5.5）。

paragraphs.en: This section estimates the inference cost of AMP1 for the models with public API pricing, the Claude models and Gemini 4 Argon, by pricing each episode’s tokens at list price ( Tab. S3 ). With Opus 5.5, a RoboLab-120 episode costs $1.39 on average, about 26 times lower than the $36.40 reported for Astranomy with GPT-6 Astra [ 21 ] . (AMP1 also succeeds more often, 82.8% against 74.8%.) Astranomy queries the model for every small end-effector step, whereas a single AMP1 turn can command a whole trajectory through code, and images enter the model’s context only when it asks for them.
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过按牌价计算每个回合的 token 费用，估计了 AMP1 在具有公开 API 定价的模型、Claude 模型以及 Gemini 4 Argon 上的推理成本（表 S3）。 使用 Opus 5.5 时，RoboLab-120 的一个回合平均花费 1.39 美元，比使用 GPT-6 Astra 的 Astranomy 所报告的 36.40 美元低约 26 倍 [21]。 （AMP1 的成功率也更高，82.8% 对 74.8%。）Astranomy 为每一步微小的末端执行器动作都查询模型，而 AMP1 的单个回合可以通过代码指令一整条轨迹，并且只有当模型主动请求时，图像才会进入其上下文。

paragraphs.en: Cost per episode is widely reported, but it mixes two factors: the tokens an episode consumes, which the model and harness determine, and the price per token, which the provider sets. Prices do not track capability. Opus 5 is billed at 25% more than Opus 5.5 for input and output tokens and 2.5 times more for cache reads ( Tab. S3 ). Prices also fall quickly: the cost of a given capability level has dropped by roughly an order of magnitude per year [ 26 , 27 ] . We therefore report model calls and token counts alongside cost ( Fig. S11 ); unlike cost, they compare models and harnesses independently of the price list.
paragraphs.zh: 每个回合的成本被广泛报道，但它混合了两个因素：回合消耗的 token 数量（由模型和执行框架决定），以及每个 token 的价格（由提供商设定）。 价格并不与能力同步。 Opus 5 的输入和输出 token 定价比 Opus 5.5 高 25%，缓存读取定价则高 2.5 倍（表 S3）。 价格也在快速下降：给定能力水平的成本每年大约下降一个数量级 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 因此，我们在报告成本的同时也报告模型调用次数和 token 数量（图 S11）；与成本不同，这些指标可以在不依赖价格表的情况下独立比较模型和执行框架。

paragraphs.en: More reasoning raises the success rate of every model in Fig. S11 A, but it also substantially raises the cost per episode. The extra cost has two sources: the model writes more in each turn, and it takes more turns, each of which re-reads the episode ( Fig. S11 B, C). How much the extra cost buys depends on the model. For Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, more reasoning adds 14.6 and 17.2 points for about $0.90 more per episode. For Gemini 4 Argon, which has little headroom, it adds 2.3 points for $1.30 more, more than doubling the cost.
paragraphs.zh: 图 S11 A 中，更多的推理提升了每个模型的成功率，但也大幅提高了每回合（episode）的成本。额外成本有两个来源：模型在每轮中写的内容更多，并且需要更多轮次，而每轮都会重新读取该回合（图 S11 B、C）。额外成本能换来多少收益取决于模型。对于 Opus 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5，更多推理分别带来 14.6 和 17.2 分的提升，代价是每回合约增加 0.90 美元。对于提升空间很小的 Gemini 4 Argon，它带来 2.3 分的提升，成本增加 1.30 美元，超过原来的两倍。

paragraphs.en: For the weaker models (Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 4.5), the assistive harness is both more successful and cheaper than the basic harness; for the stronger models (Gemini 4 Argon, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5), it is less successful at about the same cost ( Fig. S11 D; see Sec. 2D.2 ). The weaker models take fewer turns, as the assistive routines replace much of their trial and error, and require fewer tokens ( Fig. S11 E, F). Sonnet 5 and Opus 4.5 take about 30% fewer turns and cost 36 to 39% less per episode; Haiku 5.5 costs about 10% less. The stronger models take about as many turns as with the basic harness and generate 7 to 10% fewer tokens, but they read 10 to 19% more input, so their cost rises by up to 7%.
paragraphs.zh: 对于较弱的模型（Haiku 5.5、Sonnet 5 和 Opus 4.5），辅助式框架比基础式框架更成功且成本更低；对于较强的模型（Gemini 4 Argon、Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 和 Opus 5），它的成功率较低而成本大致相同（图 S11 D；见第 2D.2 节）。 较弱的模型所用轮数更少，因为辅助例程替代了它们大量的反复试错，且所需的 token 更少（图 S11 E、F）。 Sonnet 5 和 Opus 4.5 所用轮数减少约 30%，每个回合的成本降低 36% 至 39%；Haiku 5.5 的成本降低约 10%。 较强的模型所用轮数与基础式框架大致相同，生成的 token 减少 7% 至 10%，但它们读取的输入多 10% 至 19%，因此成本最多上升 7%。
